articles.title_en: Insights into multiscale damage mechanisms in cementitious materials under thermal cycling: the role of moisture behavior
articles.title_cn: 热循环作用下水泥基材料多尺度损伤机制研究：水分行为的作用
articles.abstract_en: Cementitious materials can deteriorate under thermal cycling (TC) above the freezing point even though no ice-related bulk phase transition occurs, which points to moisture behavior as a likely driver of damage, yet its specific contribution remains unclear. To isolate this contribution, we developed a field-temperature-referenced accelerated TC regime (5–45 °C, 3 h/cycle) and applied it to white Portland cement (WPC) paste preconditioned to controlled internal relative humidity (RH) levels of 10–99% and tested under either sealed or free-exchange boundary conditions, so that the internal moisture state and boundary-controlled moisture exchange could be separated. Under sealed conditions, UPV loss grew with internal RH, from 3.89% (S10) to 8.62% (S99), despite negligible net mass change. Standardized multiscale indicators revealed an RH-dependent transition in the governing mechanism: drier specimens were controlled by capillary suction and pore coarsening, whereas wetter specimens underwent cyclic moisture redistribution, accumulated short-T2 water (interlayer and gel water), and developed localized microcracking within a densifying matrix. 1H NMR confirmed that this redistribution was only partly reversible, leaving a residual shift toward short-T2 components, and the calculated calcium-silicate-hydrate (C-S-H) interlayer spacing evolved toward about 0.76 nm regardless of the initial state. Allowing free moisture exchange changed the mechanism rather than merely intensifying it: F99 showed the largest UPV loss (19.4%), together with stronger crack connectivity, pronounced strain localization (μεxx = −2.25, μεyy = −4.76), and intensified carbonation, signaling a coupled moisture transport–carbonation–fracture pathway. On this basis, a tri-component thermo-hygro damage model was formulated to apportion UPV-based deterioration among intrinsic thermal fatigue, RH-dependent amplification, and boundary-controlled moisture exchange. The results establish, at the matrix scale, that internal moisture state and boundary exchange—not net drying—govern the severity and the mode of TC-induced damage in cement paste.
articles.abstract_cn: 水泥基材料在冰点以上的热循环（TC）作用下会发生劣化，即使没有发生与冰相关的体相转变，这表明水分行为可能是损伤的驱动因素，但其具体贡献仍不清楚。为分离这一贡献，我们开发了一种场温度参考的加速热循环制度（5-45 °C，3 小时/循环），并将其应用于预 conditioning 至受控内部相对湿度（RH）水平（10-99%）的白硅酸盐水泥（WPC）浆体，并在密封或自由交换边界条件下进行测试，从而可以分离内部水分状态和边界控制的水分交换。在密封条件下，超声波脉冲速度（UPV）损失随内部相对湿度的增加而增加，从 3.89%（S10）到 8.62%（S99），尽管净质量变化可忽略不计。标准化的多尺度指标揭示了控制机制随相对湿度变化的转变：较干燥的试样受毛细管吸力和孔隙粗化控制，而较湿润的试样经历循环水分再分布，积累短T2水（层间水和凝胶水），并在致密化基体内发展局部微裂纹。1H NMR 证实这种再分布仅部分可逆，留下向短T2组分的残余偏移，计算得到的钙硅酸盐 hydrate（C-S-H）层间距无论初始状态如何均演化至约 0.76 nm。允许自由水分交换改变了机制而非仅仅加剧了它：F99 显示出最大的 UPV 损失（19.4%），同时具有更强的裂纹连通性、显著的应变局部化（μεxx = −2.25，μεyy = −4.76）和加剧的碳化，表明存在耦合的水分传输-碳化-断裂路径。在此基础上，建立了一个三组分热湿损伤模型，将基于 UPV 的劣化分配为固有热疲劳、相对湿度依赖的放大和边界控制的水分交换。结果在基体尺度上证实，内部水分状态和边界交换——而非净干燥——控制着水泥浆体中 TC 诱导损伤的严重程度和模式。

articles.title_en: Evaluating links between microscale mineralogy and neutral rock drainage chemistry in mine waste materials
articles.title_cn: 评估矿山废料中微尺度矿物学与中性岩石排水化学之间的联系
articles.abstract_en: Quantitative automated mineralogical analysis is commonly used in mineral exploration, processing and increasingly in mine waste management. Yet, full integration between the microscale mineralogical dynamics of mine waste materials and the evolution of (bulk) wastewater quality remains challenging, especially for complex, heterogeneous materials. We experimented with syenite and skarn waste rock in 32-week leaching experiments under oxic versus sub-oxic conditions and examined the potential controls of (modal) mineralogical composition and mineral textures on select hydrochemical features of the resulting leachate. Circumneutral leachate pH was maintained throughout all experiments, and Ca, Sr, and Mn, and bicarbonate and sulfate were the most abundant solutes mobilized through mineral dissolution. Mineralogical analyses reveal carbonates and sulfates as the most reactive phases with generally higher exposures (liberation) and significant alteration to their textural properties, particularly in experiments under oxic conditions. Descriptive statistical analyses (time series, partial correlations and principal component analyses) helped identify plausible mechanistic controls on leachate trends, e.g., elevated Ca and Mg leachate concentrations attributed to carbonate dissolution and a mobilization of Sr from celestine dissolution. This study demonstrates that automated mineralogical analyses can provide valuable mechanistic insight into selected drainage features, while highlighting the challenges of establishing robust quantitative relationships between microscale mineralogical properties and bulk wastewater quality in heterogeneous mine waste materials.
articles.abstract_cn: 定量自动化矿物学分析常用于矿产勘探、加工，并越来越多地用于矿山废料管理。然而，矿山废料材料的微尺度矿物学动态与（总体）废水质量演变之间的完全整合仍然具有挑战性，尤其是对于复杂、异质的材料。我们在32周的浸出实验中，对正长岩和矽卡岩废石在氧化与次氧化条件下进行了实验，并考察了（模态）矿物组成和矿物结构对所得浸出液特定水化学特征的潜在控制作用。所有实验中浸出液pH值保持在中性附近，通过矿物溶解 mobilized 的最丰富溶质为Ca、Sr、Mn以及碳酸氢盐和硫酸盐。矿物学分析显示，碳酸盐和硫酸盐是最具反应性的相，通常具有较高的暴露（解离）程度，并且其结构性质发生显著变化，尤其是在氧化条件下的实验中。描述性统计分析（时间序列、偏相关和主成分分析）有助于识别浸出液趋势的合理机制控制因素，例如，Ca和Mg浸出液浓度升高归因于碳酸盐溶解，而Sr的迁移来自天青石溶解。本研究证明，自动化矿物学分析可以为特定排水特征提供有价值的机制见解，同时强调了在异质矿山废料材料中建立微尺度矿物学性质与总体废水质量之间稳健定量关系的挑战。

articles.title_en: Fe(II)-doped hydrotalcite in cement systems: Structure and Cr(VI) immobilization
articles.title_cn: 水泥体系中Fe(II)掺杂水滑石：结构及Cr(VI)固定
articles.abstract_en: Fe(II)-doped hydrotalcite can form in cement systems under anoxic conditions, e.g., landfills and geological repositories, but its molecular structure and environmental function remain largely unexplored. Here, the molecular structure and Cr(VI) immobilization mechanism of Fe(II)-hydrotalcite are investigated through a combination of synchrotron-based X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) and molecular simulations. Fe(II) can substitute for Mg(II) in the hydrotalcite main layer, forming a continuous solid solution and inducing local structural distortion likely caused by differences in ionic radius and electron distribution. The incorporation of Fe(II) markedly enhances the Cr(VI) retention capacity, increasing the removal efficiency from ~10% to nearly 100%. Combined Fe and Cr K-edge XAS reveals that Cr(VI) is reduced to Cr(III), while Fe(II) is oxidized to Fe(III). The Cr(III) species are likely incorporated into a goethite-like phase. These findings provide molecular-level insight into the structure-redox-immobilization relationship of Fe(II)-hydrotalcite and offer guidance for designing cementitious materials capable of long-term retention of toxic oxyanions.
articles.abstract_cn: Fe(II)掺杂水滑石可在缺氧条件下（如垃圾填埋场和地质处置库）的水泥体系中形成，但其分子结构和环境功能在很大程度上仍未得到探索。本研究通过同步辐射X射线吸收光谱（XAS）与分子模拟相结合的方法，研究了Fe(II)-水滑石的分子结构及Cr(VI)固定机制。Fe(II)可替代水滑石主层中的Mg(II)，形成连续固溶体，并引起局部结构畸变，这可能是由离子半径和电子分布的差异所致。Fe(II)的掺入显著增强了Cr(VI)的保留能力，将去除效率从约10%提高到接近100%。Fe和Cr K边XAS联合分析表明，Cr(VI)被还原为Cr(III)，而Fe(II)被氧化为Fe(III)。Cr(III)物种可能被掺入针铁矿相中。这些发现为Fe(II)-水滑石的结构-氧化还原-固定关系提供了分子层面的见解，并为设计能够长期保留有毒含氧阴离子的胶凝材料提供了指导。

articles.title_en: Versatility of buccal myomucosal flap for secondary cleft palatal defects- our experience with 123 cases
articles.title_cn: 颊肌黏膜瓣在继发性腭裂缺损修复中的多功能性——基于123例病例的经验
articles.abstract_en: IntroductionCleft palate repair aims to restore both the anatomical and functional integrity of the palate. Despite advancements in surgical procedures, palatal fistulas continue to be a severe problem, affecting speech, swallowing, and quality of life. The. This study investigates the efficacy of buccal myomucosal flaps in closure of secondary cleft palatal defects, with an emphasis on larger anterior fistulas. Materials and methodsWe treated 123 patients with palatal fistulae using buccal myomucosal flaps from 2008 to 2023. All cases involved a two-layer closure technique using a posteriorly based buccal artery pedicle. Patients were followed up postoperatively at intervals of 1 week, 1 month, 3 months, 6 months, and 12 months. Speech outcomes were assessed preoperatively and postoperatively. ResultsThe study included 62 females and 61 males with mean age 6 years 11 months. The original defects included unilateral, bilateral, and isolated cleft palates. Most fistulas (43%) were located at the anterior hard palate. Buccal flaps were taken from the right side in 64% of cases, left side in 23%, and bilaterally in 12%. The largest fistula measured 6 cm × 7 cm, and the smallest 11 mm × 18 mm. Postoperative complications were minimal, with no cases of hemorrhage, infection, or flap necrosis. Speech analysis showed significant improvement across all measures. ConclusionThe buccal myomucosal flap is a versatile and effective technique for secondary cleft palatal defect repair. It provides a reliable solution for closing fistulas and lengthening the soft palate, with minimal complications and significant improvements in speech.
articles.abstract_cn: 引言腭裂修复旨在恢复腭部的解剖和功能完整性。尽管手术技术不断进步，腭瘘仍然是一个严重问题，影响言语、吞咽和生活质量。本研究探讨颊肌黏膜瓣在关闭继发性腭裂缺损中的疗效，重点关注较大的前部瘘管。材料与方法我们于2008年至2023年间使用颊肌黏膜瓣治疗了123例腭瘘患者。所有病例均采用基于后部颊动脉蒂的两层关闭技术。患者术后分别在1周、1个月、3个月、6个月和12个月进行随访。言语结果在术前和术后进行评估。结果研究包括62名女性和61名男性，平均年龄为6岁11个月。原始缺损包括单侧、双侧和孤立性腭裂。大多数瘘管（43%%）位于前硬腭。颊瓣取自右侧的占64%%，左侧占23%%，双侧占12%。最大瘘管尺寸为6厘米×7厘米，最小为11毫米×18毫米。术后并发症极少，无出血、感染或皮瓣坏死病例。言语分析显示所有指标均有显著改善。结论颊肌黏膜瓣是修复继发性腭裂缺损的一种多功能且有效的技术。它为关闭瘘管和延长软腭提供了可靠的解决方案，并发症少，言语改善显著。

articles.title_en: Hearing is caring: Machine learning modelling for the prediction of pediatric unmet hearing health needs
The gender dimension of refugees’ integration in the labor market
articles.title_cn: 难民劳动力市场融入的性别维度
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the gender differences in labor market integration among refugees and their determinants. It focuses on a longitudinal dataset that covers the entire refugee population in Switzerland over 20 years. During the period examined, the majority of refugees came from low-income economies in Africa and Asia. The quasi-random allocation of asylum seekers across Swiss cantons, which differ in their socio-economic characteristics, provides a natural experiment to identify the effects of source country culture and the role of local initial conditions in shaping refugees’ labor-market integration trajectories. Our empirical findings show that women refugees from countries with more conservative gender norms (measured by female-to-male labor force participation ratios and fertility rates) have less favorable labor market outcomes, with these effects varying in their persistence over time. The analysis further reveals the negative role of initial unemployment and the positive role of co-ethnic networks in the cantons of arrival, with these effects varying by gender and network characteristics. Finally, local attitudes toward gender equality reduce the gender gap in labor market outcomes among refugees.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了难民劳动力市场融入中的性别差异及其决定因素。研究聚焦于一个覆盖瑞士全部难民人口、时间跨度达20年的纵向数据集。在研究期间，大多数难民来自非洲和亚洲的低收入经济体。寻求庇护者在社会经济特征各异的瑞士各州之间的准随机分配，提供了一个自然实验，用以识别来源国文化的影响以及当地初始条件在塑造难民劳动力市场融入轨迹中的作用。我们的实证研究结果表明，来自性别规范更为保守（以男女劳动力参与率之比和生育率衡量）的国家的女性难民，其劳动力市场结果较差，且这些效应在时间上的持续性有所不同。分析进一步揭示了到达州初始失业率的负面作用以及同族网络的正面作用，这些效应因性别和网络特征而异。最后，当地对性别平等的态度缩小了难民劳动力市场结果中的性别差距。

articles.title_en: A study on the adsorption and dispersion capability of VPEG-PCEs with different structures on cement containing montmorillonite
articles.title_cn: 不同结构VPEG-PCEs对含蒙脱土水泥的吸附与分散性能研究
articles.abstract_en: Polycarboxylate ether (PCE) superplasticizer exhibits excellent dispersion and water-reducing capability, but its poor tolerance to montmorillonite (MMT) limits the application. This paper synthesized PCEs with multi-branches structure and their molecular structures were characterized by Gel permeation chromatography (GPC), Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR), 1H-nuclear magnetic resonance (1H-NMR) spectroscopy and specific charge density. The adsorption behaviors of the synthesized PCEs on cement and MMT were investigated. The time-dependent flowability of the paste with these PCEs were measured, and the hydration of cement were examined. Based on that, the interaction mechanisms between these PCEs and MMT were revealed. Results show that the novel PCEs exhibit stronger dispersion capability in cement containing MMT system and have the lower relative flowability loss values than that of comb-like PCE (VPCE). Interestingly, the performance of the PCE grafted polyethylene glycol diacrylate (PPCE) shows higher dependence on the content of MMT. At a low MMT content, it exhibits stronger tolerance to MMT than the PCE with N'N methylene bisacrylamide monomer (MPCE), but the flowability of paste significantly decreases with the increase of MMT.
articles.abstract_cn: 聚羧酸醚（PCE）高效减水剂表现出优异的分散和减水能力，但其对蒙脱土（MMT）的耐受性较差，限制了其应用。本文合成了多支链结构的PCEs，并通过凝胶渗透色谱（GPC）、傅里叶变换红外光谱（FTIR）、1H-核磁共振（1H-NMR）光谱和比电荷密度对其分子结构进行了表征。研究了合成的PCEs在水泥和MMT上的吸附行为。测量了含这些PCEs浆体的随时间变化的流动性，并考察了水泥的水化过程。在此基础上，揭示了这些PCEs与MMT之间的相互作用机制。结果表明，新型PCEs在含MMT水泥体系中表现出更强的分散能力，且相对流动性损失值低于梳形PCE（VPCE）。有趣的是，接枝聚乙二醇二丙烯酸酯的PCE（PPCE）的性能对MMT含量表现出更高的依赖性。在低MMT含量下，其对MMT的耐受性强于含N'N亚甲基双丙烯酰胺单体的PCE（MPCE），但随着MMT含量的增加，浆体的流动性显著下降。

articles.title_en: In-situ polymerization-induced thixotropy of cement paste under shear histories: A theoretical model
articles.title_cn: 剪切历史下原位聚合诱导水泥浆体触变性的理论模型
articles.abstract_en: In-situ polymerization modified cement paste (IPC) offers significant potential for applications such as anti-washout concrete and 3D concrete printing (3DCP), owing to its uniquely enhanced rheological properties. However, the thixotropic behavior of IPC following different shear histories remains unclear. Here, we establish a theoretical model to depict the in-situ polymerization-induced thixotropy of IPC under various shear histories and reveal the underlying physiochemical mechanism. Rheological measurements indicate that the thixotropic structural build-up of IPC decreases with increasing shear duration, consistent with the slowed re-aggregation of cement flocs observed microscopically. We found that thixotropic behavior of IPC is predominantly governed by polymer-bridging interactions, and therefore established a theoretical model based on the surface coverage (θ) of adsorbed polymers. When θ<θcri, the interparticle forces exhibit only minor changes with larger θ, indicating that the monolayer adsorption (θcri ≅ 1) of in-situ formed sodium polyacrylate (PAAS) contributes minimally to the thixotropic structuration rate (Athix) as monolayer adsorption is insufficient to establish polymer bridging. Once θ>θcri, multilayer adsorption emerges and strengthens interparticle forces through the formation of polymer bridges, thereby markedly increasing Athix. As θ approaches θsat, polymer adsorption reaches saturation at approximately two layers of in-situ formed PAAS (θsat ≅ 2), leading to a gradual decline in Athix until it completely diminishes at θsat. For a specific system, therefore, shear history determines the initial surface coverage (θini) and the potential for polymerization (β) during the resting period, influencing subsequent polymer adsorption and thus the thixotropic behavior of IPC. Our findings define a mechanism of in-situ polymerization-induced thixotropic structuration, paving the way for investigations into how rheological properties of IPC evolve across various applications under different shear histories.
articles.abstract_cn: 原位聚合改性水泥浆体（IPC）因其独特增强的流变性能，在抗冲刷混凝土和3D混凝土打印（3DCP）等应用中展现出巨大潜力。然而，不同剪切历史后IPC的触变行为仍不清楚。在此，我们建立了一个理论模型来描述IPC在各种剪切历史下原位聚合诱导的触变性，并揭示其潜在的物理化学机制。流变测量表明，IPC的触变结构建立随剪切持续时间的增加而降低，这与微观观察到的水泥絮凝物再聚集减慢一致。我们发现IPC的触变行为主要由聚合物桥接相互作用控制，因此基于吸附聚合物的表面覆盖率（θ）建立了理论模型。当θ<θcri时，颗粒间力随θ增大仅发生微小变化，表明原位形成的聚丙烯酸钠（PAAS）的单层吸附（θcri ≅ 1）对触变结构化速率（Athix）贡献极小，因为单层吸附不足以建立聚合物桥接。一旦θ>θcri，多层吸附出现并通过形成聚合物桥增强颗粒间力，从而显著增加Athix。当θ接近θsat时，聚合物吸附达到饱和，约为两层原位形成的PAAS（θsat ≅ 2），导致Athix逐渐下降直至在θsat时完全消失。因此，对于特定体系，剪切历史决定了静置期间的初始表面覆盖率（θini）和聚合潜力（β），影响后续聚合物吸附，从而影响IPC的触变行为。我们的发现定义了原位聚合诱导触变结构化的机制，为研究不同剪切历史下IPC流变性能在各种应用中的演变铺平了道路。

articles.title_en: Further insight into the effect of silanes with different molecular structures on cement hydration
articles.title_cn: 不同分子结构硅烷对水泥水化影响的进一步研究
articles.abstract_en: Effect of three types of silanes with the increased number of amino groups (n-dodecyl triethoxysilane (DTES), aminopropyltriethoxysilane (APTES), 2-aminoethyl-3-aminopropyl trimethoxysilane (AEAPTMS)) on cement hydration was investigated by means of calorimetry, ICP-OES, TOC analysis, and DLS measurement. It is found that an increased number of amino groups in the silane molecule can lead to a strong retardation effect on cement hydration. Further analysis indicates that this retardation effect is not primarily caused by the hindrance to clinker dissolution or by the prevention of nuclei formation, but by the inhibition of the growth of hydration products. The added aminosilanes can be strongly adsorbed on the newly formed C-S-H nuclei and complex with the free calcium ions in the pore solution. The adsorption amount and the amount of complexed calcium ions of silane increase with the number of amino groups in the molecular structure. Both of them could prevent the further growth of hydration products and eventually retard cement hydration.
articles.abstract_cn: 通过量热法、ICP-OES、TOC分析和DLS测量，研究了三种氨基数量增加的硅烷（正十二烷基三乙氧基硅烷（DTES）、氨丙基三乙氧基硅烷（APTES）、[2]-氨乙基-[3]-氨丙基三甲氧基硅烷（AEAPTMS））对水泥水化的影响。研究发现，硅烷分子中氨基数量的增加可导致对水泥水化的强烈延缓作用。进一步分析表明，这种延缓作用并非主要由阻碍熟料溶解或阻止晶核形成所致，而是通过抑制水化产物的生长。添加的氨基硅烷能强烈吸附在新形成的C-S-H晶核上，并与孔隙溶液中的游离钙离子络合。硅烷的吸附量和络合钙离子的量随分子结构中氨基数量的增加而增加。这两者都能阻止水化产物的进一步生长，最终延缓水泥水化。

articles.abstract_en: Apatite minerals and their synthetic analogs are becoming increasingly important in the rare-earth element (REE) industry. In this study, a Ce-bearing analog of lead apatite – pyromorphite Pb5(PO4)3Cl – was synthesized and its dissolution was experimentally examined over a wide temperature range, to evaluate its solubility and potential in REE recovery. We demonstrate that precipitation of pyromorphite from aqueous solution in the presence of Ce results in Ce incorporation into the structure via heterovalent substitution coupled with Na, yielding Pb4.17(Ce0.5Na0.16)(PO4)3Cl. Dissolution experiments were conducted at 5, 15, 21, 40 and 70 °C for 32 days open to the air. Solubility increases with temperature for both the pure and Ce-substituted phase. Cerium substitution in pyromorphite lowers the apparent solubility product indicating thermodynamically driven preferential incorporation of Ce into its structure. Similar to REE-rich Ca-apatite, the Ce-doped pyromorphite dissolves incongruently with precipitation of secondary Ce-phosphate phases: CePO4·0.6H2O and Ce2Pb3(PO4)4·nH2O. These phases become more abundant at elevated temperatures, reflecting their retrograde solubility typical of hydrated REE-phosphates. Nevertheless, their total abundance remains below 10 vol%. The apparent solubility constants Ksp,app,25 °C calculated for the dissolution reactions Pb5(PO4)3Cl(s) ⇌ 5 Pb2+ + 3PO43− + Cl− and Pb4.17(Ce0.5Na0.16)(PO4)3Cl(s) ⇌ 4.17 Pb2+ + 0.16Na+ + 0.5Ce3+ + 3PO43− + Cl− are 10−79.98±1.72 and 10−80.34±1.16, respectively. Both constants increase with increasing temperature. These results provide new quantitative constraints on REE beneficiation strategies that rely on the precipitation of REE-substituted Pb-apatite analogs.
articles.abstract_cn: 磷灰石矿物及其合成类似物在稀土元素 (REE) 行业中变得越来越重要。在本研究中，合成了铅磷灰石的含 Ce 类似物——焦氯铅矿 Pb5(PO4)3Cl，并在较宽的温度范围内通过实验检查了其溶解情况，以评估其溶解度和 REE 回收潜力。我们证明，在存在 Ce 的情况下，叶氯矿从水溶液中沉淀出来，导致 Ce 通过与 Na 偶联的异价取代结合到结构中，产生 Pb4.17(Ce0.5Na0.16)(PO4)3Cl。溶解实验在 5、15、21、40 和 70 °C 下，在空气中开放 32 天进行。纯相和 Ce 取代相的溶解度都随着温度的升高而增加。叶氯矿中的铈取代降低了表观溶度积，表明热力学驱动的 Ce 优先掺入其结构中。与富含 REE 的钙磷灰石类似，Ce 掺杂的磷氯铅矿的溶解与次生 Ce-磷酸盐相的沉淀不一致：CePO4·0.6H2O 和 Ce2Pb3(PO4)4·nH2O。这些相在高温下变得更加丰富，反映了它们典型的水合稀土磷酸盐的逆溶解度。然而，它们的总丰度仍然低于 10 vol%。表观溶解度常数 Ksp,app,25 °C 计算溶解反应 Pb5(PO4)3Cl(s) ⇌ 5 Pb2+ + 3PO43− + Cl− 和 Pb4.17(Ce0.5Na0.16)(PO4)3Cl(s) ⇌ 4.17 Pb2+ + 0.16Na+ + 0.5Ce3+ + 3PO43− + Cl− 分别为 10−79.98±1.72 和 10−80.34±1.16。两个常数都随着温度的升高而增加。这些结果为依赖于 REE 取代的铅磷灰石类似物沉淀的 REE 选矿策略提供了新的定量限制。

articles.title_en: Quartz geochemistry and H–O isotopic signatures of the Mufushan granite-pegmatite system, South China: Implications for magmatic evolution, fluid mixing, and rare metal metallogenesis
articles.title_cn: 华南幕阜山花岗岩-伟晶岩体系的石英地球化学与H-O同位素特征：对岩浆演化、流体混合和稀有金属成矿的指示
articles.abstract_en: The Mufushan granite-pegmatite system in South China is a world-class LCT rare-metal province that preserves a well-defined record of magmatic-hydrothermal evolution. Previous studies have primarily focused on the geochronology of granites and pegmatites, the occurrence of rare metals, and the sources of ore-forming fluids. However, the genetic mechanisms of pegmatite deposits remain debated, and the prolonged history of fluid evolution in the region is still poorly constrained. This study employs femtosecond LA-ICP-MS and stable isotope techniques to characterize quartz trace element geochemistry and H–O isotopic compositions from eight granitic units of the Mufushan complex. We aim to reconstruct the petrogenesis, fluid evolution, and rare-metal mineralization from the Late Jurassic to Early Cretaceous. Quartz compositions reveal a progressive transition in substitution mechanisms: from Al3++Li+ → Si4+ during the granitic stage to Al3++Na+ → Si4+ in the pegmatitic stage. A coupled B3++P5+ → 2Si4+ substitution remained active throughout the magmatic evolution, with minimal interference from Al-bearing species. Within the framework of pegmatite genetic classification, elemental discrimination plots (Li, Al, Ge, Ti) and H–O isotopic characteristics (δD: −88.9∼-58.3‰, δ18O: 9.38∼12.14‰) suggest a hybrid petrogenetic model involving both magmatic differentiation and crustal anatexis for the Mufushan pluton. Mineralogical zonation, decreasing crystallization temperatures, and coherent trace element trends are consistent with a fractional crystallization model; however, distinct trace element patterns in muscovite granite and albite pegmatite (the weak correlation between Ge and Ti) indicate an additional contribution from crustal sources. Quartz Ge-Al-Ti-Rb content predominantly plot within the deep anatectic pegmatite (DPA) field, whereas the most evolved rocks (potassium feldspar-quartz pegmatite) trend toward residual melt granitic (RMG) signatures, further supporting a hybrid petrogenetic model. Integrating quartz thermometry with trace element data reveals a three-stage fluid evolution: (1) a granite stage recording initial fluid-rock interaction; (2) a pegmatite stage exhibiting high-temperature melt-fluid interaction, anomalous temperature increases, and enrichment of specific trace elements (B, Al, P, Na) in albite pegmatite; and (3) a poltassium feldspar-quartz pegmatite stage representing the most evolved, oxidizing end-member of the system (δCe = 0.001-0.82). Rare metal enrichment is closely associated with late-stage processes, particularly in two-mica granites and potassium feldspar-rich pegmatites. Diagnostic trace element thresholds identify highly evolved phases as key geochemical vectors for Li and B mineralization. These findings establish a hybrid petrogenetic model and highlight the metallogenic significance of late-stage evolution in orogenic LCT pegmatite systems globally.
articles.abstract_cn: 华南幕阜山花岗岩-伟晶岩体系是世界级的LCT稀有金属省，保存了清晰的岩浆-热液演化记录。以往研究主要集中于花岗岩和伟晶岩的地质年代学、稀有金属赋存状态及成矿流体来源。然而，伟晶岩矿床的成因机制仍存在争议，该地区长期的流体演化历史仍缺乏约束。本研究采用飞秒LA-ICP-MS和稳定同位素技术，表征了幕阜山杂岩体八个花岗岩单元的石英微量元素地球化学和H-O同位素组成。我们旨在重建从晚侏罗世到早白垩世的岩石成因、流体演化和稀有金属矿化过程。石英组成揭示了替代机制的渐进转变：从花岗岩阶段的Al3++Li+ → Si4+ 转变为伟晶岩阶段的Al3++Na+ → Si4+。耦合的B3++P5+ → 2Si4+替代在整个岩浆演化过程中持续活跃，且受含铝物种的干扰极小。在伟晶岩成因分类框架内，元素判别图（Li、Al、Ge、Ti）和H-O同位素特征（δD：−88.9∼-58.3‰，δ18O：9.38∼12.14‰）表明幕阜山岩体存在岩浆分异和地壳深熔的混合成因模型。矿物分带、结晶温度降低和一致的微量元素趋势与分离结晶模型相符；然而，白云母花岗岩和钠长石伟晶岩中不同的微量元素模式（Ge与Ti的弱相关性）指示了地壳来源的额外贡献。石英Ge-Al-Ti-Rb含量主要落在深部深熔伟晶岩（DPA）区域，而最演化岩石（钾长石-石英伟晶岩）趋向残余熔体花岗岩（RMG）特征，进一步支持混合成因模型。结合石英温度计和微量元素数据，揭示了三个阶段流体演化：（1）花岗岩阶段记录了初始流体-岩石相互作用；（2）伟晶岩阶段表现出高温熔体-流体相互作用、异常温度升高以及钠长石伟晶岩中特定微量元素（B、Al、P、Na）的富集；（3）钾长石-石英伟晶岩阶段代表了体系中最演化、氧化性最强的端元（δCe = 0.001-0.82）。稀有金属富集与晚期过程密切相关，尤其是在二云母花岗岩和富钾长石伟晶岩中。诊断性微量元素阈值识别出高演化相作为Li和B矿化的关键地球化学指示标志。这些发现建立了混合成因模型，并强调了晚期演化在全球造山型LCT伟晶岩体系中的成矿意义。

articles.title_en: The effects of phosphorus and fluorine doping on ternesite: Sintering behavior, high-temperature reaction kinetics and hydration properties
articles.title_cn: 磷和氟掺杂对硫硅酸钙的影响：烧结行为、高温反应动力学和水化性能
articles.abstract_en: Ternesite meets the development needs of contemporary cement industry as a low-carbon emission cement mineral. This study investigates the effects of phosphorus (P) and fluorine (F) doping on the sintering process of ternesite, revealing the kinetic mechanisms of its formation and decomposition, and exploring the regulatory role of doping on hydration behavior. The results indicated that P and F doping lowered the formation temperature of ternesite, while P doping also improved its thermal stability. The highest content of ternesite in P and F doped samples was achieved at 1150 °C for 8–12 h (90.15% and 91.35%), while the undoped samples (86.6%) was at 1200 °C for 8 h. Doping did not significantly alter the morphology of ternesite, only affected the grain size. The kinetic analysis showed that the initial formation of ternesite was influenced by diffusion control and interface chemical reaction control, while the middle and later stages and decomposition processes were dominated by diffusion control. Among them, the formation process involved the migration and diffusion of Ca2+ and SO42− through the intermediate region towards the center of SiO2 particles, while the decomposition reaction was mainly controlled by the growth of C2S and the diffusion rate of Ca2+. Ternesite had potential hydration activity, but P and F doping inhibited early activity. It was worth noting that the higher chemically combined water content in the middle and later stages of P-doped samples reflected significant hydration potential, with a paste compressive strength of 16.6 MPa at 180 d. The study of the reaction mechanism and kinetics of the ternesite minerals can provide guidance for the production and application of low-carbon cement.
articles.abstract_cn: 硫硅酸钙作为一种低碳排放水泥矿物，满足了当代水泥工业的发展需求。本研究探讨了磷（P）和氟（F）掺杂对硫硅酸钙烧结过程的影响，揭示了其形成和分解的动力学机制，并探索了掺杂对水化行为的调控作用。结果表明，P和F掺杂降低了硫硅酸钙的形成温度，而P掺杂还提高了其热稳定性。P和F掺杂样品中硫硅酸钙的最高含量在1150 °C下保温8-12 h时获得（90.15%和91.35%），而未掺杂样品（86.6%）则在1200 °C下保温8 h时达到。掺杂并未显著改变硫硅酸钙的形貌，仅影响了晶粒尺寸。动力学分析表明，硫硅酸钙的初始形成受扩散控制和界面化学反应控制的影响，而中后期和分解过程则以扩散控制为主。其中，形成过程涉及Ca2+和SO42−通过中间区域向SiO2颗粒中心迁移和扩散，而分解反应主要受C2S的生长和Ca2+的扩散速率控制。硫硅酸钙具有潜在的水化活性，但P和F掺杂抑制了早期活性。值得注意的是，P掺杂样品在中后期较高的化学结合水含量反映了显著的水化潜力，其浆体抗压强度在180 d时为16.6 MPa。对硫硅酸钙矿物反应机理和动力学的研究可为低碳水泥的生产和应用提供指导。

articles.title_en: Multi-scale modeling of cement-based materials under sulfate attack: Roles of phase assemblage and microstructural evolution in compressive strength
articles.title_cn: 硫酸盐侵蚀下水泥基材料的多尺度建模：相组成与微观结构演化对抗压强度的作用
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd. All rights are reserved, including those for text and data mining, AI training, and similar technologies. The degradation of cement-based materials under sulfate attack is primarily governed by the evolution of the microstructure and phase composition, while the contribution of each to the deterioration process remains unclear. Within the framework of continuum micromechanics, this study develops a hierarchical multi-scale model that upscales mechanical properties from the scale of hydration products to the concrete scale. The model sequentially defines representative volume elements at four scales, then upscales properties using multi-step and multi-level homogenization methods coupled with a quasi-brittle failure criterion, and validates the predictions against 400-day experimental data across cement paste, mortar, and concrete. The analysis elucidates how organizational forms at distinct material scales lead to variations in macroscopic performance, and provides a comprehensive explanation for the differing degrees of deterioration observed in cement paste, mortar and concrete. Based on quantitative results, this study identifies how microstructure and phase composition control strength evolution is systematically identified. Overall, this research provides a quantitative and physically grounded framework for predicting the long-term strength evolution of cement-based materials under sulfate attack, offering a reliable basis for durability assessment, service life prediction, and the design of corrosion-resistant concrete structures.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd. 保留所有权利，包括文本和数据挖掘、AI训练及类似技术的权利。硫酸盐侵蚀下水泥基材料的劣化主要受微观结构和相组成演化的控制，但各自对劣化过程的贡献仍不清楚。在连续介质细观力学的框架内，本研究开发了一个分层多尺度模型，将力学性能从水化产物尺度提升到混凝土尺度。该模型依次在四个尺度上定义代表性体积单元，然后通过多步和多级均匀化方法结合准脆性破坏准则提升性能，并针对水泥浆体、砂浆和混凝土的400天实验数据验证预测结果。分析阐明了不同材料尺度上的组织形式如何导致宏观性能的差异，并为水泥浆体、砂浆和混凝土观察到的不同程度劣化提供了全面解释。基于定量结果，本研究系统识别了微观结构和相组成如何控制强度演化。总体而言，本研究为预测硫酸盐侵蚀下水泥基材料的长期强度演化提供了一个定量且基于物理的框架，为耐久性评估、使用寿命预测和耐腐蚀混凝土结构设计提供了可靠依据。

articles.title_en: Rentier resource nationalism and overseas investment by multinational corporations: the impact of resource value
articles.title_cn: 食利型资源民族主义与跨国公司海外投资：资源价值的影响
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd Characterized by its predatory nature and the institutional uncertainty, rentier resource nationalism (RRN) has emerged as a critical risk factor for overseas investment by multinational corporations (MNCs). However, existing literature rarely relies on theoretical models to analyze the differential impacts of RRN across heterogeneous investment objectives. Furthermore, the underlying role of resource value remains underexplored, particularly from the perspective of “cognitive divergence”. To address these gaps, this study develops a three-stage game model and investigates how RRN and resource value affect the economic variables of MNCs. The results reveal that RRN significantly reduces the residual profit and overseas investment outlay of MNCs, while increasing metal output. Through the lens of investment objective heterogeneity, MNCs targeting residual profit maximization suffer negative shocks. Conversely, MNCs aiming to ensure more resource supply can benefit from the dynamics, and exhibit a higher tolerance threshold for RRN intensity. The ultimate impact of resource value hinges on the relative strength of the market-size driving effect versus the resource-depletion inhibitory effect. Crucially, “cognitive divergence” regarding resource value serves as an important mechanism explaining the simultaneous emergence of intensified RRN and the expansion of investment outlay. This study provides a theoretical foundation for the rational formulation of RRN policies and enriches the theoretical framework of international investment.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd 食利型资源民族主义（RRN）以其掠夺性和制度不确定性为特征，已成为跨国公司（MNCs）海外投资的关键风险因素。然而，现有文献很少依赖理论模型来分析RRN在不同投资目标下的差异化影响。此外，资源价值的潜在作用仍未得到充分探讨，尤其是从“认知分歧”的角度。为弥补这些空白，本研究构建了一个三阶段博弈模型，并考察了RRN和资源价值如何影响跨国公司的经济变量。结果表明，RRN显著降低了跨国公司的剩余利润和海外投资支出，同时增加了金属产量。从投资目标异质性的角度来看，以剩余利润最大化为目标的跨国公司遭受负面冲击。相反，旨在确保更多资源供应的跨国公司可以从这种动态中受益，并对RRN强度表现出更高的容忍阈值。资源价值的最终影响取决于市场规模驱动效应与资源耗竭抑制效应的相对强度。至关重要的是，关于资源价值的“认知分歧”是解释RRN加剧与投资支出扩张同时出现的重要机制。本研究为合理制定RRN政策提供了理论基础，并丰富了国际投资的理论框架。

articles.title_en: Geochemical data imputation and anomaly detection based on diffusion models
articles.title_cn: 基于扩散模型的地球化学数据填补与异常检测
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Geochemical data commonly contain missing values and anomaly values. In studies represented by tectonic discrimination, the utilization rate of geochemical data typically ranges from 10% to 20% or even lower, which greatly restricts geochemical research and disciplinary development. To address these issues, this paper expands tectonic settings to seven categories covering both continental and oceanic environments. Based on generative models, this study proposes a missing value imputation model with multi-type feature processing and a self-supervised diffusion time estimation model for anomaly detection. In addition, this paper explores optimal data preprocessing strategies for different models, offering valuable recommendations for subsequent research and practical applications. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed models exhibit good feasibility and stability in geochemical missing value imputation and anomaly detection tasks. The mean squared error (MSE) for missing value imputation remains below 0.005, while the area under the curve for precision-recall (PR-AUC) for anomaly detection reaches 0.68, showing competitive performance over existing algorithms. Further tectonic discrimination experiments show that missing value imputation and anomaly detection have varying effects on different classification models. Specifically, missing value imputation is more effective in improving the classification performance of tree-based models, whereas anomaly detection has a more pronounced effect on models that are sensitive to anomalous samples, such as SVM.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 地球化学数据通常包含缺失值和异常值。在以构造判别为代表的研究中，地球化学数据的利用率通常仅为10%至20%甚至更低，这极大地限制了地球化学研究和学科发展。为解决这些问题，本文将构造环境扩展为涵盖大陆和海洋环境的七个类别。基于生成模型，本研究提出了一种具有多类型特征处理的缺失值填补模型和一种用于异常检测的自监督扩散时间估计模型。此外，本文探讨了不同模型的最优数据预处理策略，为后续研究和实际应用提供了有价值的建议。实验结果表明，所提出的模型在地球化学缺失值填补和异常检测任务中表现出良好的可行性和稳定性。缺失值填补的均方误差（MSE）保持在0.005以下，而异常检测的精确率-召回率曲线下面积（PR-AUC）达到0.68，显示出与现有算法相比具有竞争力的性能。进一步的构造判别实验表明，缺失值填补和异常检测对不同分类模型的影响各异。具体而言，缺失值填补在提高基于树的模型的分类性能方面更为有效，而异常检测对诸如SVM等对异常样本敏感的模型具有更显著的效果。

articles.title_en: Kinetic origins of Löwenstein's rule compliance during early-stage aluminosilicate nucleation: A reactive molecular dynamics study
articles.title_cn: 铝硅酸盐成核早期阶段洛文斯坦规则遵守的动力学起源：反应分子动力学研究
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd. All rights are reserved, including those for text and data mining, AI training, and similar technologies. Calcium aluminate silicate hydrate (C-A-S-H) nucleation critically influences the microstructural development of blended cementitious systems, yet the atomistic mechanisms by which Al modifies the earliest condensation stages remain poorly understood. Reactive force field molecular dynamics simulations are employed to investigate aluminosilicate cluster formation across Al/Si ratios of 0–0.30 and temperatures of 300–1000 K under high-supersaturation conditions representative of the spinodal regime. The computed activation energy for the pure silicate system (44 kJ/mol) is consistent with experimentally reported C-S-H condensation barriers (40–60 kJ/mol), validating the simulation framework. Al incorporation reduces this barrier to 15–37 kJ/mol, kinetically facilitating silicate condensation and promoting the formation of higher-connectivity aluminosilicate networks. A compositional crossover near Al/Si ≈ 0.15 marks the transition from Si-O-Al-dominated bridging to increasingly prevalent Al-O-Al linkage formation, comparison with a random-mixing baseline reveals that Al-O-Al bonds form at 5–6 times the statistically expected frequency, confirming kinetic trapping rather than random encounter as the origin of Löwenstein violations. Trajectory analysis further reveals that metastable Al-O-Al bonds reorganize into Löwenstein-compliant Si-O-Al linkages through ring-mediated rearrangement, providing an atomistic pathway for the emergence of Al avoidance in mature C-A-S-H structures. These findings provide a molecular-level kinetic complement for rationalizing Al/Si thresholds in the design of supplementary cementitious materials.

articles.title_en: Surgical correction of unilateral soft palate and faucial pillar dysplasia: A systematic review & case report
articles.abstract_en: BackgroundUnilateral soft palate and faucial pillar dysplasia is a rare anomaly distinct from typical cleft palate. ObjectiveAmong patients with these anatomic findings, this study aims to define the consistent diagnostic features, assess surgical techniques for repair and speech outcomes. MethodsA systematic review of PubMed and Embase was conducted using the PRISMA protocol. A descriptive synthesis on patient demographics, surgical interventions, and outcomes was performed. A select patient case treated at the authors’ institution is presented. ResultsFifteen studies comprising 32 patients were included. All patients had unilateral soft palate deficiency with either dysplastic or absent faucial pillars. Twenty-six patients underwent surgical correction at a mean age of 33 months. The most common technique included soft palate dissection plus the addition of an adjacent interpolated flap. Twenty patients experienced improved speech; however, outcome only 53% of patients had follow-up >12 months. Four of 26 (15%) required revision surgery. ConclusionUnilateral soft palate and faucial pillar dysplasia demands surgical techniques distinct from traditional cleft palate repair methods. Due to the hypoplasia of the unilateral velum and faucial pillars, the use of adjacent flaps may represent an important feature of successful surgical treatment.

articles.title_en: VP-MonoMF: Visual prompt guided monocular 3D object detection with multiscale fusion
articles.title_cn: VP-MonoMF：基于视觉提示引导的多尺度融合单目3D目标检测
articles.abstract_en: Depth estimation from a single image remains a challenging task in monocular 3D object detection. Existing methods improve the detection accuracy by leveraging more precise 2D and 3D information. However, they simultaneously train 2D and 3D detection branches, which inevitably affect each other. Meanwhile, they often overlook the adverse effects caused by variations in camera pose. Furthermore, although they achieve satisfactory detection accuracy on large objects, their accuracy on small objects remains limited due to limited pixel areas. To address these issues, we propose a Visual Prompt Guided Monocular 3D Object Detection Method with Multiscale Fusion (VP-MonoMF). Specifically, we first develop a Multi-Depth Fusion (MDF) module as the 3D detection branch, which integrates multi-scale information from both global depth maps and local 3D depth information. Then, we train MDF in the first stage and the 2D Detector in the second stage to mitigate mutual interference. To minimize the impact of the camera pose variance, MDF utilizes a 3D Depth Reconstruction (3DR) module to correct depth map deviations. Furthermore, we introduce a Visual Prompt Fusion (VPF) module to enhance small object features by adaptively adjusting weights based on object size. We conduct experiments on the KITTI dataset. VP-MonoMF achieves state-of-the-art performance in monocular 3D object detection task. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/HFUT-CV/VP-MonoMF.
articles.abstract_cn: 从单张图像进行深度估计在单目3D目标检测中仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务。现有方法通过利用更精确的2D和3D信息来提高检测精度。然而，它们同时训练2D和3D检测分支，这不可避免地会相互影响。同时，它们常常忽视相机姿态变化带来的不利影响。此外，尽管它们在大目标上取得了令人满意的检测精度，但由于像素区域有限，在小目标上的精度仍然受限。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种基于视觉提示引导的多尺度融合单目3D目标检测方法（VP-MonoMF）。具体来说，我们首先开发了一个多深度融合（MDF）模块作为3D检测分支，该模块整合了全局深度图和局部3D深度信息的多尺度信息。然后，我们在第一阶段训练MDF，在第二阶段训练2D检测器，以减轻相互干扰。为了最小化相机姿态变化的影响，MDF利用3D深度重建（3DR）模块来校正深度图偏差。此外，我们引入了一个视觉提示融合（VPF）模块，通过根据目标大小自适应调整权重来增强小目标特征。我们在KITTI数据集上进行了实验。VP-MonoMF在单目3D目标检测任务中达到了最先进的性能。代码可在https://github.com/HFUT-CV/VP-MonoMF公开获取。

articles.title_en: RFDPNet: Real-time frequency-aware detail prior network for underwater image enhancement
articles.title_cn: RFDPNet：用于水下图像增强的实时频率感知细节先验网络
articles.abstract_en: Underwater images encounter wavelength-dependent absorption and scattering, leading to severe color distortion, contrast degradation, and the loss of fine structural details. Most enhancement methods still face limitations in meeting real-time requirements and effectively exploiting frequency-aware detail cues for structural restoration. To address these challenges, we propose a real-time frequency-aware detail prior network (RFDPNet) for underwater image enhancement. Built upon an encoder-decoder architecture, RFDPNet introduces a frequency-guided upsampling module at the multi-scale fusion stage, where Sobel-derived high-frequency structural cues are used to effectively guide skip connections for fine-detail recovery. A spectral-spatial attention module is employed to adaptively correct inter-channel imbalance and enhance salient spatial features. The network is optimized using a channel-weighted gradient loss that assigns a higher weight to gradient discrepancies in the red channel to compensate for severe attenuation underwater. Extensive experiments on the LSUI, UIEB, and EUVP benchmark datasets demonstrate that RFDPNet achieves competitive enhancement performance while maintaining 117.6 FPS at 256 × 256 and 98.4 FPS at 720p on a single GPU.
articles.abstract_cn: 水下图像遭遇波长依赖的吸收和散射，导致严重的颜色失真、对比度下降以及精细结构细节的丢失。大多数增强方法在满足实时要求和有效利用频率感知细节线索进行结构恢复方面仍面临限制。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种用于水下图像增强的实时频率感知细节先验网络（RFDPNet）。基于编码器-解码器架构，RFDPNet在多尺度融合阶段引入了一个频率引导的上采样模块，其中使用Sobel派生的高频结构线索有效引导跳跃连接以恢复精细细节。采用光谱-空间注意力模块自适应校正通道间不平衡并增强显著空间特征。网络通过通道加权梯度损失进行优化，该损失为红色通道中的梯度差异分配更高权重，以补偿水下严重衰减。在LSUI、UIEB和EUVP基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，RFDPNet在单个GPU上实现了竞争性的增强性能，同时保持117.6 FPS在256×256分辨率和98.4 FPS在720p分辨率。

articles.title_en: Decoupled gradient-guided stratification for resource-efficient multi-modal data pruning
articles.title_cn: 解耦梯度引导分层用于资源高效的多模态数据剪枝
articles.abstract_en: Instruction finetuning of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) relies on massive datasets, hindering scalability and efficiency. Consequently, data pruning has emerged as a vital strategy to attain full-dataset performance using a minimal subset. However, existing methods often incur high computational overheads or suffer from performance collapse at high pruning rates. To address these challenges, we propose Decoupled Gradient-Guided Stratification (DGGS), a resource-efficient data pruning framework. Diverging from approaches that introduce additional computation via external proxy models, we natively repurpose the internal vision encoder to stratify data based on visual complexity, and employ the LLM module as a deterministic verifier to quantify the semantic density of each stratum. DGGS dynamically allocates the pruning budget to stratified regions where semantic importance outweighs visual complexity, filtering out visual noise. Empirically, DGGS operates with minimal additional memory overhead and achieves robust performance, retaining approximately 85% of full-dataset performance with 1% of the training data.
articles.abstract_cn: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的指令微调依赖于大规模数据集，阻碍了可扩展性和效率。因此，数据剪枝已成为一种关键策略，以使用最小子集实现全数据集性能。然而，现有方法往往产生高计算开销或在高剪枝率下性能崩溃。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了解耦梯度引导分层（DGGS），一种资源高效的数据剪枝框架。与通过外部代理模型引入额外计算的方法不同，我们原生地重新利用内部视觉编码器，基于视觉复杂度对数据进行分层，并采用LLM模块作为确定性验证器来量化每个分层的语义密度。DGGS动态地将剪枝预算分配给语义重要性超过视觉复杂度的分层区域，过滤视觉噪声。实验上，DGGS以最小的额外内存开销运行，并实现稳健性能，保留约85%的全数据集性能，仅使用1%的训练数据。

articles.title_en: Scarred by nature: How early exposure to natural disasters shapes risk attitudes
articles.title_cn: 自然的烙印：早期自然灾害暴露如何塑造风险态度
articles.abstract_en: Can early-life experiences shape long-term risk attitudes? This paper examines the relationship between exposure to natural disasters during early adulthood and individual risk preferences later in life. Using harmonized survey data linked to disaster records, we find that individuals exposed to natural disasters between the ages of 18 and 25 exhibit significantly greater risk aversion later in life. This relationship proves robust across a range of alternative specifications. We further explore the role of cultural transmission as a mechanism, showing that social connectedness moderates the observed behavioral shift. Our findings underscore the impressionable years as a critical window for the formation of individual preferences. The study offers new insights into how climate-related shocks are linked to long-lasting behavioral patterns, with implications for public policy, economic behavior, and climate adaptation.
articles.abstract_cn: 早期生活经历能否塑造长期风险态度？本文考察了成年早期遭受自然灾害与个体晚年风险偏好之间的关系。利用与灾害记录相连接的协调调查数据，我们发现，在18岁至25岁之间经历自然灾害的个体，在晚年表现出显著更高的风险厌恶程度。这一关系在多种替代规格下均保持稳健。我们进一步探讨了文化传递作为机制的作用，表明社会联系调节了观察到的行为转变。我们的发现强调了可塑性年龄阶段作为个体偏好形成的关键窗口。本研究为气候相关冲击如何与持久行为模式相关联提供了新见解，对公共政策、经济行为和气候适应具有启示意义。

articles.title_en: Oceanic Alkalinity and titration Alkalinity: a novel straightforward approach in keeping with common general chemistry
articles.title_cn: 海洋碱度与滴定碱度：一种符合普通化学常规的新颖直接方法
articles.abstract_en: We present exact concepts of Oceanic Alkalinity and Titration Alkalinity that are in keeping with common chemistry. Oceanic Alkalinity is the difference between the sum of charges of strong cations and the sum of charges of strong anions in seawater. This difference is compensated by the sum of charges of the weak anions minus the sum of charges of the weak cations. The Titration Alkalinity of a natural seawater sample is defined as the concentration of all bases able to accept a hydrogen ion at the equivalence point of the carbonic acid system. Ideally, acid titration of all weak ions would yield a value of total consumption of added hydrogen ions that then would equate perfectly with the net sum of the charges of the strong ions in Oceanic Alkalinity. However, some adjustments are necessary. At the equivalence endpoint of the titration, hydrogen ions have also been absorbed by small portions of the strong SO42− and F− anions. Additionally, at the endpoint several phosphate anions are not completely neutralized to H3PO4. Due to this non-ideal situation, there is an exact difference between Oceanic Alkalinity and Titration Alkalinity:AlkOceanic = AlkTitration + 1.021 [DIP] - 0.0003966 [SO42−] - 0.010457 [F−]or in terms of salinityAlkOceanic = AlkTitration + 1.021 [DIP] - 0.3409 Swhere DIP is total dissolved inorganic phosphorus. This exact difference in the order of 12 to 15 μmol kg−1 is highly significant versus the best feasible ∼1 μmol kg−1 precision of the titration. Finally, because the concentration of Dissolved Inorganic Carbon is determined independently by coulometry, there is no need for non-linear curve fitting of the complete acid titration curve. It suffices to only fit the second part of the titration curve to determine the second equivalence point, yielding a more straightforward, and in principle more precise, determination of Titration Alkalinity.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了与普通化学一致的海洋碱度和滴定碱度的精确概念。海洋碱度是海水中强阳离子电荷总和与强阴离子电荷总和之间的差值。该差值由弱阴离子电荷总和减去弱阳离子电荷总和来补偿。天然海水样品的滴定碱度定义为在碳酸系统等当点能够接受氢离子的所有碱的浓度。理想情况下，对所有弱离子的酸滴定将得到添加氢离子总消耗量的值，该值将与海洋碱度中强离子电荷的净总和完全相等。然而，需要进行一些调整。在滴定的等当终点，氢离子也被少量强SO42−和F−阴离子吸收。此外，在终点时，几种磷酸根阴离子并未完全中和为H3PO4。由于这种非理想情况，海洋碱度与滴定碱度之间存在精确差异：Alk海洋 = Alk滴定 + 1.021 [DIP] - 0.0003966 [SO42−] - 0.010457 [F−]或以盐度表示Alk海洋 = Alk滴定 + 1.021 [DIP] - 0.3409 S其中DIP为总溶解无机磷。这一精确差异在12至15 μmol kg−1量级，相对于滴定最佳可行的约1 μmol kg−1精度而言非常显著。最后，由于溶解无机碳浓度通过库仑法独立测定，无需对完整酸滴定曲线进行非线性曲线拟合。只需拟合滴定曲线的第二部分以确定第二等当点，从而更直接且原则上更精确地测定滴定碱度。

articles.title_en: Sleep disturbances in children with allergic rhinitis: Associations with rhinitis control and treatment response
articles.title_cn: 过敏性鼻炎儿童的睡眠障碍：与鼻炎控制及治疗反应的相关性
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. Introduction: Allergic rhinitis (AR), a common pediatric condition, is an established contributor to impaired sleep and sleep-disordered breathing. However, data on the relative impact of disease severity versus control on sleep remain limited. We aimed to investigate the associations between AR severity, disease control, and treatment response and sleep quality in Turkish children. Methods: In this prospective study, 65 children aged 4-15 years with AR and 67 age-matched healthy controls were evaluated. Sleep quality, AR control, and AR severity were assessed using the Children's Sleep Habits Questionnaire (CSHQ), the Rhinoconjunctivitis Control Assessment Test (RCAT), and its Impact on Asthma (ARIA) guidelines, respectively. CSHQ scores were compared according to AR severity and control status and evaluated before and after three months of treatment. Results: Mean CSHQ scores were higher in the AR group than in controls (53.7 ± 8.7 vs. 47.5 ± 8.0, p < 0.001). AR was associated with disturbances in several CSHQ subdomains, including difficulty waking, fragmented sleep, sleep-disordered breathing, and parasomnias. CSHQ scores did not differ across AR severity categories (p = 0.216) but showed an inverse correlation with RCAT scores (r = −0.40, p = 0.001). Among 46 treated patients, sleep quality improved after therapy, particularly in the sleep fragmentation and sleep anxiety domains, with no significant difference between montelukast monotherapy and combined montelukast plus antihistamine therapy. Conclusion: In children with AR, sleep impairment is more closely related to rhinitis control than to symptom-based severity. Optimizing disease control, rather than focusing solely on severity, appears crucial for improving sleep and related functional outcomes.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. 引言：过敏性鼻炎（AR）是一种常见的儿科疾病，已被证实是导致睡眠受损和睡眠呼吸障碍的因素之一。然而，关于疾病严重程度与控制对睡眠相对影响的数据仍然有限。我们旨在调查土耳其儿童中AR严重程度、疾病控制及治疗反应与睡眠质量之间的关联。方法：在这项前瞻性研究中，评估了65名年龄在4-15岁患有AR的儿童和67名年龄匹配的健康对照者。分别使用儿童睡眠习惯问卷（CSHQ）、鼻结膜炎控制评估测试（RCAT）及其对哮喘的影响（ARIA）指南评估睡眠质量、AR控制和AR严重程度。根据AR严重程度和控制状态比较CSHQ评分，并在治疗三个月前后进行评估。结果：AR组的平均CSHQ评分高于对照组（53.7 ± 8.7 对比 47.5 ± 8.0，p < 0.001）。AR与多个CSHQ子域中的障碍相关，包括醒来困难、睡眠碎片化、睡眠呼吸障碍和异态睡眠。CSHQ评分在不同AR严重程度类别之间没有差异（p = 0.216），但与RCAT评分呈负相关（r = −0.40，p = 0.001）。在46名接受治疗的患者中，治疗后睡眠质量有所改善，特别是在睡眠碎片化和睡眠焦虑领域，孟鲁司特单药治疗与孟鲁司特联合抗组胺药治疗之间没有显著差异。结论：在患有AR的儿童中，睡眠障碍与鼻炎控制的关系比与基于症状的严重程度更为密切。优化疾病控制，而非仅关注严重程度，对于改善睡眠及相关功能结局至关重要。

articles.title_en: Parental awareness of childhood hearing loss, risk factors and communication milestones following newborn hearing screening
articles.title_cn: 新生儿听力筛查后父母对儿童听力损失、风险因素及沟通里程碑的认知
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 The Authors Background: The prevalence of childhood hearing loss doubles from newborn period to school age. Parental concern and developmental checklists are often used to flag potential hearing loss after newborn screening, but parental concern alone is a poor indicator. This study explored parental awareness of childhood hearing loss, communication milestones, and risk factors, and particularly whether this knowledge was gained during the newborn period. Methods: A digital survey was anonymously completed by parents of children under 2 years old living in Sweden. Results: While 98% of parents were aware of the impact of hearing loss on language development, only 56% recalled receiving information about early detection during newborn screening. Most parents (70%) believed a child could still have hearing loss despite passing the screening. This belief was less common among parents with lower education or who did not speak Swedish at home. Parents often underestimated the age at which children reach communication milestones, and 74% reported not considering hearing loss when their child failed to respond to a direction. Conclusions: Parents demonstrated high overall awareness of childhood hearing loss. However, whether information was provided during newborn screening was inconsistent. The limited sensitivity of parental concern in detecting hearing loss may not stem from a lack of knowledge, but rather from the fact that parents often do not consider hearing loss as a possible explanation when their child does not respond in everyday situations.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 作者 背景：儿童听力损失的患病率从新生儿期到学龄期翻倍。父母担忧和发育检查表常用于在新生儿筛查后标记潜在的听力损失，但仅凭父母担忧是一个较差的指标。本研究探讨了父母对儿童听力损失、沟通里程碑和风险因素的认知，特别是这些知识是否在新生儿期获得。方法：一项数字调查由居住在瑞典的2岁以下儿童的父母匿名完成。结果：虽然98%的父母意识到听力损失对语言发展的影响，但只有56%的人记得在新生儿筛查期间收到过早期检测的信息。大多数父母（70%）认为即使通过了筛查，孩子仍可能有听力损失。这一信念在受教育程度较低或在家不说瑞典语的父母中较少见。父母常常低估孩子达到沟通里程碑的年龄，74%的人报告当孩子未能响应指令时未考虑听力损失。结论：父母对儿童听力损失的整体认知水平较高。然而，新生儿筛查期间是否提供信息并不一致。父母担忧在检测听力损失方面的有限敏感性可能并非源于缺乏知识，而是因为父母在日常生活中孩子不响应时往往不将听力损失视为可能的解释。

articles.title_en: LSBR-pkd: A lightweight model for student behavior recognition via co-optimization of pruning and knowledge distillation
articles.title_cn: LSBR-pkd：一种通过剪枝与知识蒸馏协同优化的轻量级学生行为识别模型
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. The application of artificial intelligence in smart education has shown remarkable potential, highlighting the need to optimize neural network models for efficient deployment on edge devices. In this paper, we propose a lightweight dual-backbone model for student behavior recognition, which is based on the collaborative optimization of pruning and knowledge distillation (LSBR-pkd). We optimize the model architecture using lightweight modules, including an enhanced downsampling operation, an Efficient Group Convolution Head (EGCHead), and an improved feature extraction module, thereby achieving a favorable balance between model efficiency and accuracy. Building on this lightweight foundation, we combine structured pruning with knowledge distillation, leveraging their complementary advantages to compress the model while improving its recognition accuracy. Experimental results on the SCB-Dataset3-S demonstrate that LSBR-pkd reduces the parameter count and computational complexity to 27.7% and 55.4% of the baseline, respectively, while F1-score and mAP improved by 0.8-1.0%. The model exhibits superior comprehensive performance, fully meeting the deployment requirements of resource-constrained edge devices in smart classrooms.

articles.title_en: Cash transfers and time use within the household: an analysis of the effect of <ce:italic>Familias en Acción</ce:italic>

articles.abstract_en: © 2026 The Authors Conditional cash transfers (CCTs) have been found to have several benefits, particularly with respect to educational outcomes of targeted children. However, concerns have also been raised that CCTs may further push women into traditional gender norms, as they make mothers responsible for ensuring that their children meet the conditionalities and that their family receives the transfer.
