articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 作者 有条件现金转移（CCT）已被发现具有多项益处，尤其是在目标儿童的教育成果方面。然而，也有人担忧CCT可能进一步将女性推向传统性别规范，因为该计划使母亲负责确保其子女满足条件要求以及家庭获得转移支付。我们分析了哥伦比亚2020-21年的时间使用数据，发现CCT“家庭行动”计划增加了母亲分配给家务劳动的时间，特别是当她们有6-14岁子女时。这一模式并非源于儿童与母亲家务劳动之间的替代，而是揭示了现金转移使女性在疫情期间能够减少劳动力参与——但她们的时间随后被重新分配至更多家务劳动，遵循了传统规范。

articles.title_en: Mapping mineralization-related geochemical patterns using self-organizing maps and SHAP interpretation in the Nanling belt, China
articles.title_cn: 利用自组织映射和SHAP解释绘制南岭成矿带矿化相关地球化学模式
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Mineralization anomaly identification is a crucial aspect of mineral exploration. Stream sediment geochemical data from the Nanling belt are characterized by high dimensionality, nonlinearity, and spatial heterogeneity, posing challenges for traditional anomaly detection methods (e.g., principal component analysis) that rely on linear assumptions or subjective parameter selection. This study presents an integrated SOM framework that combines k-means clustering analysis and SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) method for mineralization-related geochemical anomaly identification and feature interpretability analysis. The SOM model effectively processed high-dimensional geochemical data by combining cluster analysis and component plane analysis, and two distinctive element combinations were identified. The first consists of U–Y–La–Th–Be–Na–Nb–Zr–Ba–Al 2 O 3 that reflects granite-related ore-forming system, especially for radioactive metal (e.g., U and Th) and rare earth elements (REE, e.g., Y and La) mineralization. The second is composed of W–Sn–Bi–Ag–Mo–As–Cd–Cu–F–Pb–Zn that mainly reflects tungsten polymetallic mineralization. Based on the supervised classifier trained on binary labels derived from the SOM clustering results, the SHAP method quantified the contribution of each element within the two element combinations, providing an interpretable framework that highlights the significant contributions of Th and U to the granite mineralization system in the first element combination, and W, Bi, and Sn as central to tungsten polymetallic mineralization in the second element combination. The model performance was evaluated with known ore deposits as the ground truth labels by using the Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) curve analysis, showing that the AUC values for SOM models related to REE mineralization and tungsten polymetallic mineralization were 0.839 and 0.842, respectively. Compared to existing models applied in the Nanling region, such as uniform manifold approximation and projection model, the constructed SOM model demonstrates superior adaptability to high-dimensional nonlinear geochemical data and better preservation of spatial topological relationships. This integrated framework offers a transferable and interpretable approach for geochemical anomaly identification, providing a methodological reference for mineral prospectivity mapping in comparable metallogenic regions.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 矿化异常识别是矿产勘探的关键方面。南岭地区的河流沉积物地球化学数据具有高维性、非线性和空间异质性，这给依赖线性假设或主观参数选择的传统异常检测方法（如主成分分析）带来了挑战。本研究提出了一个集成的SOM框架，结合k-means聚类分析和SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP)方法，用于矿化相关地球化学异常识别和特征可解释性分析。SOM模型通过结合聚类分析和分量平面分析有效处理了高维地球化学数据，并识别出两个独特的元素组合。第一个组合由U–Y–La–Th–Be–Na–Nb–Zr–Ba–Al 2 O 3组成，反映了与花岗岩相关的成矿系统，特别是放射性金属（如U和Th）和稀土元素（REE，如Y和La）的矿化。第二个组合由W–Sn–Bi–Ag–Mo–As–Cd–Cu–F–Pb–Zn组成，主要反映钨多金属矿化。基于从SOM聚类结果中获得的二元标签训练的有监督分类器，SHAP方法量化了每个元素在两个元素组合中的贡献，提供了一个可解释的框架，突出了Th和U在第一个元素组合中对花岗岩成矿系统的重要贡献，以及W、Bi和Sn在第二个元素组合中对钨多金属矿化的核心作用。使用已知矿床作为真实标签，通过接收者操作特征（ROC）曲线分析评估模型性能，结果显示与REE矿化和钨多金属矿化相关的SOM模型的AUC值分别为0.839和0.842。与南岭地区应用的现有模型（如均匀流形逼近和投影模型）相比，所构建的SOM模型表现出对高维非线性地球化学数据的更优适应性，并更好地保留了空间拓扑关系。该集成框架为地球化学异常识别提供了一种可转移且可解释的方法，为类似成矿区的矿产远景填图提供了方法论参考。

articles.title_en: Transport and transformation of dissolved inorganic carbon from cave systems to a surface watershed: a case study from Jiguan Cave and the Yi River headwater, central China
articles.title_cn: 洞穴系统向地表流域溶解无机碳的输移与转化：以中国中部鸡冠洞和伊河源头为例
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd The transport and transformation of dissolved inorganic carbon (DIC) from cave systems to surface waters remain insufficiently constrained in karst watersheds. This study combines 13 years of monitoring data from Jiguan Cave (2010–2022) with watershed sampling from the Yi River headwater in 2022 to examine DIC and δ 13 C DIC variations along a pathway from the cave system to the river and reservoir. The results show that: (1) From 2010 to 2022, local normalized difference vegetation index (NDVI) increased from 0.36 to 0.42, while DIC in LYXS drip water increased from 5.85 to 7.4 mmol/L and δ 13 C DIC shifted from −13.40‰ to −14.52‰. These changes are consistent with a possible increase in the influence of soil-derived carbon along the LYXS pathway. In contrast, pool waters and the underground river did not show comparable long-term DIC increases, reflecting spatially heterogeneous DIC behavior within the cave system. This heterogeneity may be related to differences in water storage, residence time, mixing, fracture-flow pathways, and hydrological connectivity. Extreme climate events were also associated with DIC variability, with DIC peaking in years with high precipitation (2010, 2011, 2017, 2021) and a delayed decline after the 2013 drought. (2) SIc results show that drip and pool waters were commonly supersaturated with respect to calcite, consistent with a thermodynamic tendency for CO 2 degassing and/or calcite precipitation. In contrast, the underground river was generally closer to undersaturation, consistent with its potential role as a pathway for exporting DIC associated with soil CO 2 input and carbonate dissolution. (3) The Jiguan Cave underground river provides a hydrological and geochemical input to the Shilonggou River (SLGR), which subsequently joins the YR. Along the flow path (underground river, SLGR, and YR), downstream δ 13 C DIC enrichment was observed and is consistent with the combined effects of mixing, CO 2 degassing, and potential aquatic biological uptake. Specifically, in the rainy season, δ 13 C DIC progressively increased from the underground outlet (−20.99‰) to the SLGR (−19.48‰) and the YR (−15.88‰). At the SLGR-YR confluence in July, a DIC-constrained two-endmember calculation predicted a conservative-mixing δ 13 C DIC value of −21.75‰ at YR2, whereas the measured value was −13.87‰. The 7.88‰ enrichment indicates that conservative mixing alone cannot explain the measured downstream δ 13 C DIC value. In contrast, higher DIC and more enriched δ 13 C DIC during the dry season likely reflect longer water-rock interaction and stronger groundwater contribution. (4) In Jinniuling Reservoir, stratification sampling in July showed enriched δ 13 C DIC in surface water (−13.93‰) relative to deep water (−19.76‰), with slightly lower surface DIC. This vertical pattern is consistent with biological and/or physical modification of the reservoir DIC pool. Whether these processes contribute to long-term carbon retention requires direct measurements of aquatic productivity and sedimentary carbon burial. The hydrochemically estimated inorganic carbon export ranged from approximately 1.27 × 10 4 to 1.41 × 10 4 t CO 2 /yr. This estimated inorganic carbon export represents hydrochemical DIC transport rather than a net carbon sink. These results provide site-specific evidence that soil- and cave-derived DIC is transported to surface waters and subsequently modified by hydrological, geochemical, and biological processes.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd 岩溶流域中溶解无机碳（DIC）从洞穴系统向地表水的输移和转化仍缺乏充分约束。本研究结合鸡冠洞 13 年的监测数据（2010-2022）以及 2022 年伊河源头的流域采样，考察了从洞穴系统到河流和水库路径上DIC和δ 13 C DIC的变化。结果表明：(1) 从 2010 年到 2022 年，局部归一化植被指数（NDVI）从 0.36 增加到 0.42，而LYXS滴水中的DIC从 5.85 增加到 7.4 mmol/L，δ 13 C DIC从 −13.40‰ 转变为 −14.52‰。这些变化与沿LYXS路径土壤来源碳影响可能增强相一致。相比之下，池水和地下河未显示出类似的长期DIC增加，反映了洞穴系统内DIC行为的空间异质性。这种异质性可能与储水量、滞留时间、混合、裂隙流路径和水文连通性的差异有关。极端气候事件也与DIC变率相关，在高降水年份（2010、2011、2017、2021）DIC达到峰值，并在 2013 年干旱后出现延迟下降。(2) SIc结果表明，滴水和池水通常对方解石过饱和，这与CO 2 脱气和/或方解石沉淀的热力学趋势一致。相比之下，地下河通常更接近不饱和状态，这与其作为输出与土壤CO 2 输入和碳酸盐溶解相关的DIC的潜在路径作用一致。(3) 鸡冠洞地下河为石龙沟河（SLGR）提供了水文和地球化学输入，随后汇入伊河（YR）。沿流动路径（地下河、SLGR和YR），下游δ 13 C DIC富集被观察到，这与混合、CO 2 脱气和潜在水生生物吸收的综合效应一致。具体而言，在雨季，δ 13 C DIC从地下出口（−20.99‰）到SLGR（−19.48‰）和YR（−15.88‰）逐渐增加。在七月SLGR-YR交汇处，DIC约束的双端元计算预测了在 YR2 处保守混合δ 13 C DIC值为 −21.75‰，而实测值为 −13.87‰。7.88‰ 的富集表明，仅保守混合无法解释实测的下游δ 13 C DIC值。相比之下，旱季较高的DIC和更富集的δ 13 C DIC可能反映了更长的水-岩相互作用和更强的地下水贡献。(4) 在金牛岭水库，七月的分层采样显示表层水δ 13 C DIC（−13.93‰）相对于深层水（−19.76‰）富集，且表层DIC略低。这种垂直模式与水库DIC库的生物和/或物理改造一致。这些过程是否有助于长期碳封存需要直接测量水生生产力和沉积碳埋藏。水文化学估算的无机碳输出范围约为 1.27 × 10 4 到 1.41 × 10 4 t CO 2 /年。这一估算的无机碳输出代表水文化学DIC输移，而非净碳汇。这些结果提供了场地特定证据，表明土壤和洞穴来源的DIC被输移到地表水，并随后受到水文、地球化学和生物过程的改造。

articles.title_en: Diagnosing RAG vulnerabilities via sensitive knowledge recognition
articles.title_cn: 通过敏感知识识别诊断RAG漏洞
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems enhance the factual accuracy of Large Language Models (LLMs) by integrating external knowledge bases. However, certain knowledge within these bases may be incorrectly retrieved by RAG, thereby disrupting subsequent processes. Through analysis, we identify two patterns of sensitive knowledge, both refer to top-ranked yet irrelevant knowledge retrieved by the system that may induce LLMs to output hallucinations. Unlike poisoned knowledge from adversarial attacks, sensitive knowledge is legitimate. We propose Robustness and Availability Assessment via Internal Sensitive Knowledge Profiling (RAISP) framework to analyzes sensitive knowledge and its impact on RAG’s robustness and availability. Specifically, RAISP identifies sensitive knowledge and classifies it into two distinct patterns, establishing dedicated detection thresholds for each; it also simulates retrieval offset to investigate how RAG robustness affects retrieval outcomes and analyzes the influence of sensitive knowledge within the knowledge base on LLM outputs.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. 检索增强生成（RAG）系统通过整合外部知识库来增强大型语言模型（LLM）的事实准确性。然而，这些知识库中的某些知识可能被RAG错误检索，从而干扰后续过程。通过分析，我们识别出两种敏感知识模式，均指系统检索到的排名靠前但无关的知识，可能诱导LLM产生幻觉输出。与对抗性攻击中的有毒知识不同，敏感知识是合法的。我们提出了基于内部敏感知识画像的鲁棒性与可用性评估（RAISP）框架，以分析敏感知识及其对RAG鲁棒性和可用性的影响。具体而言，RAISP识别敏感知识并将其分类为两种不同模式，为每种模式建立专门的检测阈值；同时，它模拟检索偏移以研究RAG鲁棒性如何影响检索结果，并分析知识库中敏感知识对LLM输出的影响。

articles.title_en: Experimental simulations and regional estimates of mercury emissions from fire-affected Cerrado soils (Central Brazil)
articles.title_cn: 受火灾影响的塞拉多土壤（巴西中部）汞排放的实验模拟与区域估算
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 The Authors Wildfires are increasingly recognized as drivers of mercury (Hg) mobilization in tropical ecosystems, yet their effects on soil biogeochemistry across Cerrado vegetation formations remain poorly constrained. This study evaluated total mercury (THg) stocks, soil composition, and fire-induced Hg losses in forest, savanna, and grassland soils from the Águas Emendadas Ecological Station (ESECAE), central Brazil. Laboratory heating experiments simulated low (200 °C), intermediate (350 °C), and high (500 °C) fire intensities, combined with elemental and mineralogical characterization and regional emission estimates based on burned area data. Forest soils exhibited significantly higher THg concentrations, organic carbon content, and C/N ratios than savanna and grassland soils, reflecting stronger Hg association with organic matter and reduced ultraviolet radiation exposure. Simulated burning resulted in substantial Hg mobilization, with losses exceeding 70% even at low intensity and reaching near-total depletion at moderate and high temperatures. Mercury emission factors were consistently highest in forest soils (3.85 ± 0.74 g Hg ha −1 ), compared to savanna (2.47 ± 0.46 g Hg ha −1 ) and grassland formations (1.2 ± 0.59 g Hg ha −1 ). Regional scaling indicated that fires mobilized up to 173 kg of Hg in the Federal District (Capital of Brazil) over the last decade. Alterations in organic matter quantity and quality closely paralleled Hg release, highlighting the central role of soil carbon in regulating Hg stability during combustion. While major-element concentrations remained stable, mineralogical transformations were pronounced, indicating secondary controls on Hg retention.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 作者 野火日益被认为是热带生态系统中汞（Hg）迁移的驱动因素，但其对塞拉多植被类型下土壤生物地球化学的影响仍知之甚少。本研究评估了巴西中部阿瓜斯埃门达达斯生态站（ESECAE）森林、稀树草原和草地土壤中的总汞（THg）储量、土壤组成及火灾引起的汞损失。实验室加热实验模拟了低（200 °C）、中（350 °C）和高（500 °C）火灾强度，并结合元素和矿物学表征以及基于过火面积数据的区域排放估算。森林土壤的THg浓度、有机碳含量和碳氮比显著高于稀树草原和草地土壤，反映出汞与有机质的更强关联以及紫外线辐射暴露的减少。模拟燃烧导致大量汞迁移，即使在低强度下损失也超过70%，在中温和高温下几乎完全耗尽。森林土壤的汞排放因子始终最高（3.85 ± 0.74 克汞公顷−1），其次是稀树草原（2.47 ± 0.46 克汞公顷−1）和草地（1.2 ± 0.59 克汞公顷−1）。区域尺度估算表明，过去十年中，联邦区（巴西首都）的火灾迁移了多达173千克的汞。有机质数量和质量的改变与汞释放密切相关，凸显了土壤碳在燃烧过程中调节汞稳定性的核心作用。虽然主要元素浓度保持稳定，但矿物学转变显著，表明存在对汞保留的次要控制因素。

articles.title_en: SigConvNeXt: An improved lightweight ConvNeXt for offline signature verification
articles.title_cn: SigConvNeXt：一种改进的轻量级ConvNeXt用于离线签名验证
articles.abstract_en: Offline signature verification is a key biometric technology with broad applications in finance, law, and document authentication. Existing feature extraction methods, primarily convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and vision transformers (ViTs), often suffer from incomplete multi-scale feature capture, limited cross-dataset generalization, and high computational complexity. To address these challenges, this paper proposes SigConvNeXt, a lightweight offline signature verification model based on ConvNeXt V2-Tiny integrated into a Siamese network for end-to-end contrastive learning. We introduce two novel modules: an Attention Refinement Module (ARM) that enhances focus on discriminative signature regions via channel and spatial attention, suppressing background noise; and a Multiscale Bidirectional Fusion Module (MSBFM) that integrates multi-granularity features through bottom-up and top-down interactions, capturing both global structural semantics and local stroke details. Experiments on CEDAR, BHSig-B, and BHSig-H datasets demonstrate competitive performance, achieving EERs of 0.00%±0.00%, 8.74%±0.24%, and 8.48%±0.88%, respectively, with only 32M parameters, fewer than comparable baselines. Ablation studies confirm the effectiveness of ARM and MSBFM, while cross-dataset evaluation highlights strong generalization across languages.
articles.abstract_cn: 离线签名验证是一种关键的生物识别技术，在金融、法律和文档认证中具有广泛应用。现有的特征提取方法，主要是卷积神经网络（CNNs）和视觉变换器（ViTs），常常存在多尺度特征捕获不完整、跨数据集泛化能力有限以及计算复杂度高的问题。为解决这些挑战，本文提出了SigConvNeXt，一种基于ConvNeXt V2-Tiny的轻量级离线签名验证模型，集成到孪生网络中进行端到端对比学习。我们引入了两个新颖模块：注意力精炼模块（ARM），通过通道和空间注意力增强对判别性签名区域的关注，抑制背景噪声；以及多尺度双向融合模块（MSBFM），通过自下而上和自上而下的交互整合多粒度特征，捕获全局结构语义和局部笔画细节。在CEDAR、BHSig-B和BHSig-H数据集上的实验展示了竞争性能，分别实现了0.00%±0.00%、8.74%±0.24%和8.48%±0.88%的等错误率（EERs），仅使用32M参数，少于可比基线。消融研究证实了ARM和MSBFM的有效性，而跨数据集评估则突显了跨语言的强泛化能力。

articles.title_en: Deep CO<ce:inf loc=post>2</ce:inf> and heat transport by basal springs across the Tyrrhenian–Apennine transition zone (central–southern Italy)
articles.title_cn: 第勒尼安-亚平宁过渡带（意大利中部-南部）的深层 CO<ce:inf loc=post>2</ce:inf> 和底泉的热量传输
articles.abstract_en: Natural CO2 degassing through carbonate aquifers represents a major component of the geological carbon cycling in tectonically active regions, even if a robust database of global quantification is still lacking in literature. Although the central-southern Apennines are recognized as one of the main non-volcanic degassing zones in the Mediterranean area, the magnitude of deep CO2 and heat transfer through high-discharge cold springs remains largely underestimated. The aim is to quantify the amount of deep-derived CO2 and associated thermal fluxes transported by large karst aquifers between the Simbruini-Ernici-Cairo-Venafro carbonate basins and the Aurunci chain, through an integrated hydrogeochemical and isotopic approach. Major ion chemistry, stable isotopes δ13C of total dissolved inorganic carbon and δ18O, were combined with thermodynamic modelling, carbon mass balance, and energy balance calculations to constrain gas–water–rock interactions and isolate deep carbon contributions. Results showed that cold and hypothermal springs transport ∼505 tons/d of deep-derived C, with δ13C values (up to ∼0‰) highlighting a dominant mantle and/or deep-crustal origin. Energy balance reveals groundwater temperature increases of 1–2 °C and a cumulative thermal energy of ∼77.85 (MW). These findings demonstrate that carbonate aquifers act as efficient pathways for deep carbon and heat, contributing to regional carbon budgets at levels comparable to persistently degassing volcanic systems. The study highlights the role of groundwater-mediated CO2 transport as a key, and often overlooked, process in continental geological carbon cycling.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管文献中仍然缺乏可靠的全球量化数据库，但通过碳酸盐含水层的自然CO2脱气代表了构造活跃地区地质碳循环的主要组成部分。尽管亚平宁山脉中南部被认为是地中海地区主要的非火山排气区之一，但深层CO2和通过高流量冷泉进行的传热的程度仍然被大大低估。目的是通过综合水文地球化学和同位素方法，量化 Simbruini-Ernici-Cairo-Venafro 碳酸盐盆地和 Aurunci 链之间大型岩溶含水层输送的深层 CO2 量和相关热通量。主要离子化学、总溶解无机碳的稳定同位素 δ13C 和 δ18O，与热力学建模、碳质量平衡和能量平衡计算相结合，以限制气-水-岩石相互作用并隔离深层碳贡献。结果表明，冷泉和低温泉每天输送~505吨深部来源的碳，δ13C值（高达~0‰）突出了主要的地幔和/或深部地壳起源。能量平衡显示地下水温度增加了 1-2 °C，累积热能 ~77.85 (MW)。这些发现表明，碳酸盐含水层是深层碳和热量的有效途径，对区域碳预算的贡献与持续脱气的火山系统相当。该研究强调了地下水介导的CO2运输作为大陆地质碳循环中一个关键但经常被忽视的过程的作用。

articles.title_en: Concrete printing with textile reinforcement: Approaches, classification, and testing
articles.title_cn: 纺织增强混凝土打印：方法、分类与测试
articles.abstract_en: The integration of reinforcement remains a key challenge in 3D concrete printing (3DCP) and continues to limit its structural application. Existing approaches are largely based on metallic reinforcement or discrete fibers and are not fully compatible with the geometric flexibility and process characteristics of additive manufacturing. Textile reinforcement, consisting of continuous fiber-based yarns arranged in two- or three-dimensional architectures, offers a promising alternative due to its flexibility, high tensile strength, and corrosion resistance.This paper presents a comprehensive review and proposes a process-based classification framework for the integration of textile reinforcement into 3DCP. Building on the RILEM taxonomy for digital fabrication with concrete, integration strategies are systematically categorized according to their position within the manufacturing sequence, distinguishing between single-step processes during concrete shaping and two-step processes before or after shaping. The framework is used to analyze existing approaches and to relate them to reinforcement configurations, bond mechanisms, and resulting mechanical performance. Particular attention is given to testing methodologies and the specific challenges associated with additively manufactured textile-reinforced concrete. The study highlights key limitations, particularly with respect to bond, anisotropy, and process constraints, and provides guidance for the development of structurally efficient and scalable 3D-printed systems.
articles.abstract_cn: 增强材料的整合仍然是3D混凝土打印（3DCP）中的关键挑战，并继续限制其结构应用。现有方法主要基于金属增强材料或离散纤维，与增材制造的几何灵活性和工艺特性不完全兼容。纺织增强材料由连续纤维基纱线以二维或三维结构排列而成，因其柔韧性、高抗拉强度和耐腐蚀性，提供了一种有前景的替代方案。本文进行了全面综述，并提出了一个基于过程的分类框架，用于将纺织增强材料整合到3DCP中。基于RILEM关于混凝土数字制造的分类法，整合策略根据其在制造序列中的位置进行系统分类，区分为混凝土成型过程中的单步过程和成型前或成型后的两步过程。该框架用于分析现有方法，并将其与增强配置、粘结机制和由此产生的力学性能相关联。特别关注测试方法以及与增材制造纺织增强混凝土相关的特定挑战。研究强调了关键局限性，特别是在粘结、各向异性和工艺约束方面，并为开发结构高效且可扩展的3D打印系统提供了指导。

articles.title_en: Risk of post-tonsillectomy hemorrhage in pediatric patients with recent influenza or COVID-19 infection
articles.title_cn: 近期感染流感或COVID-19的儿科患者扁桃体切除术后出血风险
articles.abstract_en: IntroductionPostoperative hemorrhage is a significant complication of tonsillectomy with or without adenoidectomy. This retrospective cohort study evaluates whether COVID-19 or influenza infection within defined preoperative intervals increases hemorrhage risk in patients under 18 years of age. MethodsUsing the TriNetX database, we identified pediatric patients who underwent tonsillectomy with or without adenoidectomy and had documented COVID-19 or influenza infection within six, three, or one month before surgery. Cohorts included patients with COVID-19 only, influenza only, and a control group with neither infection. Propensity score matching was performed. Risk ratios (RR) and 95% confidence intervals (CI) for postoperative hemorrhage were calculated for postoperative days 0–1, 2–5, and 6–10. ResultsInfluenza infection within six, three, or one month before surgery was not associated with an increased risk of postoperative hemorrhage at any time point. COVID-19 infection was associated with a significantly increased risk of secondary hemorrhage (postoperative days 2–5 and 6–10) across all preoperative intervals. No increase in primary hemorrhage (postoperative days 0–1) was observed with COVID-19 at any interval. ConclusionPediatric patients with a COVID-19 infection within six, three, or one month prior to tonsillectomy with or without adenoidectomy are at increased risk of secondary postoperative hemorrhage. Recent influenza infection does not confer increased risk of either primary or secondary hemorrhage. Clinicians should counsel families regarding the elevated risk associated with recent COVID-19 and consider additional perioperative precautions in affected patients.
articles.abstract_cn: 引言：术后出血是扁桃体切除术（伴或不伴腺样体切除术）的重要并发症。这项回顾性队列研究评估了在术前特定时间间隔内感染COVID-19或流感是否增加18岁以下患者的出血风险。方法：利用TriNetX数据库，我们确定了接受扁桃体切除术（伴或不伴腺样体切除术）且在术前六、三或一个月内有记录的COVID-19或流感感染的儿科患者。队列包括仅感染COVID-19的患者、仅感染流感的患者以及未感染这两种疾病的对照组。进行了倾向性评分匹配。计算了术后第0-1天、第2-5天和第6-10天术后出血的风险比（RR）和95%置信区间（CI）。结果：术前六、三或一个月内的流感感染在任何时间点均未与术后出血风险增加相关。COVID-19感染在所有术前时间间隔内均与继发性出血（术后第2-5天和第6-10天）风险显著增加相关。在任何时间间隔内，未观察到COVID-19感染与原发性出血（术后第0-1天）增加相关。结论：在扁桃体切除术（伴或不伴腺样体切除术）前六、三或一个月内感染COVID-19的儿科患者，其术后继发性出血风险增加。近期流感感染不增加原发性或继发性出血风险。临床医生应就近期COVID-19感染相关的升高风险向家属提供咨询，并考虑对受影响患者采取额外的围手术期预防措施。

articles.title_en: Effect of the temperature on the degradation of dissolved organic matter originated from different land use – an incubation experiment
articles.title_cn: 温度对不同土地利用来源溶解性有机质降解的影响——一项培养实验
articles.abstract_en: The DOM cycle in terrestrial ecosystems is of particular interest in light of climate change, as DOM is one of the largest sources of available organic carbon for microorganisms and also has numerous other ecological functions. Therefore, this study investigated the effects of temperature on the composition, transformation, and decomposition of soil dissolved organic matter (DOM) originated from different land use areas (grassland, spruce, oak, arable) in a temperate region of Hungary using a 45-day laboratory incubation experiment. The chemical composition of DOM was evaluated using PARAFAC modelling, and the changes occurring during incubation were evaluated using two-dimensional correlation spectroscopy (2D COS). Significant differences were found in the chemical composition of DOM fractions in soils with different land uses. The PARAFAC model showed that although the relative amount of the low molecular weight compounds was similar in all four soils, the DOM fraction of arable soil also contained a large amount of the C2 component (high molecular weight, aromatic compounds). In contrast, the C5 component, identified as aromatic proteins/soluble microbial product (AP/SMP), was the smallest in the DOM fraction of arable soil. According to the 2D COS analysis, biogeochemical coupling was detected as negative correlations in the synchronous spectra, with correlations between the ∼320-258, 320-278, 385-258, and 350-280 nm regions at both temperatures indicating biogeochemical coupling between low molecular weight and higher molecular weight compounds. The decomposition of spruce soil DOM differed significantly for incubation at 25 and 35 °C: at the higher temperature, DOM shifted towards organic compounds with lower molecular weights than those observed at the lower temperature.
articles.abstract_cn: 在气候变化背景下，陆地生态系统中的溶解性有机质（DOM）循环备受关注，因为DOM是微生物可利用有机碳的最大来源之一，并且还具有许多其他生态功能。因此，本研究通过一项为期45天的实验室培养实验，调查了温度对匈牙利温带地区不同土地利用区域（草地、云杉、橡树、耕地）土壤溶解性有机质（DOM）组成、转化和分解的影响。使用PARAFAC模型评估DOM的化学组成，并使用二维相关光谱（2D COS）评估培养过程中发生的变化。不同土地利用土壤中DOM组分的化学组成存在显著差异。PARAFAC模型显示，尽管四种土壤中低分子量化合物的相对含量相似，但耕地土壤的DOM组分还含有大量的C2组分（高分子量、芳香族化合物）。相比之下，被鉴定为芳香族蛋白质/可溶性微生物产物（AP/SMP）的C5组分在耕地土壤的DOM组分中含量最少。根据2D COS分析，同步光谱中检测到生物地球化学耦合呈负相关，在两种温度下，约320-258、320-278、385-258和350-280 nm区域之间的相关性表明低分子量化合物与较高分子量化合物之间存在生物地球化学耦合。云杉土壤DOM的分解在25和35°C培养条件下存在显著差异：在较高温度下，DOM向分子量低于较低温度下观察到的有机化合物转变。

articles.title_en: Mercury pollution remediation in paddy fields with biochar amendment
articles.title_cn: 生物炭改良对稻田汞污染修复的研究
articles.abstract_en: Mercury (Hg) contamination in rice fields poses significant health risks to local populations. Conventional remediation methods are often costly, limiting widespread field application. Biochar amendment, noted for its cost-effectiveness and environmental compatibility, has been widely used to remediate heavy metal-contaminated paddy soils. However, its effectiveness and underlying mechanism in controlling Hg pollution remains unclear. In this study, field and laboratory experiments were carried out to evaluate the potential of biochar amendment in mitigating Hg accumulation in rice grains. The results indicated that total mercury (THg) concentrations in rice grains in the treatment group reduced to below the national limit (GB 2762-2022), methylmercury (MeHg) concentrations rice grain reduced 21% compared to the control group. Furthermore, the ratio of bioavailable THg to soil THg decreased by 51.4%, and the ratio of THg in rice grains to soil THg decreased by 32% in the treatment group compared to the control group. Additionally, biochar addition led to a 10.2% increase in rice grain yield. Transmission electron microscopy (TEM) analysis demonstrated biochar's ability to adsorb THg in paddy soil, while Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR) analysis revealed that functional groups such as hydroxyl, carboxyl, amide, and S-containing groups on the biochar surface could form complexes with Hg. Laboratory adsorption simulations revealed that biochar reached adsorption equilibrium within 30 min, achieving its highest adsorption capacity (9.75 mg/g) at pH = 4. These findings demonstrated the efficacy of biochar amendments in remediating Hg contaminated paddy soils, offering a promising strategy for farmland safety use.
articles.abstract_cn: 稻田中的汞（Hg）污染对当地居民构成显著的健康风险。传统的修复方法往往成本高昂，限制了其在大规模田间应用中的推广。生物炭改良因其成本效益和环境兼容性而被广泛用于修复重金属污染的稻田土壤。然而，其在控制汞污染方面的有效性及潜在机制仍不清楚。本研究通过田间和实验室实验评估了生物炭改良在减少稻谷中汞积累方面的潜力。结果表明，处理组稻谷中的总汞（THg）浓度降至国家限量标准（GB 2762-2022）以下，与对照组相比，稻谷中甲基汞（MeHg）浓度降低了21%。此外，与对照组相比，处理组中生物可利用THg与土壤THg的比例降低了51.4%，稻谷中THg与土壤THg的比例降低了32%。另外，添加生物炭使稻谷产量增加了10.2%。透射电子显微镜（TEM）分析表明，生物炭能够吸附稻田土壤中的THg，而傅里叶变换红外光谱（FTIR）分析揭示，生物炭表面的羟基、羧基、酰胺基和含硫基团等功能团能与Hg形成络合物。实验室吸附模拟显示，生物炭在30分钟内达到吸附平衡，在pH=4时达到最大吸附容量（9.75 mg/g）。这些发现证明了生物炭改良在修复汞污染稻田土壤方面的有效性，为农田安全利用提供了一种有前景的策略。

articles.title_en: Source-oriented ecological and human health risk assessment of potentially toxic elements in surface soils of the Chengdu Basin using APCS-MLR and Monte Carlo simulation
articles.title_cn: 基于APCS-MLR和蒙特卡洛模拟的成都盆地表层土壤潜在有毒元素源导向生态与人体健康风险评估
articles.abstract_en: In alluvial-proluvial basin soils, inherited geochemical backgrounds and modern anthropogenic inputs commonly overlap, making it difficult to infer ecological and human health risks from concentration-based source apportionment alone. To address this issue, this study developed a dual-background, source-oriented probabilistic risk framework to identify source-specific ecological and human health risk priorities of potentially toxic elements (PTEs). Using 3061 surface soil samples and 832 deep soil samples from the Chengdu Basin, southwestern China, we evaluated As, Cd, Cr, Cu, Hg, Ni, Pb and Zn by integrating APCS-MLR source apportionment, an UNMIX-principle-based source-structure consistency assessment, Monte Carlo probabilistic risk assessment and source-oriented risk apportionment.Five source groups were identified: a natural geogenic source, an agricultural nutrient-related source, a mixed anthropogenic source, an atmospheric Hg source and a U–As geochemical background source. Source-oriented risk apportionment showed that ecological and human health risks were characterized by different risk-controlling elements and source categories. Although the agricultural nutrient-related source dominated the closed concentration contribution matrix, ecological risk was amplified mainly by the Hg and Cd fractions assigned to the agricultural nutrient-related and atmospheric Hg sources. Under the deep local background scenario, the median and 95th percentile of the potential ecological risk index (RI) were 139.05 and 307.12, respectively, and the probability of RI≥300 was 5.72%, indicating generally low to moderate ecological risk with a localized high-risk upper tail.Human health risk was controlled by different element-source combinations. Mean hazard index (HI) values for adults and children were 0.0851 and 0.2717, respectively, whereas the probabilities of total carcinogenic risk (TCR) > 1 × 10^-4 were 12.86% and 3.38%. Unlike ecological risk, health risk was driven mainly by Cr and Ni from the natural geogenic source, with secondary contributions from as in the U–As geochemical background source and Pb in the mixed anthropogenic source. These findings indicate that ecological and human health risk priorities differed in controlling elements, source categories and risk-weighting pathways, rather than being governed by distinct geochemical mechanisms alone. The dual-background and source-oriented probabilistic framework can therefore support differentiated ecological risk management and human health risk prevention in regions affected by both pedogenic inheritance and diffuse anthropogenic inputs.
articles.abstract_cn: 在冲洪积盆地土壤中，继承的地球化学背景与现代人为输入通常重叠，使得仅基于浓度的源解析难以推断生态和人体健康风险。为解决这一问题，本研究开发了一个双背景、源导向的概率风险框架，以识别潜在有毒元素（PTEs）的源特异性生态和人体健康风险优先级。利用成都盆地（中国西南部）的3061个表层土壤样品和832个深层土壤样品，通过整合APCS-MLR源解析、基于UNMIX原理的源结构一致性评估、蒙特卡洛概率风险评估和源导向风险分配，评估了As、Cd、Cr、Cu、Hg、Ni、Pb和Zn。识别出五个源组：自然地质源、农业养分相关源、混合人为源、大气Hg源和U–As地球化学背景源。源导向风险分配表明，生态和人体健康风险具有不同的风险控制元素和源类别。尽管农业养分相关源主导了封闭的浓度贡献矩阵，但生态风险主要由分配给农业养分相关源和大气Hg源的Hg和Cd组分放大。在深层局部背景情景下，潜在生态风险指数（RI）的中位数和第95百分位数分别为139.05和307.12，RI≥300的概率为5.72%，表明总体生态风险为低至中等，并具有局部高风险的尾部。人体健康风险由不同的元素-源组合控制。成人和儿童的平均危害指数（HI）值分别为0.0851和0.2717，而总致癌风险（TCR）> 1 × 10^-4的概率分别为12.86%和3.38%。与生态风险不同，健康风险主要由自然地质源中的Cr和Ni驱动，其次为U–As地球化学背景源中的As和混合人为源中的Pb。这些发现表明，生态和人体健康风险的优先级在控制元素、源类别和风险加权路径上存在差异，而非仅受不同地球化学机制支配。因此，双背景和源导向的概率框架可以支持受成土继承和扩散性人为输入影响的区域进行差异化的生态风险管理和人体健康风险预防。

articles.title_en: Apportioning groundwater sources in El-Gallaba Plain, Southwestern Desert, Egypt: A stable isotopes mixing model approach
articles.title_cn: 埃及西南沙漠埃尔加拉巴平原地下水来源的分配：稳定同位素混合模型方法
articles.abstract_en: Arid graben basins commonly host groundwater systems in which deep paleo-groundwater and younger surface-derived recharge interact through fault-controlled pathways, producing complex hydrochemical and isotopic signatures. El-Gallaba Plain, in West Kom Ombo City, Aswan Governorate, Egypt, in northeastern Africa, is a representative example of such a system and relies on groundwater as the main source of freshwater for agriculture and domestic use. This study investigates the relationship between the Quaternary aquifer and adjacent water sources, including the Nubian Aquifer (NA) and surface water (N + LN), using hydrochemical modeling, isotope analysis, and isotopic source apportionment. Piper and Gibbs diagrams indicate that Na–Cl, Ca–Mg–Cl, and Na–SO4 facies dominate, and that water–rock interaction is the main control on groundwater chemistry. PHREEQC results show that the Quaternary waters contain dissolved salts such as NaCl, Mg(HCO3)2, Na2SO4, NaHCO3, and Ca(HCO3)2, produced mainly by leaching and cation exchange. The TDS–δ18O relationship identifies three distinct water groups. Bayesian stable isotope mixing modeling (SIMMR) suggests that about 53% of recharge derives from mixed Nubian Aquifer water, with the remainder linked to surface water. These results show that groundwater evolution in El-Gallaba Plain is controlled by interaction between ancient regional groundwater and modern recharge through structurally connected pathways, offering a framework relevant to similar arid graben basins.
articles.abstract_cn: 干旱地堑盆地通常蕴藏地下水系统，其中深层古地下水与较年轻的表层补给通过断层控制的路径相互作用，产生复杂的水化学和同位素特征。埃及阿斯旺省西科姆翁博市的埃尔加拉巴平原是此类系统的典型代表，其依赖地下水作为农业和家庭用水的主要淡水来源。本研究利用水化学模拟、同位素分析和同位素来源分配，探讨了第四纪含水层与邻近水源（包括努比亚含水层（NA）和地表水（N + LN））之间的关系。Piper图和Gibbs图表明，Na–Cl、Ca–Mg–Cl和Na–SO4水化学类型占主导，水-岩相互作用是地下水化学的主要控制因素。PHREEQC结果表明，第四纪水体含有溶解盐类，如NaCl、Mg(HCO3)2、Na2SO4、NaHCO3和Ca(HCO3)2，主要由淋滤和阳离子交换产生。TDS–δ18O关系识别出三个不同的水组。贝叶斯稳定同位素混合模型（SIMMR）表明，约53%的补给来自混合的努比亚含水层水，其余与地表水相关。这些结果表明，埃尔加拉巴平原的地下水演化受古老区域地下水与现代补给通过构造连通路径的相互作用控制，为类似干旱地堑盆地提供了相关框架。

articles.title_en: Bridging the semantic gap for zero-shot object counting with language-augmented pseudo-exemplars
articles.title_cn: 弥合零样本目标计数中的语义鸿沟：语言增强的伪示例方法
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. Zero-shot Object Counting (ZSC) aims to estimate the number of objects in novel categories solely based on class names, without requiring any annotated examples. Although recent advances in vision-language models, such as CLIP, have significantly improved performance, existing approaches still suffer from a persistent semantic gap between global text embeddings and local visual representations, leading to biased or inconsistent counting in complex scenes. This discrepancy often results from the inability of coarse text features to capture fine-grained visual distinctions and contextual nuances. To address these limitations, we propose Language-augmented Pseudo-exemplars (LAPE), a novel and comprehensive ZSC framework that performs both coarse- and fine-grained cross-modal alignment through a unified and trainable architecture. Specifically, we first leverage a large language model to enrich textual semantics, generating diverse and context-aware descriptions that extend beyond simple class names. The query image features and these enhanced text features are then aligned across modalities. Subsequently, a sparse semantic projection mechanism maps the global text embedding onto a compact set of the most relevant visual features, synthesizing language-augmented pseudo-exemplar representations. These pseudo-exemplars, together with the enriched textual features, jointly guide a density regression head for precise spatial distribution estimation, effectively suppressing background noise and enhancing focus on discriminative regions. Extensive experiments on FSC-147 and cross-dataset benchmarks demonstrate that our approach substantially strengthens text-vision alignment and achieves state-of-the-art counting accuracy, showcasing strong generalization capability to unseen categories even in complex scenarios. Code is available at https://github.com/WJWu20/LAPE .

articles.title_en: Mineralogy and geochemistry of beach sediments in the Gulf of Mexico and Mexican Pacific: Implication for provenance
articles.title_cn: 墨西哥湾和墨西哥太平洋海滩沉积物的矿物学与地球化学：对物源的意义
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 The Authors This study assesses the geochemical characteristics and provenance of sediments from four beaches in the Gulf of Mexico (Barra Norte and Mocambo) and Mexican Pacific coast (Puerto Chiapas and Acapulco). Major, trace, and rare earth element (REE) concentrations with textural parameters were analysed to identify the sediment provenance and its associated geodynamic processes. Grain-size analysis revealed marked textural differences, with the domination of coarse-grained sediments in Acapulco, medium-grained sediments in Puerto Chiapas, and fine-grained sediments in Mocambo and Barra Norte beaches. Quartz dominates the mineral assemblages in all beaches, although Puerto Chiapas and Mocambo sediments contain higher proportions of mafic minerals, Acapulco and Barra Norte exhibit predominantly of felsic assemblages. Major-element geochemistry reveals strong compositional contrasts among three beaches. Puerto Chiapas sediments are enriched in Fe 2 O 3 , MgO, Cr, V, and Ni, indicating intermediate to mafic provenance, whereas Acapulco sediments exhibit high SiO 2 contents (84.6-87.4 wt %), consistent with felsic and compositionally mature sedimentary sources. In contrast, Barra Norte and Mocambo sediments are characterized by elevated CaO contents associated with carbonate input, as well as felsic and intermediate source rocks. The chondrite-normalized REE patterns show LREE enrichment in all samples. CIA and PIA values indicate overall low chemical weathering in the three beaches, with slightly higher alteration in Puerto Chiapas (CIA and PIA ≈ 57) compared to Acapulco, Mocambo, and Barra Norte beaches (CIA and PIA ≈ 41-49), reflecting the preservation of relatively unaltered feldspars. Elemental ratios like Al 2 O 3 /TiO 2 , Cr and Ni contents, and the size of the Eu anomaly suggest a felsic source for the Acapulco, and Barra Norte sediments, whereas Mocambo and Puerto Chiapas sediments reflect intermediate provenance with minor mafic contributions. The geoaccumulation index (I geo ) and enrichment factor (EF) indicate that the beach sediments are practically uncontaminated (I geo < 0; EF < 2), except a moderate enrichment is observed for Co, Zn, and V in some Puerto Chiapas samples, collected near to the seaport. Principal Component Analysis (PCA) results indicate that major and trace elements variability is partly controlled by grain-size and heavy-minerals, while REE distributions are independent of grain size. The results of this study further indicate a diverse provenance, with contributions from mafic to intermediate source rocks for the Puerto Chiapas and Mocambo, and predominantly felsic source rocks for the Acapulco and Barra Norte beaches. These findings demonstrate that sediment geochemistry along the Mexican coastal areas is primarily controlled by source-rock lithology, regional tectonic setting, and hydrodynamic sorting.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 作者。本研究评估了墨西哥湾（巴拉诺特和莫坎博）和墨西哥太平洋沿岸（恰帕斯港和阿卡普尔科）四个海滩沉积物的地球化学特征和物源。分析了主量、微量元素和稀土元素（REE）浓度以及粒度参数，以确定沉积物物源及其相关的地球动力学过程。粒度分析揭示了显著的粒度差异，阿卡普尔科以粗粒沉积物为主，恰帕斯港以中粒沉积物为主，而莫坎博和巴拉诺特海滩以细粒沉积物为主。所有海滩的矿物组合中石英占主导，尽管恰帕斯港和莫坎博沉积物含有较高比例的铁镁质矿物，阿卡普尔科和巴拉诺特则主要显示长英质组合。主量元素地球化学揭示了三个海滩之间的强烈成分对比。恰帕斯港沉积物富含Fe 2 O 3、MgO、Cr、V和Ni，表明中基性物源，而阿卡普尔科沉积物显示高SiO 2含量（84.6-87.4 wt%），与长英质和成分成熟的沉积源一致。相比之下，巴拉诺特和莫坎博沉积物的特征是CaO含量升高，与碳酸盐输入以及长英质和中酸性源岩相关。球粒陨石标准化REE模式显示所有样品中轻稀土富集。CIA和PIA值表明三个海滩总体化学风化程度较低，恰帕斯港的蚀变程度略高（CIA和PIA ≈ 57），而阿卡普尔科、莫坎博和巴拉诺特海滩（CIA和PIA ≈ 41-49），反映了相对未蚀变长石的保存。元素比值如Al 2 O 3 /TiO 2、Cr和Ni含量以及Eu异常大小表明阿卡普尔科和巴拉诺特沉积物为长英质来源，而莫坎博和恰帕斯港沉积物反映中酸性物源并伴有少量基性贡献。地质累积指数（I geo）和富集因子（EF）表明海滩沉积物实际上未受污染（I geo < 0；EF < 2），除了在靠近港口的恰帕斯港部分样品中观察到Co、Zn和V的中等富集。主成分分析（PCA）结果表明，主量和微量元素的变化部分受粒度和重矿物控制，而REE分布与粒度无关。本研究结果进一步表明物源多样，恰帕斯港和莫坎博有基性至中酸性源岩的贡献，而阿卡普尔科和巴拉诺特海滩主要为长英质源岩。这些发现表明，墨西哥沿海地区的沉积物地球化学主要受源岩岩性、区域构造背景和水动力分选控制。

articles.title_en: Online rheological perception of fresh cementitious material toward intelligent construction: An energy transfer analysis approach
articles.title_cn: 面向智能建造的新拌胶凝材料流变学在线感知：一种能量传递分析方法
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd. All rights are reserved, including those for text and data mining, AI training, and similar technologies. Existing rheological testing methods for cementitious materials are either straightforward but information-limited or complex and time-consuming, making them inadequate for intelligent construction. This study proposes an energy-transfer analysis approach based on gravity-wave characteristics, enabling rapid rheological identification via non-contact optical sensing. Gravity waves were generated by impacting a rod on cement paste at ten hydration ages (15–150 min), and the resulting surface height variations were precisely measured using a laser profiler. Energy transfer efficiency (ETE) and wave slope (WS) were extracted to quantify wave energy conversion and calibrated against rotational rheometer measurements using the Modified Bingham (MB) and Herschel-Bulkley (HB) models. ETE and WS showed strong correlations with rheological parameters and captured their hydration-dependent evolution. The established identification model achieved accuracies of 94.3 ± 0.7% and 82.0 ± 4.1% for MB and HB models, respectively. Uncertainty propagation further demonstrated the greater robustness of MB-based identification, with a much narrower 95% bootstrap CI than HB-based identification. Energy dissipation physics were found to be consistent with the exponential attenuation of macroscopic waves. This sampling-free method provides theoretical support for online real-time rheological monitoring of cementitious materials.

articles.title_en: Integration of automated experiment and domain adaptation for precise evaluation of cement dispersant performance
articles.title_cn: 自动化实验与域自适应的集成用于水泥分散剂性能的精确评估
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd. All rights are reserved, including those for text and data mining, AI training, and similar technologies. Evaluating the rheological performance of modern concrete requires large datasets due to the diversity of mixture compositions and the inherent variability of cementitious materials. Our previous study introduced automated experimentation for high-throughput rheological measurement of cement-based materials. In this study, the system is extended to enable reliable estimation of Bingham parameters by integrating domain adaptation. A total of 100 mortar samples with systematically varied mix proportions were tested using the proposed framework. The resulting large, high-quality dataset, combined with machine learning, enables accurate estimation of Bingham parameters that are consistent with the measured torque response. Shapley additive explanations further confirm the proposed approach provides physically reasonable Bingham parameter estimates. The proposed system demonstrates its applicability to PCE performance evaluation, detection of subtle variations in rheological behavior, and quantitative assessment toward rheological standardization. Through this work, an automated experimentation platform for rheological characterization of cement-based materials has been completed, establishing a methodological transition toward data-centric concrete rheology.

articles.title_en: Adenoid hypertrophy is associated with poorer outcomes of acute mastoiditis in children
articles.title_cn: 腺样体肥大与儿童急性乳突炎预后较差相关
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Introduction: Acute mastoiditis is one of the most common complication of acute otitis media, and its clinical course may vary significantly among patients. Objective: To investigate the association between adenoid size and the severity of acute mastoiditis in children. Methods: This retrospective cohort study included children (<18 years) hospitalized with acute mastoiditis. The primary outcome was the association between disease severity—defined by the presence of intracranial complications or PICU admission - and the adenoid-to-nasopharyngeal ratio (ANR), measured on CT scans at three nasopharyngeal levels. Secondary outcomes included length of hospital stay, differences in bacterial profiles, and incidence of subsequent ear infections. Results: A total of 106 children (64 males [60.3%], mean age 3.03 years [IQR: 1–3.9]) were included in the analysis, of whom 32 (30.2%) were classified as having severe disease. Patients with severe mastoiditis were younger, had higher CRP levels, a longer duration of fever before presentation, underwent mastoidectomy more frequently, and had longer hospital stays (all p < 0.05). The ANR was significantly higher in patients with severe disease (0.6 vs. 0.4, p = 0.01). In multivariable logistic regression, both younger age (aOR, 2.26; 95% CI, 1.90–4.70; p = 0.05) and higher ANR (aOR, 1.30; 95% CI, 1.10–1.60; p = 0.03) were independently associated with severe mastoiditis. Bacterial profiles did not differ significantly, but severe cases had more subsequent ear infections (42.5% vs. 21.3%, p = 0.019). Conclusions: Higher ANR was associated with increased severity of acute mastoiditis in children. Further studies should explore whether early detection and treatment of adenoid hypertrophy can improve outcomes. Level of evidence: 4.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 引言：急性乳突炎是急性中耳炎最常见的并发症之一，其临床病程在不同患者间可能存在显著差异。目的：探讨腺样体大小与儿童急性乳突炎严重程度之间的关联。方法：本回顾性队列研究纳入因急性乳突炎住院的儿童（<18岁）。主要结局为疾病严重程度（定义为存在颅内并发症或入住PICU）与腺样体-鼻咽比值（ANR）之间的关联，该比值在CT扫描的三个鼻咽层面测量。次要结局包括住院时间、细菌谱差异以及后续耳部感染的发生率。结果：分析共纳入106名儿童（64名男性 [60.3%]，平均年龄3.03岁 [IQR: 1-3.9]），其中32名（30.2%）被归类为重症。重症乳突炎患者年龄更小、CRP水平更高、就诊前发热持续时间更长、更常接受乳突切除术，且住院时间更长（所有p < 0.05）。重症患者的ANR显著更高（0.6 vs. 0.4，p = 0.01）。在多变量逻辑回归中，年龄较小（aOR，2.26；95% CI，1.90-4.70；p = 0.05）和ANR较高（aOR，1.30；95% CI，1.10-1.60；p = 0.03）均与重症乳突炎独立相关。细菌谱无显著差异，但重症病例后续耳部感染更多（42.5% vs. 21.3%，p = 0.019）。结论：较高的ANR与儿童急性乳突炎严重程度增加相关。进一步研究应探讨早期发现和治疗腺样体肥大是否能改善预后。证据等级：4。

articles.title_en: Vestibular Infant Screening – Rehabilitation: A pilot study assessing preliminary effectiveness and feasibility of vestibular rehabilitation therapy in children with peripheral vestibular dysfunction
articles.title_cn: 前庭婴儿筛查——康复：一项评估外周前庭功能障碍儿童前庭康复治疗初步有效性和可行性的试点研究
articles.abstract_en: ObjectivesThis pilot study aims to evaluate the preliminary effects and feasibility of the Vestibular Infant Screening – Rehabilitation (VIS-REHAB) protocol, a structured Vestibular Rehabilitation Therapy (VRT) program combining postural and gaze stability exercises, in children with peripheral vestibular dysfunction. MethodsFour children (aged 4-14 years) with peripheral vestibular dysfunction were recruited from the Ghent University Hospital and enrolled in a two-parallel-group randomized controlled crossover trial comparing the VIS-REHAB protocol with a no-therapy control. The VIS-REHAB protocol consisted of structured exercises targeting postural (20 min) and gaze stability (10 min), delivered in 30-min sessions twice weekly over nine weeks. Primary and secondary outcome measures included postural stability, gaze stability, motor performance, and quality of life. Descriptive analyses were conducted for each participant. ResultsAll participants demonstrated improvements in the postural (Bruininks-Oseretsky Test of Motor Proficiency (BOT-2) Balance Subtest) and gaze stability (Gaze Stabilization Test) during therapy, while changes during the no-therapy period were more variable and generally less pronounced. Among the secondary outcomes, improvements were observed in the Pediatric Modified Dynamic Gait Index, BOT-2 Bilateral Coordination Subtest, and Dynamic Visual Acuity Test. Children and caregivers reported better balance, a perceived reduction in falls, and increased participation in daily life. The protocol was feasible and well-tolerated, though some age-related limitations were noted. ConclusionsThe protocol is feasible and may improve postural and gaze stability in children with peripheral vestibular dysfunction. A larger trial is planned to confirm these findings. This research presents an important first step towards developing evidence-based guidelines for pediatric VRT.
articles.abstract_cn: 目的本试点研究旨在评估前庭婴儿筛查——康复（VIS-REHAB）方案的初步效果和可行性，该方案是一种结合姿势和凝视稳定性练习的结构化前庭康复治疗（VRT）项目，适用于外周前庭功能障碍儿童。方法从根特大学医院招募了四名外周前庭功能障碍儿童（年龄4-14岁），并纳入一项双平行组随机对照交叉试验，比较VIS-REHAB方案与无治疗对照组。VIS-REHAB方案包括针对姿势（20分钟）和凝视稳定性（10分钟）的结构化练习，以30分钟为一节，每周两次，持续九周。主要和次要结局指标包括姿势稳定性、凝视稳定性、运动表现和生活质量。对每位参与者进行了描述性分析。结果所有参与者在治疗期间均表现出姿势（Bruininks-Oseretsky运动熟练度测试（BOT-2）平衡子测试）和凝视稳定性（凝视稳定测试）的改善，而无治疗期间的变化更为多变且通常不太明显。在次要结局中，观察到儿科改良动态步态指数、BOT-2双侧协调子测试和动态视觉 acuity 测试的改善。儿童和照护者报告平衡能力更好，感觉跌倒减少，日常生活参与度增加。该方案可行且耐受性良好，但注意到一些与年龄相关的限制。结论该方案可行，可能改善外周前庭功能障碍儿童的姿势和凝视稳定性。计划进行更大规模的试验以确认这些发现。这项研究是为制定儿科VRT循证指南迈出的重要第一步。

articles.title_en: Effect of different cochlear implantation timings on long-term language development outcomes of pediatric unilateral cochlear implant cases
articles.title_cn: 不同人工耳蜗植入时机对儿童单侧人工耳蜗植入者长期语言发育结果的影响
articles.abstract_en: IntroductionCochlear implantation provides an opportunity for children with congenital severe to profound hearing loss to acquire spoken language. However, as multiple factors influence language outcomes after cochlear implantation, language development performance can vary between individuals. Materials and methodsThe study participants (n = 150) were divided into three groups according to age at cochlear implantation: Group 1, 12–24 months; Group 2, 25–36 months; and Group 3, 37–48 months. The effect of age at implantation on auditory perception and language development performance was compared between these groups. The participants were also classified into five groups according to duration of cochlear implant use: Group 1, ≤48 months; Group 2, 49–72 months; Group 3, 73–96 months; Group 4, 97–120 months; and Group 5, ≥120 months. The effect of cochlear implant use duration on auditory perception and language development performance was compared between these groups. ResultsA statistically significant weak negative correlation was found between age at cochlear implantation and scores on Glendonald Auditory Screening Procedure (GASP) and Preschool Language Scales Fifth (PLS-5; p < 0.05). A statistically significant weak negative correlation was observed between age at cochlear implantation and Speech Intelligibility Rating (SIR), speech discrimination tests, and pure-tone thresholds (p < 0.05). Scores obtained from the GASP, Categories of Auditory Performance (CAP) and SIR, and the PLS-5 tests differed significantly across groups defined by chronological age at implantation (p < 0.05). Scores on the GASP, CAP, SIR, PLS-5, speech recognition threshold, and speech discrimination tests differed significantly according to the classification by cochlear implant experience (p < 0.05). ConclusionThe timing of cochlear implantation, together with individual differences, appears to impact long-term language development in children. To increase the chance that children using cochlear implants will achieve language development comparable to their normal-hearing peers, early implantation is important. Additionally, bilateral cochlear implantation, increased number of auditory–verbal therapy sessions, and long-term language intervention are critical. Children who undergo delayed cochlear implantation in particular require more intensive auditory–verbal therapy services.
articles.abstract_cn: 引言人工耳蜗植入为患有先天性重度至极重度听力损失的儿童提供了获得口语的机会。然而，由于多种因素影响人工耳蜗植入后的语言结果，个体间的语言发育表现可能存在差异。材料与方法研究参与者（n = 150）根据人工耳蜗植入时的年龄分为三组：第1组，12-24个月；第2组，25-36个月；第三组，37-48个月。比较了这些组之间植入年龄对听觉感知和语言发育表现的影响。参与者还根据人工耳蜗使用时间分为五组：第1组，≤48个月；第2组，49-72个月；第3组，73-96个月；第4组，97-120个月；第5组，≥120个月。比较了这些组之间人工耳蜗使用时间对听觉感知和语言发育表现的影响。结果人工耳蜗植入年龄与格伦多纳德听觉筛查程序（GASP）和学前语言量表第五版（PLS-5）得分之间存在统计学上显著的弱负相关（p < 0.05）。人工耳蜗植入年龄与言语清晰度评级（SIR）、言语辨别测试和纯音阈值之间存在统计学上显著的弱负相关（p < 0.05）。按植入时实足年龄划分的各组在GASP、听觉行为分级（CAP）、SIR和PLS-5测试中的得分存在显著差异（p < 0.05）。按人工耳蜗使用经验分类，GASP、CAP、SIR、PLS-5、言语识别阈值和言语辨别测试的得分存在显著差异（p < 0.05）。结论人工耳蜗植入的时机，连同个体差异，似乎影响儿童的长期语言发育。为了增加使用人工耳蜗的儿童实现与正常听力同龄人相当的语言发育的机会，早期植入很重要。此外，双侧人工耳蜗植入、增加听觉-言语治疗次数和长期语言干预至关重要。特别是接受延迟人工耳蜗植入的儿童需要更密集的听觉-言语治疗服务。

articles.title_en: Transoral excision of pediatric submandibular gland pleomorphic adenoma: A single-center case series
articles.abstract_en: IntroductionSubmandibular gland pleomorphic adenoma is rare in children, and data regarding the optimal surgical approach remain limited. This study evaluated the feasibility, perioperative outcomes, and postoperative complications of transoral submandibular gland excision for pediatric pleomorphic adenoma. MethodsA retrospective review was conducted of pediatric patients who underwent transoral excision of submandibular gland pleomorphic adenoma between January 2023 and December 2024. Patients aged 18 years or younger with histopathologically confirmed pleomorphic adenoma treated via a transoral approach were included. Demographic characteristics, tumor size, operative time, length of hospital stay, postoperative complications, cosmetic satisfaction, and recurrence were analyzed. ResultsSixteen patients were included. The mean age was 11.6 ± 2.8 years, and the mean tumor diameter was 2.4 ± 0.6 cm. All patients underwent successful transoral excision without conversion to a transcervical approach. The mean operative time was 42.6 ± 11.6 min, and the mean length of hospital stay was 4.5 ± 1.2 days. The mean cosmetic satisfaction score was 9.1 ± 0.6 at 3 months postoperatively. Transient lingual nerve dysfunction occurred in five patients and resolved spontaneously in all cases. One patient developed a postoperative abscess, and one experienced transient limitation of tongue movement; both resolved without long-term sequelae. No permanent lingual, hypoglossal, or marginal mandibular nerve dysfunction, hematoma, residual gland tissue, or local recurrence was observed. ConclusionTransoral submandibular gland excision may be a feasible, safe, and cosmetically favorable approach for carefully selected pediatric patients with pleomorphic adenoma. Careful patient selection, meticulous surgical technique, and long-term follow-up remain essential.

articles.title_en: Efficacy and safety of press-needle therapy for allergic rhinitis in children: A systematic review and meta-analysis
articles.abstract_en: AimsThis systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to evaluate the efficacy and safety of press-needle therapy for allergic rhinitis in children. MethodsWe comprehensively searched for relevant randomized controlled trials (RCTs) on press-needle therapy for pediatric AR. After strict screening of literature, data extraction and assessment of methodological quality, meta-analysis was performed using appropriate statistical methods. A random-effects model was adopted to synthesize the results, considering differences in follow-up duration and intervention period among included studies. Pre-specified further analyses were conducted for the primary outcome to compare press-needle plus medication vs medication alone, press-needle alone vs medication alone, and press-needle plus medication vs press-needle alone. The primary and secondary outcome measures included clinical efficacy, symptom and sign score, Visual Analogue Scale (VAS) score, Total Nasal Symptom Score (TNSS), Pediatric Rhinoconjunctivitis Quality of Life Questionnaire (PRQLQ) score, Eosinophil Ratio (EOSR), serum immunoglobulin E (IgE) levels, adverse drug reactions (ADRs) and recurrence rate. Results24 RCTs with 1625 participants were included. Press-needle therapy significantly improved clinical efficacy (OR = 3.75, 95 CI: 2.59-5.42; I2 = 0%). Further analysis showed that press-needle plus medication was superior to medication alone (OR = 4.60, 95% CI: 3.08-6.86), whereas press-needle monotherapy did not show a significant advantage over medication alone. Significant reductions were observed in VAS (SMD = −1.30), TNSS (SMD = −0.74), PRQLQ (SMD = −1.16), and serum IgE (SMD = −2.06; based on only 3 studies, I2 = 96%, interpret with caution). No significant differences were found in symptom and sign score, EOSR, or ADRs. Recurrence rate was significantly lower in the intervention group (OR = 0.37, 95% CI: 0.23–0.61). ConclusionPress-needle therapy, primarily as an adjunct to pharmacotherapy, may be a well-tolerated and potentially effective option for pediatric AR, improving clinical response, symptoms, quality of life, and recurrence without increasing adverse events. Evidence for press-needle monotherapy and for immunological outcomes (IgE, EOSR) remains limited. Multi-center, three-arm RCTs with standardized protocols and long-term follow-up are needed to isolate its independent effect. Systematic review registrationThe protocols for this meta-analysis were registered in the International Prospective Register of Systematic Reviews (PROSPERO, https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420261307545.)

articles.title_en: Reducing referral-to-consultation delays in pediatric obstructive sleep apnea through standardized triage: A regional quality improvement initiative
articles.title_cn: 通过标准化分诊减少儿童阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停的转诊至会诊延迟：一项区域质量改进倡议
articles.abstract_en: BackgroundTimely management of pediatric obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) is essential to prevent sequelae. In publicly funded health systems, delays remain common, particularly in non-urban regions with limited specialty capacity. At a regional hospital serving Québec's Bas-Saint-Laurent region, prolonged wait times for adenotonsillectomy were observed. Preliminary review identified referral-to-consultation delay (Wait-1) as the principal access bottleneck, exceeding Pediatric Canadian Access Targets for Surgery. MethodsUsing SQUIRE 2.0 guidelines, we conducted a quality improvement initiative. A retrospective analysis of consecutive pediatric patients undergoing adenotonsillectomy for sleep-disordered breathing over 22 months (n = 82) quantified referral-to-consultation (Wait-1), consultation-to-surgery (Wait-2), and total referral-to-surgery delays. Age, tonsil grade, oxygen desaturation index, and McGill Oximetry Score were assessed as predictors of delay. Multivariable regression identified clinical predictors of management timing. Process mapping and root cause analysis identified non-standardized referral triage as the primary modifiable factor. A standardized referral template and severity-based triage algorithm incorporating tonsil grade, Pediatric Sleep Questionnaire, and oximetry findings were developed. Implementation through Plan-Do-Study-Act cycles is planned but not reported here. ResultsMean Wait-1 was 9.0 ± 7.0 months, Wait-2 was 6.2 ± 3.6 months, and total referral-to-surgery delay was 15.2 ± 8.6 months. Higher tonsil grade (p = 0.015) and oxygen desaturation index (p = 0.032) predicted shorter Wait-2. Oxygen desaturation index independently predicted shorter Wait-1 (p = 0.023) and total delay (p = 0.008). While Wait-2 met Pediatric Canadian Access Targets for Surgery for mild OSA, Wait-1 substantially exceeded benchmarks. ConclusionsIn this non-urban setting, access delays occur primarily before specialty consultation. Standardized referral triage using objective severity markers may improve prioritization and alignment with national benchmarks.
articles.abstract_cn: 背景：儿童阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（OSA）的及时管理对于预防后遗症至关重要。在公共资助的医疗系统中，延迟仍然常见，尤其是在专科能力有限的非城市地区。在服务于魁北克省Bas-Saint-Laurent地区的一家区域医院，观察到腺样体扁桃体切除术的等待时间过长。初步审查确定转诊至会诊延迟（Wait-1）是主要的就医瓶颈，超过了加拿大儿科手术准入目标。方法：遵循SQUIRE 2.0指南，我们开展了一项质量改进倡议。对连续22个月内接受腺样体扁桃体切除术治疗睡眠呼吸障碍的儿科患者（n = 82）进行回顾性分析，量化了转诊至会诊（Wait-1）、会诊至手术（Wait-2）以及总转诊至手术延迟。评估了年龄、扁桃体等级、氧饱和度下降指数和McGill血氧测定评分作为延迟的预测因素。多变量回归确定了管理时机的临床预测因素。流程映射和根本原因分析确定非标准化转诊分诊是主要的可修改因素。开发了包含扁桃体等级、儿科睡眠问卷和血氧测定结果的标准化转诊模板和基于严重程度的分诊算法。通过计划-执行-研究-行动循环的实施已计划但未在此报告。结果：平均Wait-1为9.0 ± 7.0个月，Wait-2为6.2 ± 3.6个月，总转诊至手术延迟为15.2 ± 8.6个月。较高的扁桃体等级（p = 0.015）和氧饱和度下降指数（p = 0.032）预测较短的Wait-2。氧饱和度下降指数独立预测较短的Wait-1（p = 0.023）和总延迟（p = 0.008）。虽然对于轻度OSA，Wait-2达到了加拿大儿科手术准入目标，但Wait-1大幅超过了基准。结论：在这个非城市环境中，就医延迟主要发生在专科会诊之前。使用客观严重程度标志物的标准化转诊分诊可能改善优先级排序并与国家基准保持一致。

articles.title_en: Construction and validation of a nomogram prediction model for postoperative residual risk of pediatric obstructive sleep apnea based on OCTA and LASSO machine learning algorithm
articles.title_cn: 基于OCTA和LASSO机器学习算法的儿童阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停术后残余风险列线图预测模型的构建与验证
articles.abstract_en: ObjectiveTo evaluate the value of retinal optical coherence tomography angiography (OCTA) microcirculatory parameters combined with clinical, biochemical, and polysomnography (PSG) indicators for predicting residual obstructive sleep apnea syndrome (OSAS) in children without clear anatomical or functional anomalies after adenotonsillectomy (AT), and to construct and validate a nomogram prediction model. MethodsA total of 157 school-aged children with PSG-diagnosed OSAS who underwent AT were retrospectively enrolled. Baseline demographic, anatomical (adenoid A/N ratio, tonsillar grading), biochemical (high-sensitivity C-reactive protein [hs-CRP], total antioxidant status [TAS]), PSG (apnea-hypopnea index [AHI], lowest oxygen saturation [LSaO2], oxygen desaturation index [ODI]), and OCTA parameters (vessel length density of deep capillary plexus [DCP-VLD]) were collected. Residual OSAS was defined as postoperative AHI >1 event/h with persistent symptoms at 6 months. LASSO-penalized logistic regression was used for feature selection, followed by multivariate logistic regression to build a nomogram. Model performance was assessed by C-index, calibration curve, Hosmer–Lemeshow test, and decision curve analysis (DCA). Longitudinal OCTA changes were analyzed using generalized estimating equations (GEE). ResultsResidual OSAS occurred in 39 cases (24.84%). LASSO identified four core predictors: adenoid A/N ratio, AHI, hs-CRP, and DCP-VLD. Multivariable analysis showed DCP-VLD as an independent protective factor (OR = 0.64, 95%CI: 0.48–0.85, P = 0.0021). The nomogram achieved an AUC of 0.845 (95%CI:0.728–0.962) with good calibration (Hosmer–Lemeshow P = 0.5840). DCA demonstrated superior net clinical benefit. GEE revealed limited DCP-VLD recovery in the residual group (time×group interaction P = 0.0084). ConclusionReduced macular DCP perfusion quantified by OCTA is an independent predictor of residual OSAS after AT. The LASSO-logistic nomogram integrating anatomical-metabolic-microcirculatory information shows good discrimination and clinical utility for preoperative risk stratification.
articles.abstract_cn: 目的评估视网膜光学相干断层扫描血管成像（OCTA）微循环参数联合临床、生化和多导睡眠监测（PSG）指标对腺样体扁桃体切除术（AT）后无明显解剖或功能异常的儿童残余阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停综合征（OSAS）的预测价值，并构建和验证列线图预测模型。方法回顾性纳入共157名经PSG诊断为OSAS并接受AT的学龄儿童。收集基线人口统计学、解剖学（腺样体A/N比值、扁桃体分级）、生化（高敏C反应蛋白[hs-CRP]、总抗氧化状态[TAS]）、PSG（呼吸暂停低通气指数[AHI]、最低血氧饱和度[LSaO2]、氧减指数[ODI]）和OCTA参数（深层毛细血管丛血管长度密度[DCP-VLD]）。残余OSAS定义为术后6个月AHI >1次/小时且症状持续。采用LASSO惩罚逻辑回归进行特征选择，随后进行多变量逻辑回归构建列线图。模型性能通过C指数、校准曲线、Hosmer–Lemeshow检验和决策曲线分析（DCA）评估。使用广义估计方程（GEE）分析纵向OCTA变化。结果残余OSAS发生39例（24.84%）。LASSO识别出四个核心预测因子：腺样体A/N比值、AHI、hs-CRP和DCP-VLD。多变量分析显示DCP-VLD为独立保护因素（OR = 0.64，95%CI：0.48-0.85，P = 0.0021）。列线图的AUC为0.845（95%CI：0.728-0.962），校准良好（Hosmer–Lemeshow P = 0.5840）。DCA显示优越的净临床获益。GEE显示残余组DCP-VLD恢复有限（时间×组别交互P = 0.0084）。结论OCTA量化的黄斑DCP灌注减少是AT后残余OSAS的独立预测因子。整合解剖-代谢-微循环信息的LASSO逻辑列线图在术前风险分层中显示出良好的区分度和临床实用性。

articles.title_en: Morbidity, mortality, and follow-up after pediatric tracheostomy: A national cohort study
articles.title_cn: 儿童气管切开的发病率、死亡率及随访：一项全国性队列研究
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 The Authors Objective: To describe the clinical characteristics, quantify complications, analyze mortality, and identify the clinical factors associated with increased need for otorhinolaryngology (ENT) follow-up visits in pediatric patients with a tracheostomy. Design: Retrospective cohort study. Setting: A single tertiary referral centre performing all pediatric tracheostomies in Slovenia. Patients: 43 patients younger than 16 years undergoing tracheostomy between January 1st, 2018, and December 31st, 2022. Methods and results: Electronic medical records were analyzed for age at tracheostomy (median: 197.0 days, IQR: 78.0-1951.0), type of tracheal cannula, intubation duration prior to tracheostomy (median: 35.0 days, IQR: 13.0-68.0), tracheostomy indications, comorbidities, tracheostomy-related complications, dysphagia with aspiration, number of ENT follow-up visits (median: 13.0, IQR: 6.0-20.0), follow up duration (median: 723 days, IQR: 374.0-1479) and mortality. The most common indication for tracheostomy was long-term ventilation (25/43; 58.1%). Early complications occurred in 12/43 patients (27.9%), while late complications affected 22/43 patients (51.2%). Eight patients (18.6%) developed post-intubation laryngeal stenosis. We identified upper airway obstruction as an indication for tracheostomy (p = 0.001) and the presence of post-intubation laryngeal stenosis (p = 0.021) to be independent risk factors for increased ENT follow-up visits. Seven patients (16.3%) died; no deaths were tracheostomy-related. Conclusions: Pediatric tracheostomy was associated with frequent complications. Mortality was not related to the presence of tracheostomy. Children tracheostomized for upper airway obstruction, and those with post-intubation laryngeal stenosis required significantly more ENT follow-up visits.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 作者 目的：描述接受气管切开的儿科患者的临床特征，量化并发症，分析死亡率，并识别与耳鼻喉科（ENT）随访需求增加相关的临床因素。设计：回顾性队列研究。环境：斯洛文尼亚一家进行所有儿科气管切开术的单一三级转诊中心。患者：43名年龄小于16岁、在一月1日2018至十二月31日2022期间接受气管切开的患者。方法与结果：分析了电子病历中的气管切开年龄（中位数：197.0天，IQR：78.0-1951.0）、气管套管类型、气管切开前插管持续时间（中位数：35.0天，IQR：13.0-68.0）、气管切开指征、合并症、气管切开相关并发症、吞咽困难伴误吸、ENT随访次数（中位数：13.0，IQR：6.0-20.0）、随访持续时间（中位数：723天，IQR：374.0-1479）和死亡率。气管切开最常见的指征是长期通气（25/43；58.1%）。早期并发症发生在12/43名患者（27.9%），而晚期并发症影响22/43名患者（51.2%）。八名患者（18.6%）出现插管后喉狭窄。我们确定上气道阻塞作为气管切开指征（p = 0.001）和存在插管后喉狭窄（p = 0.021）是ENT随访次数增加的独立风险因素。七名患者（16.3%）死亡；无死亡与气管切开相关。结论：儿科气管切开与频繁并发症相关。死亡率与气管切开的存在无关。因上气道阻塞而接受气管切开的儿童，以及那些有插管后喉狭窄的儿童，需要显著更多的ENT随访。

articles.title_en: Element-selective colloid-facilitated transport of radionuclides by C–S–H nanoparticles in porous concrete columns
articles.title_cn: 多孔混凝土柱中C–S–H纳米颗粒对放射性核素的元素选择性胶体促进迁移
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd Colloid-facilitated transport has been recognized as an important factor influencing radionuclide transport, but studies in cementitious systems remain limited. Batch sorption and column transport experiments were conducted using Cs(I), Se(IV), Mo(VI), and U(VI) to investigate radionuclide transport facilitated by C–S–H colloids in porous concrete columns. C–S–H colloids were synthesized using a double precipitation method in the presence of polycarboxylate ether (PCE). The colloid concentration was determined by elemental quantitative analysis, and their particle size and morphology were characterized by cryogenic TEM. Batch sorption experiments showed that U(VI) was strongly sorbed onto C–S–H colloids, whereas Cs(I), Se(IV), and Mo(VI) exhibited negligible sorption. Cs(I) and U(VI) showed strong sorption onto concrete, while Se(IV) and Mo(VI) were essentially non-sorbing. Consistent with these results, column transport experiments demonstrated that colloid-facilitated transport occurred selectively for U(VI), which is strongly sorbed onto C–S–H colloids. Cs(I), which is sorbed strongly onto the stationary phase but weakly onto colloids, exhibited retarded transport regardless of the presence of colloids. Therefore, colloid-facilitated transport in cementitious systems is strongly controlled by the relative sorption affinity of radionuclides for mobile colloids and stationary solid phases.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd 胶体促进迁移已被认为是影响放射性核素迁移的重要因素，但在水泥体系中的研究仍然有限。使用Cs(I)、Se(IV)、Mo(VI)和U(VI)进行了批量吸附和柱迁移实验，以研究多孔混凝土柱中C–S–H胶体促进的放射性核素迁移。在聚羧酸醚（PCE）存在下，采用双沉淀法合成了C–S–H胶体。通过元素定量分析测定胶体浓度，并使用低温透射电子显微镜表征其粒径和形态。批量吸附实验表明，U(VI)强烈吸附在C–S–H胶体上，而Cs(I)、Se(IV)和Mo(VI)的吸附可忽略不计。Cs(I)和U(VI)在混凝土上表现出强吸附，而Se(IV)和Mo(VI)基本上不吸附。与这些结果一致，柱迁移实验表明，胶体促进迁移对U(VI)具有选择性，因为U(VI)强烈吸附在C–S–H胶体上。Cs(I)虽然强烈吸附在固定相上，但对胶体的吸附较弱，无论是否存在胶体，其迁移均受到阻滞。因此，水泥体系中胶体促进迁移受到放射性核素对移动胶体和固定固相相对吸附亲和力的强烈控制。

articles.title_en: Extreme natural heating of Cretaceous amber and fossilized sap
articles.title_cn: 白垩纪琥珀及化石树液遭受的极端自然加热
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 The Authors Amber from the Early Cretaceous (Albian) of Spain preserves heterogeneous mixtures of resin and sap exuded from the roots of Cretaceous trees, in the form of double emulsions. Here we investigate morphological and physicochemical changes in these two fossilized plant substances in kidney-shaped amber pieces from Ariño amber (Teruel, Spain). Through integrated optical, electron, and confocal microscopy, FT-Raman spectroscopy, and elemental analysis, we demonstrate that the fossilized resin and sap were affected by an extreme thermal event where local temperatures likely exceeded 600°C, and which triggered combustion and partial melting of both substances, including through diffusion and caramelization of the fossilized sap. Thermal gradients are evident across three different types of amber layer based on their fossilized sap content, with outer zones displaying dense porosity and structural reorganization. Notable transformations include the crystallization of fossilized sap into coniferyl aldehyde, a lignin precursor, and the modification of fossilized resin-in-sap emulsion droplets with the incorporation of fluids (liquid and gas). We propose that the fossil diagenetic heating that the amber pieces suffered resulted from the spontaneous combustion of coal, a phenomenon widely documented in the Ariño area and others. These results provide the first evidence of physicochemical reactions and textural changes in fossilized sap due to heating, offering new insights into organic matter maturation and the thermal history of amber during fossil diagenesis.

articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd 地球化学背景值的主要作用通常是作为评估样品的参考。然而，样品中的元素浓度会受到其岩性和风化的明显影响，导致在同一参考下进行比较不合适。基于771条岩石、土壤和沉积物的丰度记录，我们提出了一个基于样品主要成分估算钨地球化学背景值的方程。在实验室分析质量要求下，该方程计算的771个值的合格率达到86.1%（接近实验室要求的90%）。为了检验该方程的有效性和实用性，选取了771条丰度记录中部分记录两两组合的混合样品、来自中国某钨矿床内、附近及远处的三个风化剖面的风化产物，以及澳大利亚昆士兰地区的29条河流沉积物作为示例。结果表明，背景区样品的计算钨浓度与实测钨浓度不仅高度一致，而且异常区样品的比较也适用。基于样品主要成分计算的地球化学背景值可视为参考值，解决了传统基于数据集统计得出的地球化学背景值的局限性，并在环境地球化学和地球化学勘探中具有潜在应用价值。

articles.title_en: Oxidation mechanisms and kinetics of pyrite and pyrrhotite in alkaline solutions

Iron sulfide–bearing aggregates are a primary cause of internal sulfate attack in concrete, yet the intrinsic oxidation behavior of pyrite and pyrrhotite under alkaline conditions relevant to cementitious systems remains unclear. This study provides a quantitative, mechanistic comparison of their oxidation pathways through controlled batch experiments with elevated dissolved oxygen at pH 10–13 across a range of particle sizes, complemented by ion chromatography sulfur speciation and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS).XPS analyses revealed that laboratory-synthesized monoclinic pyrrhotite retained an oxidized Fe(III) surface layer and a deeper S-rich altered region even after acid washing, indicating a persistent passivating surface structure that limits access to intrinsic dissolution behavior. However, pyrite formed thinner, more easily removed surface layers. Measured pyrite oxidation rates were consistent with reported intrinsic kinetic values, whereas pyrrhotite rates were nearly two orders of magnitude lower than those reported in recent high-pH studies which may be attributed to the passivation layer, experimental conditions, and type of pyrrhotite. Aqueous speciation revealed distinct pathways: pyrrhotite generated thiosulfate-dominated sulfur pools, while pyrite produced mainly sulfite and thiosulfate.Together, these results demonstrate that pyrrhotite's damaging role in concrete foundations cannot be attributed to inherently faster high-pH oxidation kinetics. Instead, deterioration likely reflects the interaction between pyrrhotite's persistent multilayer surface structure, oxygen-limited microenvironments within concrete, and the delayed release of partially oxidized sulfur species that ultimately generate sulfate. These mechanistic insights provide a basis for improving aggregate evaluation protocols and interpreting regional differences in deterioration timelines observed in pyrrhotite- and pyrite-bearing concrete foundations.

articles.title_en: Seawater ions-mediated phase transformation of hydrated cement during sequential leaching and carbonation

Seawater-mediated carbonation recycling of hydrated cement provides a promising pathway for enhancing concrete sustainability throughout its life cycle, yet the phase transformation during successive leaching and carbonation remains insufficiently understood, despite their critical roles in governing microstructural evolution and final material performance. Herein, experimental investigations combined with thermodynamic modeling were conducted to systematically examine the compositional evolution of both liquid and solid phases. Results show that prolonged leaching significantly alters hydrate assemblages and enriches dissolved Ca ions via ion-exchange reactions, thereby governing subsequent carbonation pathways. Chloride solutions accelerate hydrate decomposition and promote the reorganization of Cl ions into alumino-ferrite-mono (AFm) phases, particularly Kuzel's and Friedel's salts in CaCl 2 solution, while Mg ions further destabilize Ca-rich hydrates and induce Mg-rich phases (MH, Ht and M-S-H). Subsequent carbonation transforms both liquid and solid compositions, with solution ions facilitating early CaCO 3 and alumina-silica (A-S) gel precipitation and further modifying their structures through ion incorporation. Thermodynamic modeling corroborates the experimental observations and reveals a stepwise conservation of water-stable hydrates into CO 2 -stable products, primarily A-S gel, calcite, dolomite and natrolite under specific solution conditions, accompanied by corresponding changes in solution pH and ionic concentrations. Mechanistic analysis further demonstrates that leaching and carbonation are governed by coupled dissolution-precipitation-driven element rearrangements within cement hydrates. These findings provide fundamental insights into seawater-mediated CO 2 mineralization and support the sustainable design and recycling of cement-based materials.

articles.title_en: Effect of social determinants of health on adherence to the early hearing detection and intervention 1-3-6 benchmarks at University of Rochester Medical Center
articles.title_cn: 健康的社会决定因素对遵守罗切斯特大学医学中心早期听力检测和干预 1-3-6 基准的影响

This study evaluated adherence to EHDI 1-3-6 benchmarks and explored predictors of delayed or incomplete follow-up. Methods: This was a retrospective cohort study with patients born between January 1, 2020, and December 31, 2024, at two hospitals within one health system. Patients admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit were excluded. Demographic, audiologic outcome, and social determinants of health information were collected. The primary outcome was on-time completion, and secondary outcome was completion at any time. Results: A total of 22,451 patients were included. 22,433 (99.92%) completed the initial newborn hearing screen (NBHS). Out of 194 patients who were recommended follow-up, 159 (82%) completed all milestones with 49 (25%) completed them on time. The highest rate of loss to follow-up occurred at the 1-month outpatient screening milestone. Younger maternal ages (p = 0.01), Black race (p = 0.004), and increased Area Deprivation Index (ADI) scores (p = 0.02) were associated with delayed completion. Maternal use of American Sign Language (p = 0.02) and Black race (p = 0.02) ) were associated with not completing milestones. Conclusion: Timely adherence of EDHI milestones was significantly lower. Higher ADI was associated with delayed completion. Black race and maternal use of American Sign Language were associated with not completing milestones. These findings highlight a need for targeted interventions to improve timely completion of EHDI milestones.

articles.title_en: Comparative outcomes of intracapsular and total tonsillectomy for obstructive sleep apnea in children with Trisomy 21

articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Introduction: Children with Trisomy 21 (T21) are at high risk for obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) and perioperative complications. Intracapsular tonsillectomy (IT) is associated with reduced postoperative morbidity, but its long-term efficacy compared to total tonsillectomy (TT) remains debated. Objectives: To compare the safety and efficacy of IT versus TT for OSA in children with T21. Methods: A retrospective cohort study was conducted of patients aged 2-18 years with T21 who underwent tonsillectomies with/without adenoidectomy between 2005 and 2025 at a tertiary center. Patients undergoing concurrent airway procedures were excluded. Outcomes included postoperative complications, polysomnography (PSG) changes, symptom recurrence, and OSA-symptom-free survival. Results: Among 176 patients (mean age 5.9 years; 54.0% female), 109 underwent TT and 67 IT. Preoperative OSA severity and tonsil size did not differ. Postoperative return visits were significantly higher after TT (17.4% vs 1.5%, p = 0.001) for poor oral intake (12.8% vs 1.5%, p = 0.010) and bleeding (6.4% vs 0.0%, p = 0.045). Improvements in AHI (53.4% TT vs 53.1% IT, p = 1.00) and OSA resolution (19.0% vs 21.9%, p = 0.787) were comparable. Unadjusted OSA recurrence was higher after TT, but this difference was not significant after adjusting for surgery year and follow-up duration (HR 1.10, 95% CI 0.54–2.25, p = 0.785). Conclusion: Intracapsular tonsillectomy provides equivalent OSA control with lower perioperative morbidity compared with total tonsillectomy, supporting IT as a safe and effective first-line surgical approach for children with T21.

articles.title_en: Analyzing phosphorus flow in crop production via interpretable machine learning: Insights from a typical agricultural region of Jiangxi Province, China

articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Understanding historical phosphorus (P) cycling in crop production is essential for sustainable P management and water quality protection. This study adopts a comprehensive perspective of the crop production process, focusing on Jiangxi Province, an intensively farmed region in China. A bottom-up, multi-year dynamic phosphorus substance flow analysis (P-SFA) model was developed considering regional social diversity and P flow complexity. The P cycle in Jiangxi shifted from a natural-dominated steady state to a human-driven unidirectional system, with major changes occurring between 1978 and 2015. Agricultural intensification and livestock expansion have continuously increased P flows in the region. Total P input rose from 5.84 × 10 4 t in 1950 to 2.13 × 10 5 t in 2020, representing an almost fourfold increase. Since 1950, chemical fertilizers became the largest P source, reaching 1.25 × 10 5 t (58.86% of total) in 2020. Interpretability-based machine learning (ML) model quantified the influence of P flow drivers. SHAP (Shapley Additive Explanations) analysis confirmed that agriculture accounts for over 75% of P flow intensity, highlighting key socio-economic factors. This nonlinear identification method offers a new perspective for SFA. The SFA–ML model improves understanding of P flows and their role in watershed P cycling.
