articles.title_en: Carbon-isotope reversal in overmature Wufeng–Longmaxi marine shales, Sichuan Basin: Methane loss, diffusion fractionation, and preservation control
articles.title_cn: 四川盆地过成熟五峰组—龙马溪组海相页岩碳同位素倒转：甲烷损失、扩散分馏与保存控制
articles.abstract_en: Carbon-isotope reversal is widely observed in overmature shale gas systems, yet the relative contributions of thermal evolution and post-accumulation methane loss remain poorly constrained. This study investigates the origin and intensity of carbon-isotope reversal in the overmature Wufeng–Longmaxi (W–L) marine shales of the Sichuan Basin by integrating gas geochemistry, carbon isotopes, desorption experiments, methane sorption measurements, and quantitative modeling. The uplifted YC4 well in the Wulong area was compared with better-preserved overpressured regions across the basin. Despite high total organic carbon contents (up to 8 wt%), the YC4 well contains relatively low gas contents (maximum 2.72 m3/t), and measured gas inventories are consistently lower than methane sorption capacities, indicating substantial post-accumulation gas depletion. Shale gas exhibits persistent full isotopic reversal (δ13C1 > δ13C2 > δ13C3), with methane δ13C1 values ranging from −27‰ to −25‰. Desorption experiments demonstrate progressive 13C enrichment in methane and ethane during gas release, consistent with preferential loss of 12C-enriched gas. Basin-scale comparisons further show that poorly preserved areas systematically contain heavier methane and stronger isotopic reversal than better-preserved, overpressured regions. A coupled Langmuir–Rayleigh adsorption–diffusion model, using the Weiyuan block as a preservation reference, estimates that approximately 55–80% of the original methane inventory has been lost from the Wulong area. These results indicate that inherited thermogenic evolution establishes the initial isotopic reversal framework, whereas preservation-related methane loss substantially amplifies the isotopic anomaly. Integrating Δδ13C (δ13C1−δ13C2), gas content, sorption capacity, and quantitative diffusion modeling provides a practical geochemical framework for evaluating reservoir preservation and methane retention in overmature marine shale gas systems.
articles.abstract_cn: 碳同位素倒转在过成熟页岩气系统中广泛观察到，然而热演化和聚集后甲烷损失的相对贡献仍受到较差的约束。本研究通过整合气体地球化学、碳同位素、解吸实验、甲烷吸附测量和定量模拟，探讨了四川盆地过成熟五峰组—龙马溪组（W–L）海相页岩中碳同位素倒转的成因和强度。将武隆地区抬升的YC4井与盆地内保存较好的超压区域进行了对比。尽管总有机碳含量较高（最高达8 wt%），YC4井的含气量相对较低（最大2.72 m3/t），且实测气体储量始终低于甲烷吸附能力，表明存在显著的聚集后气体亏损。页岩气表现出持续的全同位素倒转（δ13C1 > δ13C2 > δ13C3），甲烷δ13C1值范围为−27‰至−25‰。解吸实验表明，在气体释放过程中甲烷和乙烷逐渐富集13C，这与优先损失富12C气体一致。盆地尺度比较进一步显示，保存较差的区域系统性地含有更重的甲烷和更强的同位素倒转，相较于保存较好、超压的区域。以威远区块作为保存参考的耦合Langmuir–Rayleigh吸附–扩散模型估计，武隆地区原始甲烷储量中约有55-80%已损失。这些结果表明，继承的热成因演化建立了初始的同位素倒转框架，而保存相关的甲烷损失显著放大了同位素异常。整合Δδ13C（δ13C1−δ13C2）、含气量、吸附能力和定量扩散模拟，为评估过成熟海相页岩气系统中储层保存和甲烷滞留提供了一个实用的地球化学框架。

articles.title_en: Crystalline ASR products: Review of mineral candidates and molecular simulations of their atomic structures, thermodynamic data and thermoelastic properties
articles.title_cn: 结晶性ASR产物：矿物候选物综述及其原子结构、热力学数据和热弹性性质的分子模拟
articles.abstract_en: Several mineral analogues were proposed for ASR products, but no consensus exists on which ones best represent crystalline phases or could serve as templates for nanocrystalline or defective forms. This study reviews all structures reported in the literature for crystalline ASR products within the SiO2–CaO–Na2O–K2O–H2O system. The research develops the first atomic model database that includes both Na- and K-based ASR phases. These structures are simulated using Density Functional Theory (DFT) and classical Molecular Dynamics (MD). The work calculates and reports crucial data, including thermodynamic properties (heat capacity, entropy, and enthalpy of formation), self-diffusion coefficients of water and alkalis, elastic and thermoelastic properties. Furthermore, it quantifies the potential for generating crystallization pressure of each mineral analogue, which is key to ASR-induced expansion. Ultimately, the study discusses the structural and thermodynamic relevance of the investigated phases to determine their suitability as crystalline analogues for ASR reaction products.
articles.abstract_cn: 针对ASR产物提出了几种矿物类似物，但对于哪些最能代表结晶相或可作为纳米晶或缺陷形态的模板，尚未达成共识。本研究回顾了文献中报道的SiO2–CaO–Na2O–K2O–H2O体系内所有结晶性ASR产物的结构。该研究开发了首个包含Na基和K基ASR相的原子模型数据库。这些结构使用密度泛函理论（DFT）和经典分子动力学（MD）进行模拟。工作计算并报告了关键数据，包括热力学性质（热容、熵和生成焓）、水和碱的自扩散系数、弹性和热弹性性质。此外，它量化了每种矿物类似物产生结晶压力的潜力，这是ASR引起膨胀的关键。最终，研究讨论了所调查相的结构和热力学相关性，以确定它们作为ASR反应产物结晶类似物的适用性。

articles.title_en: Water absorption–release behavior of SAP@coral aggregate composite and its influence on UHPC
articles.title_cn: SAP@珊瑚骨料复合材料的水分吸收-释放行为及其对超高性能混凝土的影响
articles.abstract_en: In marine engineering, coral aggregate (CA) has become an essential raw material for producing marine ultra-high-performance concrete (UHPC) due to its local availability and inherent internal curing capability. However, its highly connected pore structure leads to excessively rapid water release, limiting its internal curing capability to meet the dynamic water demand of UHPC during hydration. To overcome these limitations, a composite internal curing material (SAP@CA) was developed by impregnating superabsorbent polymers (SAP) into the CA pores through an aqueous-solution polymerization method. The water absorption and release behaviors of SAP@CA were systematically investigated, and the moisture migration in UHPC matrix was monitored using 1H nuclear magnetic resonance (1H NMR) and X-ray computed tomography (X-CT). The results show that embedding SAP into CA pores significantly enhances its water absorption capacity and improves its resistance to ionic interference in cement filtrate. Benefiting from a synergistic mechanism involving capillary buffering and osmotic regulation, SAP@CA exhibits stable water retention during the early stage and a controlled, gradient water release behavior in the mid-stage. Consequently, the duration of 100% internal relative humidity (IRH) is extended to 77 h, and autogenous shrinkage of UHPC is reduced by 44%. Moreover, after water release, the residual SAP and hydration products within the CA pores contribute to microstructural densification, resulting in a 28 d compressive strength of 125 MPa with only a 2.5% strength reduction compared with the control group. These findings demonstrate that SAP@CA provides an effective strategy for developing high-performance internal curing materials for UHPC in marine and coastal engineering applications.
articles.abstract_cn: 在海洋工程中，珊瑚骨料（CA）因其就地可取性和固有的内养护能力，已成为生产海洋超高性能混凝土（UHPC）的重要原材料。然而，其高度连通的孔隙结构导致水分释放过快，限制了其内养护能力以满足UHPC水化过程中的动态需水需求。为克服这些限制，通过水溶液聚合法将超吸水聚合物（SAP）浸渍到CA孔隙中，开发了一种复合内养护材料（SAP@CA）。系统研究了SAP@CA的吸水与释水行为，并利用1H核磁共振（1H NMR）和X射线计算机断层扫描（X-CT）监测了UHPC基体中的水分迁移。结果表明，将SAP嵌入CA孔隙中显著增强了其吸水能力，并提高了其在水泥滤液中对离子干扰的抵抗性。得益于毛细缓冲和渗透调节的协同机制，SAP@CA在早期表现出稳定的保水性，并在中期表现出受控的梯度释水行为。因此，100%内部相对湿度（IRH）的持续时间延长至77小时，UHPC的自收缩减少了44%。此外，释水后，CA孔隙内残留的SAP和水化产物有助于微结构致密化，使得28天抗压强度达到125 MPa，与对照组相比仅降低2.5%。这些发现表明，SAP@CA为海洋和沿海工程中UHPC高性能内养护材料的开发提供了一种有效策略。

articles.title_en: Evaluation of anatomical and ultrasonographic parameters to predict difficult airway in pediatric patients
articles.title_cn: 解剖学和超声参数评估儿科患者困难气道的评价
articles.abstract_en: BackgroundPredicting a difficult airway in pediatric patients remains challenging due to unique anatomical and physiological characteristics. Traditional bedside predictors show inconsistent accuracy in children, and ultrasonography has emerged as a promising, objective tool for airway evaluation. This study aimed to assess the diagnostic performance of anatomical and ultrasonographic parameters in predicting difficult intubation in pediatric patients. MethodsIn this prospective, double-blind observational study, children aged 1–12 years undergoing elective surgery with endotracheal intubation were evaluated. Clinical assessments included anthropometric measurements and airway tests (Mallampati, thyromental distance (TMD), sternomental distance (SMD), hyomental distance (HMD)). Sonographic measurements—skin–epiglottis distance (S-ED) and skin–hyoid distance (S-HD)-were obtained preoperatively. Difficult intubation was defined as Intubation Difficulty Score (IDS) > 5. ROC curve analyses were used to evaluate diagnostic performance; logistic regression identified independent predictors. ResultsA total of 240 children were included, with a difficult-intubation incidence of 20%. S-ED demonstrated the highest predictive accuracy (AUC 0.941), followed by S-HD (AUC 0.912), HMD (AUC 0.898), and Mallampati classification (AUC 0.860). TMD and SMD showed moderate predictive ability. Combining significant clinical and sonographic parameters improved diagnostic performance, with S-ED + S-HD yielding an AUC of 0.961. Multivariable regression identified S-ED (OR 4.61), S-HD (OR 1.76), Mallampati ≥ III, and facial anomalies as independent predictors of difficult intubation. The final model correctly classified 95.4% of cases. ConclusionsUltrasonographic parameters, particularly S-ED and S-HD, are highly accurate predictors of difficult intubation in children and outperform traditional clinical tests. Combining sonographic with anatomical assessments significantly enhances diagnostic performance. Airway ultrasound provides an objective, reproducible, and non-cooperation–dependent tool that can improve preoperative risk stratification in pediatric anesthesia.
articles.abstract_cn: 背景由于独特的解剖和生理特征，预测儿科患者的困难气道仍然具有挑战性。传统的床旁预测指标在儿童中的准确性不一致，超声检查已成为一种有前景的、客观的气道评估工具。本研究旨在评估解剖学和超声参数在预测儿科患者困难插管中的诊断性能。方法在这项前瞻性、双盲观察性研究中，评估了年龄在1-12岁、接受择期手术并需气管插管的儿童。临床评估包括人体测量和气道测试（Mallampati分级、甲颏距离（TMD）、胸颏距离（SMD）、舌骨颏距离（HMD））。术前获取超声测量值——皮肤-会厌距离（S-ED）和皮肤-舌骨距离（S-HD）。困难插管定义为插管困难评分（IDS）>5。使用ROC曲线分析评估诊断性能；逻辑回归确定独立预测因子。结果共纳入240名儿童，困难插管发生率为20%。S-ED显示出最高的预测准确性（AUC 0.941），其次是S-HD（AUC 0.912）、HMD（AUC 0.898）和Mallampati分级（AUC 0.860）。TMD和SMD显示出中等预测能力。结合显著的临床和超声参数提高了诊断性能，S-ED + S-HD的AUC为0.961。多变量回归确定S-ED（OR 4.61）、S-HD（OR 1.76）、Mallampati ≥ III级和面部异常为困难插管的独立预测因子。最终模型正确分类了95.4%的病例。结论超声参数，特别是S-ED和S-HD，是儿童困难插管的高度准确预测因子，优于传统临床测试。将超声与解剖评估相结合显著提高了诊断性能。气道超声提供了一种客观、可重复且不依赖合作性的工具，可改善儿科麻醉中的术前风险分层。

articles.title_en: Decision-rule alignment in generative latent spaces: The role of radial compatibility
articles.title_cn: 生成潜空间中的决策规则对齐：径向兼容性的作用
articles.abstract_en: Deep generative encoders are frequently reused as fixed feature extractors for downstream classification, but the suitability of a classifier depends on whether its decision assumptions align with the geometry of the learned representation. We study this compatibility problem by using deterministic posterior mean embeddings extracted from variational autoencoders. Within each dataset, the encoder, embeddings, preprocessing, cross-validation partitions, and held-out samples are fixed, while only the downstream decision rule varies. We compare a centroid-based radial rule, a Gaussian maximum a posteriori (MAP) classifier with shrinkage-regularized covariance estimation, logistic regression, and eXtreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) across eight heterogeneous acoustic and visual benchmarks. The relative ordering of these decision rules is not invariant: Gaussian MAP performs best on the amphibian vocalization dataset, logistic regression leads on UrbanSound8K and ESC-50, and XGBoost ranks first across the five visual datasets. To interpret this variability, we characterize class-conditional geometry in the posterior mean embedding space and define radial compatibility as the joint presence of within-class isotropy and radial separation from competing classes. This class-centered formulation links the assumptions of centroid-based radial classification to measurable geometric properties of the representation. The cross-dataset geometry–performance analysis is interpreted descriptively because only eight dataset-level observations are available. Overall, the results show that downstream classifier effectiveness cannot be attributed solely to intrinsic model flexibility but should instead be understood as a compatibility problem between decision-rule assumptions and the geometry induced by the fixed generative representation.
articles.abstract_cn: 深度生成编码器经常被重用为下游分类的固定特征提取器，但分类器的适用性取决于其决策假设是否与学习表示的几何结构对齐。我们通过使用从变分自编码器中提取的确定性后验均值嵌入来研究这一兼容性问题。在每个数据集内，编码器、嵌入、预处理、交叉验证分区和留出样本都是固定的，只有下游决策规则变化。我们比较了基于质心的径向规则、具有收缩正则化协方差估计的高斯最大后验（MAP）分类器、逻辑回归和极端梯度提升（XGBoost）在八个异构声学和视觉基准上的表现。这些决策规则的相对排序并非不变：高斯MAP在两栖动物发声数据集上表现最佳，逻辑回归在UrbanSound8K和ESC-50上领先，而XGBoost在五个视觉数据集上排名第一。为了解释这种变异性，我们刻画了后验均值嵌入空间中的类条件几何结构，并将径向兼容性定义为类内各向同性和与竞争类的径向分离的联合存在。这种以类为中心的表述将基于质心的径向分类的假设与表示的可测量几何属性联系起来。跨数据集的几何-性能分析被描述性地解释，因为只有八个数据集级别的观测可用。总体而言，结果表明下游分类器的有效性不能仅归因于内在模型灵活性，而应被理解为决策规则假设与固定生成表示所诱导的几何结构之间的兼容性问题。

articles.title_en: Synergistic optimization of electrochemical and mechanical properties of cement-based energy storage materials: A review
articles.title_cn: 水泥基储能材料电化学与力学性能协同优化：综述
articles.abstract_en: The global energy transformation promotes the integration of structural load-bearing and electrochemical energy storage in construction materials. Cement-based energy storage composites are highly promising for intelligent zero-energy buildings, yet they face an inherent core conflict that electrochemical performance relies on high porosity and conductive networks while mechanical bearing demands dense and defect-free matrices. This paper reviews the classification, working principles, key materials, and performance progress of cement-based batteries and supercapacitors. It systematically summarizes synergistic optimization strategies, e.g., conductive filler design, microstructure modulation, polymer modification, and interface engineering. Existing challenges, including the lack of coupling evaluation criteria and unclear service behavior, are highlighted. Finally, future directions in multi-scale design, intelligent manufacturing, and life-cycle assessment are prospected, providing guidance for the practical application of structure-energy integrated materials.
articles.abstract_cn: 全球能源转型推动了建筑材料中结构承载与电化学储能的融合。水泥基储能复合材料在智能零能耗建筑中极具前景，但其面临一个固有的核心矛盾：电化学性能依赖于高孔隙率和导电网络，而机械承载则要求致密且无缺陷的基体。本文综述了水泥基电池和超级电容器的分类、工作原理、关键材料及性能进展，系统总结了协同优化策略，如导电填料设计、微观结构调控、聚合物改性和界面工程。指出了现有挑战，包括缺乏耦合评价标准和不明确的服务行为。最后，展望了多尺度设计、智能制造和生命周期评估的未来方向，为结构-能源一体化材料的实际应用提供指导。

articles.title_en: A comparative assessment of static mixers for twin-pipe 3D concrete printing using X-ray CT and CFD
articles.title_cn: 基于X射线CT和CFD的双管3D混凝土打印静态混合器的比较评估
articles.abstract_en: Twin-pipe 3D concrete printing enables a rapid transition of concrete from a pumpable state to a buildable state through inline material mixing. However, optimization of the static mixer remains challenging due to the complex rheology and opaque nature of cement-based materials. In this study, magnetite was used as a density-contrasted tracer by replacing quartz aggregate in one constituent stream, enabling post-mixing visualization using X-ray computed tomography (CT). A geometry-consistent image analysis method based on equal-area segmentation of circular cross-sections was developed to quantify mixing homogeneity. Five static mixer geometries were experimentally evaluated using this CT-based approach. To complement the experiments, computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulations with particle tracing were performed to investigate flow development and mixing evolution. The CFD predictions were validated against CT-derived mixing indices. Based on this combined CT-CFD framework, the five mixer types were comparatively assessed in terms of mixing performance, pressure drop, energy dissipation, and velocity distribution. The results reveal clear trade-offs between mixing efficiency and hydraulic resistance among different mixer geometries. The proposed methodology provides a quantitative framework for linking mixer geometry to flow and mixing behavior in twin-pipe 3D concrete printing and offers practical guidance for static mixer design.
articles.abstract_cn: 双管3D混凝土打印通过在线材料混合，使混凝土能够从可泵送状态快速过渡到可建造状态。然而，由于水泥基材料的复杂流变性和不透明性，静态混合器的优化仍然具有挑战性。在本研究中，磁铁矿被用作密度对比示踪剂，替代一个组成流中的石英骨料，从而能够使用X射线计算机断层扫描（CT）进行混合后可视化。开发了一种基于圆形截面等面积分割的几何一致图像分析方法，以量化混合均匀性。使用这种基于CT的方法对五种静态混合器几何形状进行了实验评估。为了补充实验，进行了带有粒子追踪的计算流体动力学（CFD）模拟，以研究流动发展和混合演变。CFD预测结果与CT衍生的混合指数进行了验证。基于这种CT-CFD联合框架，对五种混合器类型在混合性能、压降、能量耗散和速度分布方面进行了比较评估。结果揭示了不同混合器几何形状在混合效率和水力阻力之间的明显权衡。所提出的方法为将混合器几何形状与双管3D混凝土打印中的流动和混合行为联系起来提供了一个定量框架，并为静态混合器设计提供了实用指导。

articles.title_en: Effect of extraction parameters and supplementary cementitious materials on rapid determination of free chloride content in cement pastes
articles.title_cn: 萃取参数和辅助胶凝材料对水泥浆体中自由氯离子快速测定的影响
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd. All rights are reserved, including those for text and data mining, AI training, and similar technologies. This study used the effects of extraction parameters such as liquid-to-solid ratio (L/S), particle size of crushed samples, extraction time and supplementary cementitious materials (SCMs) on the free chloride content measured by the water extraction (WE) method in hardened cement pastes, using pore solution expression (PSE) method as the reference. The results show that the free chloride content measured by WE method is controlled not only by leaching of pore-solution chloride, but also by extraction-induced redistribution of bound chloride. In Portland cement pastes, increasing L/S ratio, decreasing particle size, and prolonging extraction time increased the measured free chloride content, mainly because OH − leaching promoted the decomposition of chemically bound chloride. Compared to PC, the SL- and MK-blended systems exhibited a lower chloride release of bound chloride from the solid phase, mainly due to reduced decomposition of chemically bound chlorides; consequently, the released chlorides were mainly derived from physically adsorbed chloride on C-(A)-S-H gel. At low chloride contents (0.5% and 1%), sulfate-chloride exchange in Kuzel's salt promoted FS formation and delayed decomposition of chemically bound chloride ions, whereas at high chloride content (2%), FS remained comparatively stable after extraction. Compared with PSE method in terms of accuracy, the free chloride content measured by the WE method for the SL- and MK-blended systems showed a relative deviation of less than 10%. RSM showed that particle size and extraction time were the most influential factors, followed by L/S ratio, and the optimized model predicted the WE method response with an error below 5%.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd. 保留所有权利，包括文本和数据挖掘、AI训练及类似技术的权利。本研究以孔溶液压榨法（PSE）为参考，研究了液固比（L/S）、破碎样品粒径、萃取时间及辅助胶凝材料（SCMs）等萃取参数对水萃取法（WE）测定硬化水泥浆体中自由氯离子含量的影响。结果表明，WE法测得的自由氯离子含量不仅受孔溶液氯离子浸出的控制，还受萃取诱导的结合氯离子再分布的影响。在波特兰水泥浆体中，增大L/S比、减小粒径和延长萃取时间均会增加测得的自由氯离子含量，这主要是因为OH−浸出促进了化学结合氯离子的分解。与PC相比，SL和MK掺合体系从固相释放的结合氯离子较少，主要归因于化学结合氯离子分解减少；因此，释放的氯离子主要来源于C-(A)-S-H凝胶上的物理吸附氯离子。在低氯离子含量（0.5%和1%）下，Kuzel盐中的硫酸盐-氯离子交换促进了FS的形成并延迟了化学结合氯离子的分解，而在高氯离子含量（2%）下，FS在萃取后保持相对稳定。与PSE法在准确性方面相比，WE法测得的SL和MK掺合体系的自由氯离子含量相对偏差小于10%。RSM表明，粒径和萃取时间是最主要的影响因素，其次是L/S比，优化模型预测WE法响应的误差低于5%。

articles.title_en: Rare earth element quantification in sedimentary systems: recommendations for pXRF methods
articles.title_cn: 沉积体系中稀土元素定量分析：pXRF方法建议
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 The Authors Quantifying rare earth elements (REEs) in coal-bearing sedimentary strata requires reliable geochemical methods, yet the comparability of portable X-ray fluorescence (pXRF) and inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry (ICP-MS) datasets remains poorly constrained. This study evaluates method comparability across 230 samples from the Uinta Region of Utah and western Colorado, spanning coal, mudstone, siltstone, claystone, carbonaceous shale, sandstone, and igneous lithologies. Three hierarchical factors govern method agreement: sample preparation, lithology, and elemental atomic weight. Powdered samples show stronger ICP-MS agreement than whole rock samples across all lithologies (R 2 = 0.614 vs. 0.126), as homogenization minimizes grain-size and mineralogical heterogeneity. In powdered samples, pXRF-derived Y serves as a reliable heavy REE proxy (R 2 = 0.743, m = 1.00, b = 7 ppm). Coal outperforms other lithologies in both preparation approaches; mudstone whole rock samples show near-zero correlation. Agreement degrades with increasing atomic weight; pXRF-derived Pr and Nd should not be used quantitatively without independent validation. Recommended methodologies optimize pXRF as a non-destructive REE screening tool: spatial grid analysis (n ≥ 8 per sample) yields bulk-representative REE values statistically comparable to ICP-MS; coefficient of variation values of 37.7–67.9% confirm that single-point measurements inadequately represent bulk REE content. Complementary analyses along a stratigraphic transect show no statistically significant method difference (p = 0.093). A uniform correction factor of 1.214 ± 0.066 provides moderate REE estimation accuracy (R 2 = 0.661, RMSE = 54.66 ppm) suitable for first-order enrichment screening. These findings establish a validated, cost-effective framework for pXRF deployment in sedimentary critical mineral assessments.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 作者 量化含煤沉积地层中的稀土元素（REEs）需要可靠的地球化学方法，然而便携式X射线荧光（pXRF）与电感耦合等离子体质谱（ICP-MS）数据集之间的可比性仍缺乏充分约束。本研究评估了来自犹他州尤因塔地区和科罗拉多州西部230个样本的方法可比性，涵盖煤、泥岩、粉砂岩、粘土岩、碳质页岩、砂岩和火成岩岩性。三个层级因素控制方法一致性：样品制备、岩性和元素原子量。粉末样品在所有岩性中与ICP-MS的一致性均强于全岩样品（R 2 = 0.614 对比 0.126），因为均质化减少了粒度与矿物学非均质性。在粉末样品中，pXRF衍生的Y可作为可靠的重稀土代理指标（R 2 = 0.743，m = 1.00，b = 7 ppm）。煤在两种制备方法中均优于其他岩性；泥岩全岩样品显示近零相关性。一致性随原子量增加而降低；未经独立验证，pXRF衍生的Pr和Nd不应定量使用。推荐的方法优化了pXRF作为非破坏性稀土筛选工具的应用：空间网格分析（每样本n ≥ 8）产生的体代表性稀土值与ICP-MS统计上可比；变异系数值37.7-67.9%证实单点测量不足以代表体稀土含量。沿地层剖面的补充分析显示方法间无统计显著差异（p = 0.093）。统一校正因子1.214 ± 0.066提供中等稀土估算精度（R 2 = 0.661，RMSE = 54.66 ppm），适用于一级富集筛选。这些发现为沉积关键矿产评估中pXRF的应用建立了经过验证的、成本效益高的框架。

articles.title_en: The symptoms and treatment of congenital inner ear malformation: a national-level study comparing the TriNetX research network with Epic Cosmos
articles.title_cn: 先天性内耳畸形的症状与治疗：一项比较TriNetX研究网络与Epic Cosmos的全国性研究
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. Objective: The current epidemiological understanding of inner ear malformation (IEM) patients is limited by the rarity of the condition. This study employs two national databases to describe the natural progression of this disease across thousands of electronic medical records. Methods: A retrospective analysis was conducted using de-identified data from TriNetX and Epic Cosmos. Patient characteristics of individuals with IEM and related diagnoses and treatments were extracted and chi-square analyses were used to compare between databases. Results: Overall, 8862 IEM patients were identified in Epic Cosmos and 8145 IEM patients in TriNetX. There was no difference in the number of cochlear implant patients between the two datasets (8% vs 9%, p = 0.226) and there was a statistically, but not clinically, significant difference between the number of hearing loss patients (81% vs 80%, p = 0.007). Patients were first diagnosed with IEM before age 20 at a rate of 42% in Epic Cosmos and 54% in TriNetX, and after 50 years old at a rate of 36% in Epic Cosmos and 12% in TriNetX. Conclusion: This analysis suggests most IEM patients will experience some degree of hearing loss, although onset timing and severity may vary widely and most patients will not require a cochlear implant. Additionally, more adults than previously recognized may have mild forms of IEM that contribute to late-onset symptoms. Finally, these large databases successfully present a similar patient population when queried using well-defined, consistently applied diagnosis or billing codes.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. 目的：目前对内耳畸形（IEM）患者的流行病学认识受限于该病的罕见性。本研究利用两个全国性数据库，描述该疾病在数千份电子病历中的自然进展。方法：使用TriNetX和Epic Cosmos的去标识化数据进行回顾性分析。提取IEM患者及其相关诊断和治疗的患者特征，并采用卡方分析比较两个数据库之间的差异。结果：总体而言，在Epic Cosmos中识别出8862名IEM患者，在TriNetX中识别出8145名IEM患者。两个数据集之间人工耳蜗植入患者数量无差异（8% vs 9%，p = 0.226），听力损失患者数量存在统计学显著但无临床意义的差异（81% vs 80%，p = 0.007）。在Epic Cosmos中，42%的患者在20岁之前首次诊断为IEM，在TriNetX中为54%；在50岁之后诊断的比例在Epic Cosmos中为36%，在TriNetX中为12%。结论：本分析表明，大多数IEM患者会经历某种程度的听力损失，尽管发病时间和严重程度可能差异很大，且大多数患者不需要人工耳蜗植入。此外，比以前认识的更多的成年人可能患有轻度IEM，导致迟发性症状。最后，当使用定义明确、一致应用的诊断或计费代码进行查询时，这些大型数据库成功呈现了相似的患者群体。

articles.title_en: Burden of hearing loss due to otitis media in China from 1990 to 2023: A systematic analysis of the global burden of disease study 2023
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Background: Hearing loss is a major global public health issue, and otitis media is an important preventable contributor. However, systematic evidence on the long-term burden of otitis media-related hearing loss in China remains limited. Objective: This study assessed the burden of hearing loss due to otitis media in China from 1990 to 2023 and projected future trends to 2045. Methods: Data were obtained from the Global Burden of Disease (GBD) 2023 database. Prevalent cases, years lived with disability (YLDs), age-standardized prevalence rate (ASPR), and age-standardized YLDs rate (ASYR) were analyzed. Joinpoint regression was used to evaluate temporal trends, an age–period–cohort model was used to examine age, period, and cohort effects, and a Bayesian age–period–cohort model was used for projections. Results: From 1990 to 2023, prevalent cases, YLDs, ASPR, and ASYR all decreased. The ASPR declined from 1631.48 to 1078.97 per 100,000, and the ASYR declined from 29.87 to 19.82 per 100,000, representing reductions of 33.87% and 33.65%, respectively. The ASPR and ASYR were consistently higher in males than in females. The highest prevalence and YLDs rates were observed in children aged 5–9 years. From 2024 to 2045, prevalent cases and YLDs are projected to decline, whereas ASPR and ASYR are projected to increase. Conclusion: The burden of hearing loss due to otitis media in China declined markedly from 1990 to 2023. Children aged 5–9 years remain the key population for prevention and control.

articles.title_en: AdaKAN: A dual-branch adaptive Kolmogorov-Arnold network for medical image segmentation
articles.title_cn: AdaKAN：用于医学图像分割的双分支自适应Kolmogorov-Arnold网络
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. Medical image segmentation is a fundamental task in computer-aided diagnosis, yet it remains challenging due to the complexity of anatomical structures and the variability across imaging modalities. In this paper, we propose AdaKAN, an Adaptive Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN) that synergistically integrates convolutional operations with a novel efficient KAN (EffiKAN) block, comprised of an efficient attention mechanism and an adaptive KAN (AdaptKAN) module. This module features a dual-branch design: one branch employs a KAN layer with Bernstein polynomial activations for globally smooth and stable function approximation, while the other branch performs channel-wise refinement through projection operations and adaptive scaling. AdaKAN adopts a U-shaped architecture that effectively captures both long-range dependencies and fine-grained local features, overcoming the limitations of conventional convolutional and Transformer-based segmentation models. Skip connections are employed to preserve spatial details during encoding and facilitate accurate reconstruction during decoding. Extensive experiments conducted on diverse medical imaging datasets demonstrate that AdaKAN achieves state-of-the-art performance in segmentation accuracy.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. 医学图像分割是计算机辅助诊断中的一项基本任务，但由于解剖结构的复杂性和不同成像模态之间的变异性，它仍然具有挑战性。在本文中，我们提出了AdaKAN，一种自适应Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN），它协同整合了卷积操作与一种新颖的高效KAN（EffiKAN）块，该块由高效注意力机制和自适应KAN（AdaptKAN）模块组成。该模块采用双分支设计：一个分支使用具有Bernstein多项式激活的KAN层，用于全局平滑且稳定的函数逼近，而另一个分支通过投影操作和自适应缩放进行通道级细化。AdaKAN采用U形架构，有效捕获长距离依赖和细粒度局部特征，克服了传统卷积和基于Transformer的分割模型的局限性。在编码过程中使用跳跃连接以保留空间细节，并在解码过程中促进精确重建。在多种医学成像数据集上进行的大量实验表明，AdaKAN在分割准确性方面达到了最先进的性能。

articles.title_en: Unsupervised training of keypoint-agnostic descriptors for flexible retinal image registration
articles.title_cn: 关键点无关描述符的无监督训练用于灵活的视网膜图像配准
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 The Author(s). Current color fundus image registration approaches are limited, among other things, by the lack of labeled data, which is even more significant in the medical domain, motivating the use of unsupervised learning. Therefore, in this work, we develop a novel unsupervised descriptor learning method that does not rely on keypoint detection. This enables the resulting descriptor network to be agnostic to the keypoint detector used during the registration inference. To validate this approach, we perform an extensive and comprehensive comparison on the reference public retinal image registration dataset. Additionally, we test our method with multiple keypoint detectors of varied nature, even proposing some novel ones. Our results demonstrate that the proposed approach offers accurate registration, not incurring in any performance loss versus supervised methods. Additionally, it demonstrates accurate performance regardless of the keypoint detector used. Thus, this work represents a notable step towards leveraging unsupervised learning in the medical domain.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 作者。当前的彩色眼底图像配准方法受到缺乏标注数据的限制，这在医学领域尤为显著，从而推动了无监督学习的应用。因此，在本工作中，我们开发了一种新颖的无监督描述符学习方法，该方法不依赖于关键点检测。这使得生成的描述符网络在配准推理过程中对所使用的关键点检测器具有无关性。为验证该方法，我们在参考的公共视网膜图像配准数据集上进行了广泛而全面的比较。此外，我们使用多种不同性质的关键点检测器测试了我们的方法，甚至提出了一些新颖的检测器。我们的结果表明，所提出的方法能够提供准确的配准，且与监督方法相比没有任何性能损失。此外，无论使用何种关键点检测器，它都表现出准确的性能。因此，这项工作代表了在医学领域利用无监督学习的重要一步。

articles.title_en: Learning feature-wise temporal-spatial gating with Kolmogorov-Arnold networks for EEG seizure detection
articles.title_cn: 利用Kolmogorov-Arnold网络学习特征维度时空门控用于脑电图癫痫检测
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. Automated seizure detection from electroencephalogram (EEG) requires modelling how brain signals evolve over time and how different brain regions interact. Most deep learning approaches fuse these streams using fixed, uniform operations that treat all feature dimensions equally, which may not reflect the heterogeneous interplay of temporal and spatial activity during seizures. We propose a framework that learns a separate gating weight per feature dimension through a Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN), applied to embeddings from a Bi-Mamba temporal encoder and a hypergraph convolutional spatial encoder. On the TUSZ benchmark, the model achieves AUROC 0.923, AUPRC 0.743, and F1-score 68.3%, with consistent improvements over unimodal baselines and symmetric fusion strategies across all ablation metrics. Evaluation on CHB-MIT with independent retraining yields AUROC 0.888, demonstrating architectural transferability across recording protocols and electrode configurations. An interpretability analysis shows that ictal activity sharpens temporal attention across electrodes, particularly over right frontal-central regions, increases representational divergence between encoder streams, and is associated with higher gate weighting on a specific subset of latent feature dimensions.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier B.V. 从脑电图（EEG）中自动检测癫痫发作需要建模大脑信号随时间如何演变以及不同脑区如何相互作用。大多数深度学习方法使用固定的、统一的操作来融合这些信息流，这些操作对所有特征维度一视同仁，这可能无法反映癫痫发作期间时空活动的异质性相互作用。我们提出了一个框架，通过Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）为每个特征维度学习独立的门控权重，应用于来自Bi-Mamba时间编码器和超图卷积空间编码器的嵌入。在TUSZ基准上，模型实现了AUROC 0.923、AUPRC 0.743和F1分数68.3%，在所有消融指标上相对于单模态基线和对称融合策略均有一致的改进。在CHB-MIT上独立重新训练的评估得到AUROC 0.888，证明了架构在不同记录协议和电极配置间的可迁移性。可解释性分析表明，发作期活动增强了跨电极的时间注意力，特别是在右侧额中央区域，增加了编码器流之间的表征分歧，并与特定潜在特征维度子集上的更高门控权重相关。

articles.title_en: Soil aggregate fractionation modulates Mollisol organic carbon biomineralization and CO<ce:inf loc=post>2</ce:inf> emission during freeze-thaw cycles
articles.title_cn: 土壤团聚体分馏可调节冻融循环期间 Mollisol 有机碳生物矿化和 CO<ce:inf loc=post>2</ce:inf> 排放
articles.abstract_en: Freeze-thaw cycles (FTCs) strongly regulate soil carbon dynamics in cold regions. Soil aggregates are core structural units that protect soil organic carbon (SOC) and regulate its biomineralization. While previous studies provide a good understanding of bulk soil properties, it remains elusive how aggregate size distribution modulates SOC biomineralization under repeated freeze-thaw cycles (FTCs). Cold-region Mollisols, which are characterized by high SOC concentration and strong aggregation, provide an ideal system to address this gap. Destructuring Mollisol aggregates enables disentangling size-dependent carbon protection mechanisms for preventing SOC from biodegradation. Here, joint field investigations and controlled FTCs incubation experiments were conducted using physically separated Mollisol aggregates to disentangle size-dependent carbon protection mechanisms. The results present new evidence that aggregate-mediated SOC biomineralization under FTCs exhibits a pronounced size-dependent pattern. Large macroaggregates (LMA) experienced severe physical disintegration during FTCs, exposing protected SOC and releasing 40% - 60% more cumulative CO2 than microaggregates (MIA). Small macroaggregates (SMA) showed moderate structural breakdown but comparatively low SOC biomineralization due to biochemical constraints. MIA remained structurally stable, accumulated microbially-derived dissolved organic matter, and acted as a stable carbon sink through organo-mineral associations and microbial adaptation. A modified dual-pool kinetic model further reveals that SOC loss from LMA was primarily driven by physical fragmentation, while SOC retention in MIA was governed by chemical stabilization and microbial resilience. Overall, our results highlight that aggregate hierarchical structure exerts critical control on SOC turnover and CO2 emission in cold-region Mollisols. Carbon biogeochemical models should integrate aggregate-level processes to accurately predict soil carbon dynamics in cold-region terrestrial ecosystems.
articles.abstract_cn: 冻融循环（FTC）强烈调节寒冷地区的土壤碳动态。土壤团聚体是保护土壤有机碳（SOC）并调节其生物矿化的核心结构单元。虽然之前的研究很好地了解了土壤的性质，但在反复冻融循环 (FTC) 下，团聚体尺寸分布如何调节 SOC 生物矿化仍然难以捉摸。寒区软土具有SOC浓度高、聚集性强的特点，为解决这一问题提供了理想的系统。解构 Mollisol 聚集体能够解开依赖于尺寸的碳保护机制，以防止 SOC 生物降解。在这里，使用物理分离的 Mollisol 聚集体进行了联合现场调查和受控 FTC 孵化实验，以解开尺寸依赖性碳保护机制。结果提供了新的证据，表明 FTC 下聚集体介导的 SOC 生物矿化表现出明显的尺寸依赖性模式。大型团聚体 (LMA) 在 FTC 期间经历了严重的物理分解，暴露出受保护的 SOC，并比微团聚体 (MIA) 释放 40% - 60% 更多的累积 CO2。小大团聚体 (SMA) 显示出中等程度的结构破坏，但由于生化限制，SOC 生物矿化度相对较低。 MIA 保持结构稳定，积累微生物衍生的溶解有机物，并通过有机矿物关联和微生物适应充当稳定的碳汇。修改后的双池动力学模型进一步表明，LMA 的 SOC 损失主要是由物理碎片驱动的，而 MIA 中 SOC 的保留则由化学稳定性和微生物恢复力控制。总体而言，我们的结果强调，总体层次结构对寒区软土中的 SOC 周转和 CO2 排放具有关键控制作用。碳生物地球化学模型应整合总量水平过程，以准确预测寒区陆地生态系统的土壤碳动态。

articles.title_en: Pediatric septoplasty and functional septorhinoplasty: A survey of ASPO members
articles.abstract_en: BackgroundPediatric septoplasty and functional septorhinoplasty remain controversial due to concerns for the effect of surgery on the developing nose. We aimed to assess practice patterns among pediatric otolaryngologists who perform pediatric septoplasty and septorhinoplasty. MethodsA cross-sectional survey was distributed to members of the American Society of Pediatric Otolaryngology (ASPO). Descriptive statistics were employed to summarize the typical indications and the most common techniques used in pediatric septoplasty and septorhinoplasty. ResultsEighteen percent (105/577) of ASPO members completed the survey. Of respondents, 91 (87.0%) performed septoplasty, while 29 (27.9%) performed septorhinoplasty. Those who did not perform septorhinoplasty most commonly referred to Facial Plastics and Reconstructive Surgery (74.7%). Impacts on patient-reported quality of life were the most common criterion for both septoplasty and septorhinoplasty (82.2% and 76.4%, respectively). The NOSE was the most common patient-reported outcome instrument utilized. Among respondents, 38.9% did not use a strict age cutoff to perform septoplasty and 24.1% for septorhinoplasty. The most common techniques reported were columellar strut grafts for caudal septal deviation (66.7%), spreader grafts for internal nasal valve collapse (86.7%), alar batten grafts for external nasal valve collapse (55.2%), and lateral osteotomies for external bony deviations (85.2%). Spreader grafts only are used more than spreader flaps only to treat internal nasal valve collapse (62.1% vs 3.4%), while lateral osteotomies are used more than transverse osteotomies for bony deformity (85.7 vs 0%). ConclusionDiminished patient-reported quality of life was the most common indication for pediatric septoplasty and functional septorhinoplasty among respondents. Columellar strut grafts, spreader grafts, alar batten grafts, and lateral osteotomies were common techniques used. Further work is needed to develop guidelines on septoplasty and functional septorhinoplasty in children and adolescents.

articles.title_en: Analysis of risk factors in pediatric obstructive sleep apnea questionnaires: a 20 year review
articles.abstract_en: BackgroundThe diagnostic gold standard for pediatric obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) is polysomnography (PSG), a highly resource-intensive tool with limited accessibility. As such, sleep questionnaires have been proposed as an alternative/adjunct for OSA screening. However, these questionnaires have limitations such as the inability to clearly distinguish between OSA and simple snoring, and their poor diagnostic sensitivity and specificity. Specifically, there is significant variability in the items included within the sleep questionnaires. ObjectivesTo identify and describe questionnaires that screen for pediatric OSA, identify prevalence of individual items, and review scoring methods used; To examine how questionnaires and the specific items have evolved over time. MethodsWe conducted a literature review to identify questionnaires whose primary goal was to screen for pediatric OSA in children 0-18 years old. We searched PubMed (keywords: sleep disordered breathing, OSA, sleep apnea and risk factor) and the health and psychosocial instruments (HaPI) databases. Snowball referencing technique and two comprehensive reviews were used to identify additional questionnaires. ResultsOf the 67 articles identified, 36 questionnaires containing 56 different items were included in the analysis. Items most commonly included in questionnaires were snoring (83.3%), observed apnea (83.3%) and daytime sleepiness (83.3%). Ethnicity (5.6%)and body mass index (36.1%) were not consistently included. Thirty-five questionnaires (97.2%) used quantitative scores to identify OSA. ConclusionThere are currently several questionnaires that aim to screen children for OSA. However, these questionnaires were not able to predict OSA severity, and rarely included known OSA risk factors, such as ethnicity and obesity.

articles.title_en: Multi-scale video-conditioned prompting for open-vocabulary action recognition
articles.title_cn: 多尺度视频条件提示用于开放词汇动作识别
articles.abstract_en: CLIP has shown strong image-text matching ability, but video action recognition brings additional difficulty because an action is described by both motion changes and the spatial context around the actor. For open-vocabulary recognition, this difficulty becomes more evident: the model needs to learn video-specific cues while keeping the transfer ability of CLIP. In this paper, we present MVP-CLIP, a multi-scale video-conditioned prompting method for CLIP-based action recognition. The method first uses learnable video-level prompts to collect global action context from the input clip. It also revisits the patch tokens that are not selected as temporal seeds. Instead of discarding these patches, we sort them according to class-token attention relevance, split them into ordered groups, and summarize each group as a compact background token. The resulting video-level and frame-level context tokens are injected into the text branch for visual-semantic alignment. Experiments on HMDB51, UCF101, and K400 show consistent gains in base-to-novel evaluation and competitive closed-set performance. The code used in this study is available at https://github.com/Fandonas/MVP-CLIP.
articles.abstract_cn: CLIP展现了强大的图像-文本匹配能力，但视频动作识别带来了额外的难度，因为动作由运动变化和演员周围的空间上下文共同描述。对于开放词汇识别，这一难度更加明显：模型需要在保持CLIP迁移能力的同时学习视频特定的线索。在本文中，我们提出了MVP-CLIP，一种基于CLIP动作识别的多尺度视频条件提示方法。该方法首先使用可学习的视频级提示来从输入片段中收集全局动作上下文。它还重新审视了未被选为时间种子的补丁令牌。不是丢弃这些补丁，而是根据类令牌注意力相关性对它们进行排序，将其分成有序组，并将每组总结为紧凑的背景令牌。由此产生的视频级和帧级上下文令牌被注入文本分支以进行视觉-语义对齐。在HMDB51、UCF101和K400上的实验显示，在基础到新颖评估中取得了一致的改进，并具有竞争力的闭集性能。本研究中使用的代码可在https://github.com/Fandonas/MVP-CLIP获取。

articles.title_en: Interpretable point cloud Transformers via entropy-guided attention
articles.title_cn: 基于熵引导注意力的可解释点云Transformer
articles.abstract_en: To address the “black-box” issue of Transformer-based point cloud classification models, which lack interpretability in their decision-making processes, we propose a novel interpretability method based on entropy-guided attention. First, we integrate information entropy with the self-attention mechanism to quantify the uncertainty in the attention weight distribution of Transformers. This enables the adaptive quantification of attention map weights, significantly enhancing the discriminability and interpretability of the attention visualization. Second, we introduce an Inverse Grouping Relevance Assignment (IGRA) mechanism, which propagates token-level relevance scores back to the original point clouds. This facilitates fine-grained localization of critical features. Experiments conducted on two benchmark datasets, ModelNet40 and ShapeNet, demonstrate that the proposed method significantly outperforms existing methods on the localization accuracy, interpretive granularity, and robustness. The proposed method provides an intuitive and accurate understanding of the decision for Transformer-based point cloud classification tasks. This study not only offers an effective tool for interpretability analysis of point cloud Transformers but also presents a new perspective for understanding the internal decision-making mechanisms of complex 3D models.
articles.abstract_cn: 针对基于Transformer的点云分类模型存在的“黑箱”问题，即其决策过程缺乏可解释性，我们提出了一种基于熵引导注意力的新颖可解释性方法。首先，我们将信息熵与自注意力机制相结合，以量化Transformer注意力权重分布的不确定性。这使得注意力图权重的自适应量化成为可能，显著增强了注意力可视化的判别性和可解释性。其次，我们引入了一种逆分组相关性分配（IGRA）机制，该机制将令牌级别的相关性分数传播回原始点云，从而促进关键特征的细粒度定位。在两个基准数据集ModelNet40和ShapeNet上进行的实验表明，所提出的方法在定位精度、解释粒度和鲁棒性方面显著优于现有方法。该方法为基于Transformer的点云分类任务提供了直观且准确的决策理解。这项研究不仅为点云Transformer的可解释性分析提供了有效工具，而且为理解复杂3D模型的内部决策机制提供了新视角。

articles.title_en: ASIoU: An adaptive synergistic intersection over union loss for bounding box regression
articles.title_cn: ASIoU：一种用于边界框回归的自适应协同交并比损失
articles.abstract_en: Bounding box regression critically determines localization reliability in object detection, especially for small and densely distributed targets where gradient quality directly affects convergence stability. However, existing Intersection over Union (IoU)-based losses usually combine distance, shape, and focusing terms through static formulations, which limits their ability to allocate geometric supervision according to object scale, aspect ratio, and real-time regression quality. To address this, we propose ASIoU, an adaptive synergistic IoU loss that couples scale-aware distance weighting, aspect-ratio-guided shape alignment, and prediction quality-driven modulation into a unified objective. Integrated into YOLOv8, ASIoU achieves the best or highly competitive localization performance among nine widely used IoU losses on MS COCO, PASCAL VOC, African Wildlife, and UAV-PDD2023, including a +1.1% mAP50 gain over CIoU on MS COCO, with stable improvements across diverse scene types and object scales.
articles.abstract_cn: 边界框回归关键地决定了目标检测中的定位可靠性，尤其是对于小型和密集分布的目标，其中梯度质量直接影响收敛稳定性。然而，现有的基于交并比（IoU）的损失通常通过静态公式组合距离、形状和聚焦项，这限制了其根据目标尺度、纵横比和实时回归质量分配几何监督的能力。为解决这一问题，我们提出了ASIoU，一种自适应协同IoU损失，将尺度感知的距离加权、纵横比引导的形状对齐和预测质量驱动的调制耦合到一个统一的目标中。集成到YOLOv8中，ASIoU在MS COCO、PASCAL VOC、African Wildlife和UAV-PDD2023上，在九种广泛使用的IoU损失中实现了最佳或高度竞争的定位性能，包括在MS COCO上相比CIoU获得+1.1%的mAP50提升，并在不同场景类型和目标尺度上表现出稳定的改进。

articles.title_en: Enhanced mineral carbonation of CO<ce:inf loc=post>2</ce:inf> in basalt using circulating fluidized bed combustion fly ash
articles.title_cn: 使用循环流化床燃烧飞灰增强玄武岩中 CO<ce:inf loc=post>2</ce:inf> 的矿物碳酸化
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd Of the various CO 2 trapping mechanisms, mineral carbonation is considered one of the most secure approaches for long-term geological carbon storage. Basaltic formations are attractive due to their abundance of Ca- and Mg-bearing minerals; however, mineral carbonation is often limited by insufficient release of reactive Ca ions. Here, circulating fluidized bed combustion (CFBC) fly ash was evaluated as an additional Ca source to enhance mineral carbonation in basaltic systems. Batch experiments using 0.64 M Na 2 CO 3 showed no detectable carbonate formation in the basalt system consistent with XRD results and a low total carbon content of 0.18 %. In contrast, the addition of CFBC fly ash resulted in calcite formation and increased total carbon content up to 11.22 %. A reference system composed of CaCl 2 ·2H 2 O and Na 2 CO 3 showed a higher carbon content of 15.56 %, thus confirming the formation of carbonate precipitates under Ca-rich conditions. Geochemical modeling based on batch conditions showed that the calcite saturation index (SI) increased from 0.53 to 3.41 with CFBC fly ash addition under alkaline conditions. Under CO 2 -rich conditions, increasing CO 2 pressure (up to 5 MPa) decreased pH from 9.84 to 5.46 and reduced calcite SI from 3.46 to 0.67 due to carbonate speciation shifts. These results demonstrate that mineral carbonation in basaltic systems is primarily controlled by Ca availability in Na 2 CO 3 -based alkaline systems, whereas under CO 2 (g)-rich conditions, pH and carbonate speciation govern mineral stability and precipitation behavior.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd 在各种 CO 2 捕集机制中，矿物碳酸化被认为是长期地质碳储存最安全的方法之一。玄武岩地层由于富含钙和镁矿物而极具吸引力；然而，矿物碳酸化通常受到活性钙离子释放不足的限制。在这里，循环流化床燃烧 (CFBC) 飞灰被评估为额外的钙源，以增强玄武岩系统中的矿物碳酸化。使用 0.64 M Na 2 CO 3 的批量实验表明，玄武岩系统中没有检测到碳酸盐形成，这与 XRD 结果一致，总碳含量较低为 0.18%。相比之下，CFBC飞灰的添加导致方解石形成并将总碳含量增加至11.22%。由CaCl 2·2H 2 O和Na 2 CO 3组成的参比体系显示出较高的碳含量15.56%，从而证实了在富钙条件下碳酸盐沉淀的形成。基于批次条件的地球化学模拟表明，在碱性条件下添加 CFBC 飞灰后，方解石饱和指数 (SI) 从 0.53 增加到 3.41。在富含 CO 2 的条件下，增加 CO 2 压力（高达 5 MPa）会将 pH 从 9.84 降低到 5.46，并且由于碳酸盐形态转变，将方解石 SI 从 3.46 降低到 0.67。这些结果表明，玄武岩系统中的矿物碳化主要受 Na 2 CO 3 碱性系统中 Ca 的可用性控制，而在富含 CO 2 (g) 的条件下，pH 和碳酸盐形态控制着矿物稳定性和沉淀行为。

articles.title_en: Aging biomarkers and a quantitative diagnostic model for baltic amber degradation: A multi-analytical study of unearthed archaeological artefacts
articles.title_cn: 波罗的海琥珀老化的生物标志物与定量诊断模型：出土文物的多分析研究
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd Due to the lack of quantitative tools to diagnose the aging state and predict long-term stability, the irreversible degradation of organic polymers poses a fundamental challenge to preserve organic archaeological heritage. This research systematically analyzed 50 Song-to-Qing dynasty Baltic amber artifacts using a comprehensive suite of analytical techniques, including multiple spectra and chromatography/mass spectrometry. The findings identify key aging biomarkers in unearthed amber, and it resolves a long-term argument by demonstrating that hydrolytic cleavage of ester bonds, rather than solely oxidation, is the main aging mechanism in long-term buried amber. By integrating multidimensional data within grey relational analysis, a non-destructive quantitative model was developed to rank aging degrees, achieving high concordance with macroscopic observations. This quantitative model for archaeological preservation elucidates amber's oxidative-hydrolytic degradation mechanism and enables a shift from reactive repair to proactive conservation. This diagnostic approach elucidates amber's oxidative-hydrolytic degradation mechanism and enables a shift from reactive repair to proactive conservation planning for Baltic amber collections. The analytical framework may be adaptable to other fossil resins, though further validation is required.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd 由于缺乏定量工具来诊断老化状态和预测长期稳定性，有机聚合物的不可逆降解对保存有机考古遗产构成了根本性挑战。本研究使用包括多种光谱和色谱/质谱在内的综合分析技术，系统分析了50件宋至清代波罗的海琥珀文物。研究结果识别了出土琥珀中的关键老化生物标志物，并通过证明酯键的水解断裂（而非仅氧化）是长期埋藏琥珀的主要老化机制，解决了一个长期争议。通过将多维数据整合到灰色关联分析中，开发了一种非破坏性定量模型来对老化程度进行排序，与宏观观察高度一致。这一考古保存的定量模型阐明了琥珀的氧化-水解降解机制，并实现了从被动修复到主动保护规划的转变。该诊断方法阐明了琥珀的氧化-水解降解机制，并使波罗的海琥珀收藏的保护规划能够从被动修复转向主动保护。该分析框架可能适用于其他化石树脂，但需要进一步验证。

articles.title_en: Predicting stochastic fracture in hardened alite paste <ce:italic>via</ce:italic> a microstructure-informed multiscale reconstruction of mechanical fields
articles.title_cn: 通过微观结构信息的多尺度重建力学场预测硬化硅酸三钙浆体中的随机断裂
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 The Authors. Published by Elsevier Ltd. This is an open access article under the CC BY license. http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ Microscale heterogeneity and interfacial gradients fundamentally govern the deformation and fracture of cementitious materials, yet these features remain inadequately captured by conventional continuum mechanics. While nanoindentation provides direct access to local mechanical properties at the nanometer resolution, standard mean-field homogenization methods inherently neglect spatial correlations and fail to resolve non-linear fracture and damage evolution. Here, we develop a two-dimensional, microstructure-informed multiscale framework to reconstruct high-fidelity, continuous mechanical fields from sparse nanomechanical data. Central to this spatial reconstruction is Gaussian Process Regression (GPR), combining a center-decay mean function with a composite Matern kernel. This mechanistically motivated prior enables super-resolution field reconstruction, capturing sharp phase-boundary gradients and plausible sub-grid variations below the original indentation spacing. Using synthetic alite (impure tricalcium silicate), a complex multi-phase composite as a model system, we demonstrate that incorporating the proposed spatial model outperforms classical Voigt, Reuss, Mori-Tanaka, and Hashin-Shtrikman estimates, yielding a predicted macroscopic elastic modulus in 95.6% agreement with the average measurements from in-situ compression tests. By further integrating indentation-derived fracture-resistance fields into a phase-field formulation, the model reveals stochastic microcrack initiation and morphology-dictated failure pathways within the heterogeneous low-density C-S-H matrix. This framework offers a potentially transferable route to convert sparse micromechanical data into spatially continuous fields for predicting nonlinear damage in cementitious materials.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 作者。由Elsevier Ltd出版。这是一篇根据CC BY许可的开放获取文章。http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ 微观尺度的异质性和界面梯度从根本上决定了胶凝材料的变形和断裂，然而这些特征在传统连续介质力学中尚未得到充分捕捉。虽然纳米压痕能够以纳米分辨率直接获取局部力学性能，但标准的均值场均匀化方法本质上忽略了空间相关性，并且无法解析非线性断裂和损伤演化。在此，我们开发了一个二维、基于微观结构信息的多尺度框架，从稀疏的纳米力学数据中重建高保真、连续的力学场。这种空间重建的核心是高斯过程回归（GPR），结合了中心衰减均值函数和复合Matern核。这种基于力学动机的先验能够实现超分辨率场重建，捕捉尖锐的相边界梯度和低于原始压痕间距的合理亚网格变化。使用合成硅酸三钙（不纯的硅酸三钙）作为模型系统，这是一个复杂多相复合材料，我们证明纳入所提出的空间模型优于经典的Voigt、Reuss、Mori-Tanaka和Hashin-Shtrikman估计，预测的宏观弹性模量与原位压缩试验的平均测量结果一致性达到95.6%。通过进一步将压痕衍生的抗断裂场集成到相场公式中，该模型揭示了异质低密度C-S-H基质内的随机微裂纹萌生和形态决定的失效路径。该框架提供了一种潜在可转移的途径，将稀疏的微力学数据转换为空间连续场，用于预测胶凝材料中的非线性损伤。

articles.title_en: Unravelling the functioning of andesitic volcanic aquifers in the equatorial zone using isotopic, age-dating and geochemical tracers
articles.title_cn: 利用同位素、定年和地球化学示踪剂揭示赤道地带安山质火山含水层的运作机制
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 The Authors The hydrogeological structure of volcanic aquifers is now rather well known, including for andesitic systems. However, despite the existence of well-established Hydrogeological Conceptual Models (HCM), the functioning of andesitic aquifers remains insufficiently understood. Environmental tracers provide valuable tools to address this issue. In this study, we applied a multi-tracer approach combining hydrochemistry, water stable isotopes (δ 2 H – δ 18 O) and tritium ( 3 H) in the Kedunglarangan watershed (Pandaan, Indonesia). This combination of tracers enabled a refined delineation of groundwater recharge areas by introducing a bilinear model accounting for secondary evaporation effects. We also propose a continuous (from 1900 to present) 3 H input function for the equatorial Asian region. The generic HCM of andesitic volcanic aquifers and their hydrogeological functioning were significantly improved through the identification of seven groundwater groups based on tracer signatures and groundwater age modelling. At high elevations, volcanic edifices host unconfined aquifers recharged locally through permeable lava flows and characterized by short residence times (<25 years). The transition zone between permeable volcanic formations and less permeable laharic deposits contains aquifers and springs mainly recharged from the volcanic edifice, with increasing residence times (>25 years), although few systems show evidence of substantial local recharge from lower elevations. Further downstream, within the volcano-sedimentary plain, confined aquifers overlain by lahars naturally discharge through large springs fed predominantly by high-elevation recharge, with variable but higher mean residence times (>50 years). In addition, several shallow locally recharged aquifers display low recharge rates and relatively long residence times (>100 years), discharging through small springs. This zone is also characterized by the occurrence of very old hydrothermal waters outflowing near outcropping deep geological structures. These results demonstrate a clear hydrogeological continuity from the top of the volcanoes to their feet that could not be demonstrated based only on structural (geology) and hydrodynamic information. This research greatly improves the understanding of recharge dynamics and groundwater flow circulation in recent andesitic volcanic systems. Beyond the local case, the methodology provides tools that can be used for groundwater budget assessment and groundwater quality protection in similar volcanic contexts worldwide (e.g. Pacific Ring of Fire, Caribbean, Mediterranean volcanoes etc.).
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 作者 火山含水层的水文地质结构现已相当清楚，包括安山质系统。然而，尽管存在成熟的水文地质概念模型（HCM），安山质含水层的运作机制仍未被充分理解。环境示踪剂为解决这一问题提供了有价值的工具。在本研究中，我们在Kedunglarangan流域（印度尼西亚Pandaan）应用了结合水化学、水稳定同位素（δ 2 H – δ 18 O）和氚（ 3 H）的多示踪剂方法。这种示踪剂组合通过引入考虑二次蒸发效应的双线性模型，实现了对地下水补给区的精细划分。我们还提出了赤道亚洲地区从1900年至今的连续 3 H输入函数。通过识别基于示踪剂特征和地下水年龄模拟的七个地下水组，安山质火山含水层的通用HCM及其水文地质运作机制得到了显著改进。在高海拔地区，火山体容纳了非承压含水层，通过渗透性熔岩流进行局部补给，其特征是短停留时间（<25年）。渗透性火山地层与渗透性较低的火山泥流沉积物之间的过渡带包含主要从火山体补给的含水层和泉，停留时间增加（>25年），尽管少数系统显示出从较低海拔地区进行大量局部补给的证据。更下游，在火山沉积平原内，被火山泥流覆盖的承压含水层通过大型泉自然排泄，这些泉主要由高海拔补给，平均停留时间可变但较高（>50年）。此外，几个浅层局部补给含水层显示出低补给速率和相对较长的停留时间（>100年），通过小泉排泄。该区域还以靠近出露的深部地质构造处流出非常古老的热水为特征。这些结果表明从火山顶部到山脚存在清晰的水文地质连续性，而仅基于结构（地质）和水动力信息无法证明这一点。这项研究极大地提高了对近期安山质火山系统中补给动态和地下水流动循环的理解。超越局部案例，该方法论提供了可用于全球类似火山环境中（如太平洋火环、加勒比、地中海火山等）地下水预算评估和地下水质量保护的工具。

articles.title_en: Investigating reservoir-scale heterogeneity in Li-enriched oil field brines of the Devonian Leduc and Nisku formations, Alberta Basin, Canada
articles.title_cn: 调查加拿大阿尔伯塔盆地泥盆系Leduc和Nisku组富锂油田卤水储层尺度非均质性
articles.abstract_en: Securing a North American lithium (Li) pipeline is pivotal to the clean energy transition and national security. The low-temperature sedimentary basin brines of the Devonian Alberta Basin, Canada are emerging as a promising unconventional domestic Li resource. This study integrates new and published geochemical and isotopic datasets from the Devonian Leduc and Nisku formation oil field brines to investigate brine origin, evolution, and Li enrichment mechanisms at the reservoir scale. Despite receiving considerably less attention than the Leduc Formation, the Nisku Formation brines display broadly similar geochemical and isotopic characteristics, suggesting common Li enrichment processes. Here we subdivide the Leduc and Nisku brines into geochemically distinct groups associated with four Devonian carbonate reef reservoirs (Redwater, Leduc, Chedderville, Bashaw) and evaluate the combined behavior of Li–B-radiogenic Sr–O–H isotope systems and major-element chemistry. Shallow reef complexes in hydraulic communication with surrounding formations contain low δ2H and δ18O values (avg. −78‰ and −3‰, respectively) and Li concentrations (avg. ∼32 mg/L), suggesting meteoric infiltration caused dilution of the Li resource. Brines from structurally deep reef complexes approaching the Rocky Mountain deformation front display high Li concentrations (avg. ∼67 mg/L), high δ18O (avg. 3.4‰) and radiogenic strontium values (avg. 0.70899), and low δ11B and δ7Li values (avg. 24‰ and 15‰, respectively), consistent with interaction between brines and marine shales. Results suggest that Li enrichment and preservation are controlled by distinct but related processes, where shale-fluid interactions likely contribute Li to the basin brines while hydrologic isolation controls the preservation of elevated Li concentrations.
articles.abstract_cn: 确保北美锂（Li）供应链对于清洁能源转型和国家安全至关重要。加拿大阿尔伯塔盆地泥盆系的低温沉积盆地卤水正成为有前景的非传统国内锂资源。本研究整合了来自泥盆系Leduc和Nisku组油田卤水的新的和已发表的地球化学及同位素数据集，以在储层尺度上调查卤水的来源、演化及锂富集机制。尽管Nisku组卤水受到的关注远少于Leduc组，但它们显示出大致相似的地球化学和同位素特征，表明存在共同的锂富集过程。在此，我们将Leduc和Nisku卤水划分为与四个泥盆系碳酸盐岩礁储层（Redwater、Leduc、Chedderville、Bashaw）相关的地球化学上不同的组，并评估Li–B–放射性Sr–O–H同位素体系与主量元素化学的联合行为。与周围地层水力连通的浅层礁复合体含有较低的δ2H和δ18O值（平均值分别为−78‰和−3‰）以及锂浓度（平均值约32 mg/L），表明大气降水渗入导致锂资源稀释。靠近落基山变形前缘的构造深层礁复合体的卤水显示出高锂浓度（平均值约67 mg/L）、高δ18O（平均值3.4‰）和放射性锶值（平均值0.70899），以及低δ11B和δ7Li值（平均值分别为24‰和15‰），这与卤水与海相页岩之间的相互作用一致。结果表明，锂的富集和保存受不同但相关的过程控制，其中页岩-流体相互作用可能向盆地卤水贡献锂，而水文隔离则控制高锂浓度的保存。

articles.title_en: The influence of alkali metals on the mineral formation of sulphosilicate cement clinker
articles.title_cn: 碱金属对硫硅酸盐水泥熟料矿物形成的影响
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd. All rights are reserved, including those for text and data mining, AI training, and similar technologies. Sulphosilicate cement clinker (SSC) is a new type of low-carbon clinker system. Understanding the doping behavior of alkali metal ions is important for optimizing the quality and performance of cement clinker. However, the effect of alkali metal doping on SSC is still in a blank stage. This paper investigates the sintering behavior and microstructural evolution of alkali metal ions in SSC. By combining experiments and density functional theory simulations, the doping preference of alkali metal ions in SSC is revealed. The results showed that appropriate amounts of Li + (0.5%), Na + (1%) and K + (0.5%) can promote mineral formation and reduce the sintering temperature of SSC by 50–100 °C. However, excessive alkali metals can accelerate the decomposition of C 5 S 2 $. The mineral particles in clinker aggregate with each other to form agglomerates of varying sizes. Li + is solidly soluble in C 4 A 3 $, C 5 S 2 $ and C 2 S by substitution of Ca 2+ or interstitial filling, while Na + and K + are solidly soluble only by substitution of Ca 2+ . DFT simulations further confirm that C 2 S has the optimal Ca site substitution efficiency, while the crystal structure of C 4 A 3 $ is more likely to accommodate interstitial filling, especially Li + can spontaneously occupy the interstitial sites. The study elucidated the sintering behavior, existence form and doping mechanism of alkali metals, providing theoretical guidance for the preparation of SSC.

articles.title_en: Surface moisture and interlayer properties: Near-infrared spectroscopy measurements, microstructural approach and active control strategy
articles.title_cn: 表面水分与层间性能：近红外光谱测量、微观结构方法及主动控制策略
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd. All rights are reserved, including those for text and data mining, AI training, and similar technologies. Surface moisture critically influences interlayer bond behaviour in 3D-printed cement-based materials. This paper introduces a non-destructive approach using near-infrared (NIR) spectroscopy to quantify surface moisture and integrates real-time NIR sensing with a controlled investigation of surface moisture and interlayer bond strength. We first develop, calibrate, and validate an automated NIR-based system. Using this system, we investigate how surface moisture variations—induced by wetting or drying under diverse environmental conditions—affect interlayer performance. Our findings highlight the pivotal role of surface moisture in governing local cement hydration, local porosity, and ultimate interlayer bond strength. Notably, we identify a unique relationship between surface moisture and bond strength for a given printable material, independent of the moisture history (wetting and/or drying) investigated in this paper. Leveraging these insights, we propose an active surface moisture control strategy capable of precisely targeting and regulating bond strength across varying environmental conditions. This approach offers a robust framework for optimising or tuning the structural properties of 3D-printed cementitious materials.

articles.title_en: Unraveling nanoscale chemo-mechanical interlocking in organic-inorganic sol-gel functionalized steel fiber toward ductile cementitious composite
articles.title_cn: 揭示有机-无机溶胶-凝胶功能化钢纤维中的纳米级化学-机械互锁，以实现延性水泥基复合材料
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd. All rights are reserved, including those for text and data mining, AI training, and similar technologies. Low ductility of concrete makes it vulnerable to catastrophic failure via uncontrolled crack propagation. Steel fiber can suppress crack through bridging effect, while the chemically inert surface weakens interfacial bonding and limits energy dissipation. This study develops an organic-inorganic sol-gel coating to functionalize fiber, aiming to strengthen interfacial bonding with cementitious matrix and unlock toughening capability. The bond strength with cementitious matrix increased by 97.7%, enabling one dominant localized crack with secondary cracking of cementitious composite under tensile loading. Microscale characterization and molecular dynamics simulation reveal that modified fiber features nanoscale protrusions, enhancing surface roughness and providing additional nucleation sites for SiOCa coordination interactions with matrix. Moreover, the hydrophilic coating promotes dense calcium silicate hydrate growth. Combined mechanical interlocking, chemical bridging, and interfacial microstructural densification facilitate robust bonding for stress transfer. This study presents a chemical coating to elevate energy dissipation, offering a novel and effective interfacial functionalization tactic for tough and durable construction material.

articles.title_en: Applications of sulfur isotopes to discriminate natural and anthropogenic sulfate sources with stoichiometric approaches in the Fukui Ono Basin alluvial aquifer, Japan
articles.title_cn: 利用硫同位素与化学计量学方法区分日本福井小野盆地冲积含水层中自然与人为硫酸盐来源
articles.abstract_en: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd In agricultural fields, since chemical fertilizers are one of the most important potential sources of anthropogenic sulfur in groundwater, a quantitative comprehension of this element is crucial for assessing human impacts on groundwater systems. By using hydrochemical and sulfur isotopic tracers (δ 34 S), this study identifies and quantifies the sources of groundwater sulfate in the Lowland of Fukui Ono Basin (LFOB), where agricultural fields are widely distributed. Along the northward flow paths, both sulfate and nitrate concentrations increase in the LFOB groundwater, likely attributed to the oxidation processes of ammonium sulfate fertilizer. In more detail, δ 34 S analysis reveals the existence of the other sulfate source: soil organic matter with high δ 34 S values (+6.33∼+12.73‰) in addition to chemical fertilizers with low δ 34 S values (−0.60 to +0.60‰). The quantitative discriminations based on δ 34 S signatures demonstrate that anthropogenic sulfate from chemical fertilizers accounts for 58∼82% of the total sulfate associated with nitrate concentrations in the groundwater. On the other hand, natural sulfate from soil organic matter (18∼42%) is consistent with partial CO 2 pressure, an indicator of organic matter decomposition in aquifers. In addition, a spatial analysis reveals distinct hydrological pathways; anthropogenic sulfate progressively accumulates along northward groundwater flow paths due to agricultural inputs, whereas natural sulfate distributions are controlled by localized hydrogeological features. Especially for the latter, low natural sulfate concentrations in the central basin reflect dilution from river water infiltration, while elevated natural sulfate concentrations in the western basin are likely derived through the decomposition of organic-rich lacustrine deposits. Thus, this study demonstrates that combining isotopic tracers with stoichiometric indicators provides a robust framework for understanding contaminant transport and geological influences in complex alluvial aquifer systems.
articles.abstract_cn: © 2026 Elsevier Ltd 在农业区，由于化学肥料是地下水中人为硫最重要的潜在来源之一，定量理解该元素对于评估人类活动对地下水系统的影响至关重要。通过使用水化学和硫同位素示踪剂（δ 34 S），本研究识别并量化了福井小野盆地低地（LFOB）地下水中硫酸盐的来源，该地区农业田地广泛分布。沿向北的流动路径，LFOB地下水中的硫酸盐和硝酸盐浓度均增加，这可能归因于硫酸铵肥料的氧化过程。更详细地，δ 34 S分析揭示了其他硫酸盐来源的存在：具有高δ 34 S值（+6.33∼+12.73‰）的土壤有机质，以及具有低δ 34 S值（−0.60至+0.60‰）的化学肥料。基于δ 34 S特征的定量区分表明，来自化学肥料的人为硫酸盐占地下水中与硝酸盐浓度相关的总硫酸盐的58∼82%。另一方面，来自土壤有机质的自然硫酸盐（18∼42%）与部分CO 2压力一致，这是含水层中有机质分解的指标。此外，空间分析揭示了不同的水文路径；人为硫酸盐沿向北的地下水流动路径逐渐积累，这是由于农业输入，而自然硫酸盐的分布受局部水文地质特征控制。特别是对于后者，盆地中部的低自然硫酸盐浓度反映了河流水入渗的稀释作用，而西部盆地的高自然硫酸盐浓度可能源于富含有机质的湖相沉积物的分解。因此，本研究证明，将同位素示踪剂与化学计量指标相结合，为理解复杂冲积含水层系统中的污染物迁移和地质影响提供了稳健的框架。

articles.title_en: Dissolved oxygen control on manganese release and component-selective DOM transport at the sediment–water interface: A mechanistic geochemical study of lake biwa sediments
articles.title_cn: 溶解氧对沉积物-水界面锰释放和组分选择性溶解有机质迁移的控制：琵琶湖沉积物的机理地球化学研究
articles.abstract_en: Bottom-water deoxygenation is intensifying in many stratified lakes, yet quantitative links between dissolved oxygen (DO) and sediment redox fluxes and dissolved organic matter (DOM) exchange remain uncertain. Here we used long-duration intact-core incubations from Lake Biwa (Japan) under three controlled DO regimes (0, 2.6, and 10 mg L−1 at 7°C) to evaluate how DO modulates Mn/Fe/P mobility and the relative transport/retention of humic-like vs protein-like fluorescent DOM components. Anoxia triggered large Mn release (to ∼40 mg L−1 by day 120), whereas 2.6 and 10 mg L−1 suppressed Mn to ≤0.5 mg L−1 (∼130× lower). In contrast, dissolved Fe and P remained low across treatments (<0.5 and < 0.3 mg L−1). Fluorescence excitation–emission matrices (EEMs) showed preferential accumulation of protein-like signals in pore waters, while fulvic acid–like (FA-like) signals were more evident in overlying waters. Nernst/Gibbs calculations yield a thermodynamic ordering consistent with preferential Mn reduction before Fe under our experimental conditions, though this interpretation remains a working hypothesis pending direct verification. We emphasize that our incubations represent a gas-controlled, closed-water design that excludes bioturbation and advective transport, and that fluorescence classes are operational proxies rather than direct molecular-size measurements. Together, these results provide testable, physicochemically grounded hypotheses for DO-sensitive Mn cycling and DOM partitioning at sediment–water interfaces in stratified lakes.
articles.abstract_cn: 在许多分层湖泊中，底层水脱氧正在加剧，但溶解氧（DO）与沉积物氧化还原通量及溶解有机质（DOM）交换之间的定量联系仍不确定。本研究使用日本琵琶湖的长期完整岩心培养实验，在三种受控DO条件下（7°C时分别为0、2.6和10 mg L−1），评估DO如何调节Mn/Fe/P的迁移性以及类腐殖质与类蛋白荧光DOM组分的相对迁移/保留。缺氧引发了大量锰释放（至第120天时约达40 mg L−1），而2.6和10 mg L−1的DO将锰抑制至≤0.5 mg L−1（约低130倍）。相比之下，各处理中溶解态铁和磷均保持较低水平（分别<0.5和<0.3 mg L−1）。荧光激发-发射矩阵（EEMs）显示，孔隙水中类蛋白信号优先积累，而上覆水中类富里酸（FA类）信号更为明显。能斯特/吉布斯计算得出了一个热力学排序，与实验条件下优先进行锰还原而非铁还原的现象一致，但这一解释仍有待直接验证，目前仅为一种工作假设。我们强调，我们的培养实验代表了一种气体控制的封闭水设计，排除了生物扰动和平流输运，且荧光类别是操作性的代理指标，而非直接的分子大小测量。综合来看，这些结果为分层湖泊沉积物-水界面处对DO敏感的锰循环和DOM分配提供了可检验的、基于物理化学基础的假设。

articles.title_en: Evolution of carbonation in cement blends incorporating thermally-mechanochemically activated low-kaolinite mixed-layer clays: Insights into hydrate phase assemblage, C-A-S-H structure and porosity
articles.title_cn: 含热-机械化学活化低高岭石混层黏土的水泥混合材中碳化演变：水化相组合、C-A-S-H结构与孔隙率的见解
articles.abstract_en: Low-kaolinite clays represent a globally abundant resource for reducing clinker content, yet their durability remains poorly understood. This study examines the carbonation behavior of a clay blended binder incorporating 30 wt% of a thermally-mechanochemically activated 2:1 mixed-layer clay, with emphasis on hydrate assemblage evolution, C-A-S-H chemistry, and pore structure. Drying was decoupled from CO₂ exposure to distinguish physical conditioning from chemically driven carbonation damage, and curing duration was varied to access different hydrate states in this slow-reacting system. Carbonation proceeds through CH depletion, AFm/AFt destabilisation, and C-A-S-H decalcification; however, the extent of degradation depends strongly on the chemical maturity of the gel at the time of exposure. Binders carbonated after extended curing show markedly reduced decalcification (Ld ≈ 34% versus 92% in short-cured samples) and limited pore coarsening. Drying induces gel contraction and pore restructuring, but severe degradation occurs only when carbonation chemically decalcifies the gel. These results demonstrate that carbonation resistance in low-kaolinite binders is governed by hydrate assemblage evolution and chemical maturity of C-A-S-H, reflecting carbonation pathways distinct from those assumed for OPC and LC3 systems.
articles.abstract_cn: 低高岭石黏土是全球范围内减少熟料含量的丰富资源，但其耐久性仍知之甚少。本研究考察了掺入30 wt%热-机械化学活化的2:1混层黏土的黏土混合胶凝材料的碳化行为，重点研究水化相演变、C-A-S-H化学和孔隙结构。干燥与CO₂暴露解耦，以区分物理调理与化学驱动的碳化损伤，并改变养护时间以获取该慢反应体系中不同的水化状态。碳化通过CH消耗、AFm/AFt失稳和C-A-S-H脱钙进行；然而，降解程度强烈依赖于暴露时凝胶的化学成熟度。延长养护后碳化的胶凝材料显示出显著降低的脱钙（短养护样品中Ld ≈ 34%对比92%）和有限的孔隙粗化。干燥引起凝胶收缩和孔隙重构，但严重降解仅在碳化化学脱钙凝胶时发生。这些结果表明，低高岭石胶凝材料的抗碳化性受水化相演变和C-A-S-H化学成熟度控制，反映了与OPC和LC3体系假设不同的碳化路径。

articles.title_en: A predictive model for acid generation critical time in filtered tailings using acidification and neutralization potential
articles.title_cn: 使用酸化和中和电位预测过滤尾矿中产酸临界时间的模型
articles.abstract_en: Tailings filtration enhances the geotechnical stability of tailings storage facilities and contributes to reducing their overall footprint. However, despite these operational advantages, the low degree of saturation associated with filtered tailings may also increase the risk for acid mine drainage (AMD) generation. In this research, laboratory kinetic tests were coupled with multicomponent reactive transport simulations to assess the time tailings can remain exposed before AMD generation starts, identified as critical time. Laboratory kinetics tests were performed on reactive mine tailings at various degrees of saturation, and the evolution of pore-water geochemistry was monitored over time. Numerical simulations were then calibrated on the laboratory tests and extrapolated to other mineral contents. Experimental and numerical results showed that critical time was significantly delayed when the degree of saturation exceeded 90%. The critical time was primarily governed by the neutralization potential associated with carbonate content, and was also influenced by the net neutralization potential, especially when neutralization to acidification potential ratio was greater than 0.5. Finally, a predictive equation was proposed to estimate critical time. Predicting critical time can be useful to optimize filtered tailings management and reclamation and improve the geochemical stability of filtered tailings storage facilities.
articles.abstract_cn: 尾矿过滤增强了尾矿储存设施的岩土稳定性，并有助于减少其总体占地面积。然而，尽管有这些操作优势，与过滤尾矿相关的低饱和度也可能增加酸性矿山排水（AMD）产生的风险。在这项研究中，实验室动力学测试与多组分反应输运模拟相结合，以评估在 AMD 生成开始之前尾矿可以保持暴露的时间，该时间被确定为关键时间。对不同饱和度的活性尾矿进行了实验室动力学测试，并监测了孔隙水地球化学随时间的演变。然后根据实验室测试对数值模拟进行校准，并外推至其他矿物质含量。实验和数值结果表明，当饱和度超过90%时，临界时间显着延迟。临界时间主要由与碳酸盐含量相关的中和电位决定，并且还受到净中和电位的影响，特别是当中和与酸化电位之比大于0.5时。最后，提出了一个预测方程来估计关键时间。预测关键时间有助于优化过滤尾矿管理和回收，并提高过滤尾矿储存设施的地球化学稳定性。

articles.title_en: Inter-basin groundwater flow pathways and hydrogeochemical evolution regulated by deep fault systems
articles.title_cn: 深大断裂系统调控的跨流域地下水流动路径及水文地球化学演化
articles.abstract_en: Inter-basin groundwater flow (IGF) is defined as groundwater flow across topographic or hydrologic basin boundaries, which plays a critical role in regional water budgets and the global water cycle. On the Tibetan Plateau (TP), IGF has been acknowledged as the primary process responsible for water deficits of drainage basins, with deep fault systems serving as the principal conduits facilitating such flow. This study presents comprehensive hydrogeochemical and multi-isotopic evidence (δ18O, δ2H, 3H, 87Sr/86Sr, and trace elements) to delineate fault-controlled IGF in the southern TP. The results demonstrate that a portion of the leakage water from Nam Co Lake migrates southward as IGF into adjacent river basins along deep, middle, and shallow pathways constrained by the underlying deep fault system. The hydrogeochemical evolution of deep IGF is characterized by inputs from magmatic fluids and extensive interactions with carbonate and silicate minerals, while shallower pathways are primarily controlled by carbonate dissolution and freshwater mixing. These findings underscore the significance of deep faults in regulating IGF transport and evolution. A ternary mixing model of 87Sr/86Sr and δ18O indicates that IGF mixing ratios in local groundwater range from 1.0% to 26.5%, generally decreasing with flow distance. The contribution of IGF to river runoff is estimated to be <6.0% compared with the dominant sources of meteoric water and local groundwater. This study presents a hydrogeochemical framework for identifying IGF patterns beyond water-balance approaches, providing valuable insights into regional water resource assessment and sustainable management on the TP and in other fault-controlled areas.
articles.abstract_cn: 跨流域地下水流动（IGF）被定义为地下水跨越地形或水文流域边界的流动，其在区域水资源预算和全球水循环中发挥着关键作用。在青藏高原（TP），IGF已被认为是造成流域水资源赤字的主要过程，而深大断裂系统则是促进此类流动的主要通道。本研究提供了综合的水文地球化学和多同位素证据（δ18O、δ2H、3H、87Sr/86Sr及微量元素），以描绘青藏高原南部受断裂控制的IGF。结果表明，纳木错湖的部分渗漏水作为IGF沿深、中、浅路径向南迁移至相邻河流流域，这些路径受下伏深大断裂系统的约束。深部IGF的水文地球化学演化特征为岩浆流体输入及与碳酸盐和硅酸盐矿物的广泛相互作用，而较浅路径则主要受碳酸盐溶解和淡水混合控制。这些发现强调了深大断裂在调控IGF运移和演化中的重要性。87Sr/86Sr和δ18O的三元混合模型表明，当地地下水中IGF混合比例范围为1.0%至26.5%，通常随流动距离增加而减少。与主要来源的大气降水和当地地下水相比，IGF对河流径流的贡献估计小于6.0%。本研究提出了一个超越水量平衡方法识别IGF模式的水文地球化学框架，为青藏高原及其他断裂控制区域的水资源评估和可持续管理提供了宝贵见解。

articles.title_en: Cochlear implantation for cochlear hypoplasia type I: Surgical considerations and auditory outcomes in a case series
articles.title_cn: I型耳蜗发育不全的耳蜗植入：手术考量与听觉结果病例系列研究
articles.abstract_en: BackgroundCochlear hypoplasia type I (CH-I) is a severe inner ear malformation often deemed a relative contraindication for cochlear implantation (CI), posing unique challenges for patients. ObjectivesThis study aimed to evaluate surgical techniques, challenges, and postoperative auditory outcomes in CH-I patients undergoing CI, identifying key prognostic factors. Material and methodsA retrospective analysis of six CH-I patients (11–222 months old) who underwent CI between 2012 and 2023 was conducted. Five patients used the transmastoid facial nerve recess approach (TFNRA) with a short straight electrode, while one employed the transmastoid slot labyrinthotomy approach (TSLA) with a customized electrode. Outcomes were assessed via Categories of Auditory Performance (CAP), Speech Intelligibility Rating (SIR), and both closed-set and open-set speech tests, including the Mandarin Lexical Neighborhood Test (MLNT). ResultsFive patients achieved useable auditory function, with three demonstrating good open-set speech recognition. No significant differences were observed between unilateral and bilateral implantation. Conclusions and significanceCI is viable for CH-I patients when TFNRA are combined with systematic auditory training. Preoperative cochlear morphology assessment and short straight electrodes are crucial for optimizing outcomes, emphasizing the need for long-term rehabilitation.

articles.title_en: Iron precipitation for permeability reduction of sands
articles.title_cn: 铁沉淀降低砂土渗透性
articles.abstract_en: We present in this paper an approach to reduce sand permeability through the aerobic precipitation of ferric iron. First, a passive, counterdiffusion approach in which de-oxygenated water with Fe(II) chloride and an organic buffer (either sodium acetate or sodium propionate) is employed to saturate the sand. As oxidation proceeds, aqueous iron is consumed and a band of precipitate forms below the sand-air interface. This establishes a gradient in which iron diffuses upwards toward the source of oxygen to fuel further oxidation. Secondly, an active, flush-based approach involving the periodic introduction/draining of treatment solution was employed in attempt to overcome caveats of counterdiffusion. In these tests, water is periodically cycled every 30 min. This allows air to fully permeate the columns, provides enhanced control over the reaction environment, and enables oxidation and precipitation over a greater depth. Various initial concentrations of iron ranging from 0.1 M to 1 M in concentration were assessed. Using these approaches, the hydraulic conductivity of Ottawa 20-30 sand has been reduced by 22% to 98%, with the extent of reduction correlating positively with the concentration of iron. The use of propionate as a buffer generally led to higher reductions in permeability—a result attributed to decreased complexation with iron relative to acetate. Counterdiffusion experiments, while offering a simple and passive approach and successfully reducing permeability in some cases by up to 98% while requiring fewer reagents, often resulted in a thin and easily fractured layer at lower concentrations. The flush approach, while enhancing oxygenation and allocating precipitates over an extended region, inspired a rapid reaction and precipitates which more-readily detached from sand prior to elution during hydraulic conductivity tests.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种通过三价铁的有氧沉淀来降低砂土渗透性的方法。首先，采用一种被动的、逆扩散方法，使用含有氯化亚铁（Fe(II)）和有机缓冲剂（乙酸钠或丙酸钠）的脱氧水饱和砂土。随着氧化进行，水相中的铁被消耗，并在砂土-空气界面下方形成一层沉淀带。这建立了一个梯度，使铁向上扩散至氧气源以促进进一步氧化。其次，采用一种主动的、冲洗式方法，涉及处理溶液的周期性引入/排出，以试图克服逆扩散的缺陷。在这些试验中，水每30分钟周期性循环一次。这使空气能够完全渗透柱体，增强对反应环境的控制，并使氧化和沉淀在更大深度内发生。评估了从0.1 M到1 M的不同初始铁浓度。使用这些方法，渥太华20-30砂的水力传导率降低了22%至98%，降低程度与铁浓度正相关。使用丙酸盐作为缓冲剂通常导致更高的渗透性降低——这一结果归因于与铁相比，丙酸盐与铁的络合作用较弱。逆扩散实验虽然提供了一种简单且被动的方法，在某些情况下成功将渗透性降低高达98%且所需试剂较少，但在较低浓度下往往形成薄且易碎的层。冲洗方法虽然增强了氧化作用并将沉淀物分配在更广泛的区域，但引发了快速反应，且沉淀物在水力传导率测试期间更容易在洗脱前从砂土上脱落。
